text: Riba djaluna, sientífikonan di e Skol di Medisina di Universidat di Stanford a anunsiá e invento di un hèrmènt diagnóstiko nobo ku por surti sélula a base di tipo: un chep chikitu ku por produsí hasiendo uso di standart enkdjèt prenter pa posiblemente un sèn estadounidense pa unu.
eng_text: On Monday, scientists from the Stanford University School of Medicine announced the invention of a new diagnostic tool that can sort cells by type: a tiny printable chip that can be manufactured using standard inkjet printers for possibly about one U.S. cent each.

text: Investigadornan dirigente ta bisa ku esaki lo por trese detekshon tempran di kanser, tuberkulósis, HIV i malaria pa pashèntnan na paisnan di entrada abou, kaminda e sifra di sobrebibensia pa malesanan manera kanser di pechu por ta mitar di esun di paisnan mas riku.
eng_text: Lead researchers say this may bring early detection of cancer, tuberculosis, HIV and malaria to patients in low-income countries, where the survival rates for illnesses such as breast cancer can be half those of richer countries.

text: E JAS 39C Gripen a kai riba un pista di aterisahe pa mas òf ménos 9:30 am ora lokal (02:30 UTC) i a eksplotá, poniendo ku a sera e aeropuerto pa buelonan komersial.
eng_text: The JAS 39C Gripen crashed onto a runway at around 9:30 am local time (0230 UTC) and exploded, closing the airport to commercial flights.

text: A identifiká e piloto komo Lider di Eskuadron Dilokrit Pattavee.
eng_text: The pilot was identified as Squadron Leader Dilokrit Pattavee.

text: Medionan lokal ta reportá ku un vehíkulo di brantwer di aeropuerto a bòltu riba kaminda pa duna asistensia.
eng_text: Local media reports an airport fire vehicle rolled over while responding.

text: Vidal di 28 aña di edat a afiliá na Barça for di Sevilla, tres temporada pasá.
eng_text: 28-year-old Vidal had joined Barça three seasons ago, from Sevilla.

text: For di binimentu pa e kapital katalan, Vidal a hunga 49 partido pa e klup.
eng_text: Since moving to the Catalan-capital, Vidal had played 49 games for the club.

text: E protesta a start alrededor di 11:00 ora lokal (UTC+1) na Whitehall enfrente di e entrada pa Downing Street vigilá pa polis, e residensia ofisial di Promé Minister.
eng_text: The protest started around 11:00 local time (UTC+1) on Whitehall opposite the police-guarded entrance to Downing Street, the Prime Minister's official residence.

text: Djis despues di 11:00 or, manifestantenan a blòkia tráfiko na Whitehall riba e kaya direkshon nort.
eng_text: Just after 11:00, protesters blocked traffic on the northbound carriage in Whitehall.

text: Pa 11:20 or, polis a pidi e manifestantenan pa hala tras riba asera, argumentando ku nan mester a balansá e derecho pa protestá ku e tráfiko ku tabata kresiendo.
eng_text: At 11:20, the police asked the protesters to move back on to the pavement, stating that they needed to balance the right to protest with the traffic building up.

text: Banda di 11:29, e protesta a bai direkshon di Whitehall, pasa Trafalgar Square, na banda di the Strand, pasando banda di Aldwych i drentando Kingsway direkshon di Holborn kaminda ku Conservative Party tabata tene su Foro di Primavera den hotèl Grand Connaught Rooms.
eng_text: Around 11:29, the protest moved up Whitehall, past Trafalgar Square, along the Strand, passing by Aldwych and up Kingsway towards Holborn where the Conservative Party were holding their Spring Forum in the Grand Connaught Rooms hotel.

text: Nadal su rèkert personal kontra e kanades ta 7 – 2.
eng_text: Nadal's head to head record against the Canadian is 7–2.

text: Resientemente el a pèrdè kontra Raonic den Brisbane Open.
eng_text: He recently lost against Raonic in the Brisbane Open.

text: Nadal a skor 88% ku punto na nèt den e partido ganando 76 punto den e promé serve.
eng_text: Nadal bagged 88% net points in the match winning 76 points in the first serve.

text: Despues di e partido, King of Clay a bisa, “Mi ta simplemente eksitá, pa ta bèk den e ròndunan final di e eventonan mas importante. Mi ta aki pa purba di gana esaki.”
eng_text: After the match, King of Clay said, "I am just excited about being back in the final rounds of the most important events. I am here to try to win this."

text: “Panama Papers” ta un palabra kapa pa globalmente dies mion di dokumento di e ofisina di abogado panameño Mossack Fonsera, ku a lèk pa prensa na primavera 2016.
eng_text: "Panama Papers" is an umbrella term for roughly ten million documents from Panamanian law firm Mossack Fonseca, leaked to the press in spring 2016.

text: E dokumentonan a mustra ku dieskuater banko a yuda klientenan riku skonde rikesa na balor di biónes di dòler estadounidense pa evadí impuesto i otro reglamentunan.
eng_text: The documents showed fourteen banks helped wealthy clients hide billions of US dollars of wealth to avoid taxes and other regulations.

text: E korant britániko The Guardian a sugerí ku Deutsche Bank tabata kontrolá aproksimadamente un terser parti di e 1200 kompanianan fantasma usá pa logra esaki.
eng_text: British newspaper The Guardian suggested Deutsche Bank controlled roughly a third of the 1200 shell companies used to accomplish this.

text: Tabatin protesta rònt mundu, diferente persekushon kriminal, i e lidernan di e gobièrnunan di Islandia i Pakistan tur dos a resigná.
eng_text: There were protests worldwide, several criminal prosecutions, and the leaders of the governments of Iceland and Pakistan both resigned.

text: Nasé na Hong Kong, Ma a studia na Universidat di New York i Harvard Law School i tabatin un tempu un “green card” merikano komo residente permanente.
eng_text: Born in Hong Kong, Ma studied at New York University and Harvard Law School and once held an American permanent resident "green card".

text: Hsieh a indiká durante e elekshon ku Ma lo por hui for di e pais durante un tempu di krísis.
eng_text: Hsieh implied during the election that Ma might flee the country during a time of crisis.

text: Hsied a deklará tambe ku e Ma fotogéniko tabata mas bien pa apariensia ku pa e kontenido.
eng_text: Hsieh also argued that the photogenic Ma was more style than substance.

text: Apesar di e akusashonnan akí, Ma a gana ábilmente riba un plataforma ku ta abogá pa relashonnan mas estrecho ku China kontinental.
eng_text: Despite these accusations, Ma won handily on a platform advocating closer ties with the Chinese mainland.

text: ‘Player of the Day’ di awe ta Alex Ovechkin di Washington Capitals.
eng_text: Today's Player of the Day is Alex Ovechkin of the Washington Capitals.

text: E tabatin 2 gol i 2 asistensia pa hinka gol den Washington su viktoria di 5-3 riba Atlanta Thrashers.
eng_text: He had 2 goals and 2 assists in Washington's 5-3 win over the Atlanta Thrashers.

text: Ovechkin su promé asistensia di e anochi tabata pa e gol di viktoria den e enkuentro, dor di e nobato Nicklas Backstrom;
eng_text: Ovechkin's first assist of the night was on the game-winning goal by rookie Nicklas Backstrom;

text: su segundo gol di e anochi tabata su di 60 di temporada, birando e promé hungadó pa skor 60 òf mas gol den un temporada for di 1995-96, tempu ku Jaromir Jagr i Mario Lemieux kada unu a alkansá e rekòrt akí.
eng_text: his second goal of the night was his 60th of the season, becoming the first player to score 60 or more goals in a season since 1995-96, when Jaromir Jagr and Mario Lemieux each reached that milestone.

text: Batten tabata na puesto 190 riba e lista 400 Richest Americans (e 400 merikanonan di mas riku) na 2008, ku un fortuna kalkulá di $2,3 bion.
eng_text: Batten was ranked 190th on the 2008 400 Richest Americans list with an estimated fortune of $2.3 billion.

text: El a graduá na College of Arts & Sciences di e Universidat di Virginia na 1950 i tabata un donatùr signifikante na e instituto akí.
eng_text: He graduated from the College of Arts & Sciences of the University of Virginia in 1950 and was a significant donor to that institution.

text: A sende Irak su prizòn Abu Ghraib na kandela durante un rebelion.
eng_text: Iraq's Abu Ghraib prison has been set alight during a riot.

text: E prisòn a haña mal fama despues ku a deskubrí abuso di prisionero ayaden despues ku trupanan merikano a tuma poder.
eng_text: The jail became notorious after prisoner abuse was discovered there after US forces took over.

text: Piquet Jr. a dal su outo den e 2008 Singapor Grand Prix nèt despues di un service stòp tempran pa Fernando Alonso, loke a pone e outo di seguridat subi pista.
eng_text: Piquet Jr. crashed in the 2008 Singapore Grand Prix just after an early pit stop for Fernando Alonso, bringing out the safety car.

text: Miéntras ku e outonan dilanti di Alonso a bai paden pa tènk kombustibel durante e pousa di e outo di seguridat, el a subi di posishon pa kohe e viktoria.
eng_text: As the cars ahead of Alonso went in for fuel under the safety car, he moved up the pack to take victory.

text: Piquet Jr. a haña retiro despues di e 2009 Hungarian Grand Prix.
eng_text: Piquet Jr. was sacked after the 2009 Hungarian Grand Prix.

text: Pa 8:46 a.m. eksaktamente un silensio a kai den e siudat, markando e momentu ku e promé djèt a ataká su meta.
eng_text: At exactly 8:46 a.m. a hush fell across the city, marking the exact moment the first jet struck its target.

text: Dos rayo di lus a wòrdu manipulá pa marka lus den laira anochi.
eng_text: Two beams of light have been rigged up to point skywards overnight.

text: Konstrukshon di sinku raskashelu nobo ta kanando na e sitio, ku un sentro pa transporte i un parke memorial den e parti sentral.
eng_text: Construction is ongoing for five new skyscrapers at the site, with a transportation center and memorial park in the middle.

text: E show di PBS tin mas ku dos mil premio Emmy i su rekorido poko ménos ku Sesame Street i Mister Rogers´Neighborhood.
eng_text: The PBS show has more than two-dozen Emmy awards, and its run is shorter only than Sesame Street and Mister Rogers' Neighborhood.

text: Kada episodio di e show ta enfoká riba un tema di un buki spesifiko i despues eksplorá e tema pa medio di diferente storianan.
eng_text: Each episode of the show would focus on a theme in a specific book and then explore that theme through multiple stories.

text: Kada show ta proveé rekomendashonan pa bukinan ku muchanan por buska ora nan bai nan biblioteka.
eng_text: Each show would also provide recommendations for books that children should look for when they went to their library.

text: John Grant for di WNED Buffalo (Reading Rainbow´s home station) a bisa: “Reading Rainbow a siña muchanan e rason pa lesa,... amor pa lesamentu - [e show] a enkurashá muchanan pa kue un buki i lesa.”
eng_text: John Grant, from WNED Buffalo (Reading Rainbow's home station) said "Reading Rainbow taught kids why to read,... the love of reading — [the show] encouraged kids to pick up a book and to read."

text: Algún ta kere, inkluyendo John Grant, ku e krísis finansiero i e kambio den filosofia di e programa edukashonal di televishon a kontribuí na terminashon di e serie.
eng_text: It is believed by some, including John Grant, that both the funding crunch and a shift in the philosophy of educational television programming contributed to ending the series.

text: E tormenta, situá mas òf ménos 645 mia (1040 km) wèst di e islanan di Kabo Bèrdè, lo disolvé probablemente promé ku e por menasá kualke área na tera, pronostikadornan ta bisa.
eng_text: The storm, situated about 645 miles (1040 km) west of the Cape Verde islands, is likely to dissipate before threatening any land areas, forecasters say.

text: Fred aktualmente tin bientu di 105 mia pa ora (165 km/ora) i ta move den direkshon nortwèst.
eng_text: Fred currently has winds of 105 miles per hour (165 km/h) and is moving towards the northwest.

text: Fred ta e siklon tropikal mas fuerte ku a yega di registrá asina leu sùit i ost den Atlántiko for di yegada di uso di imágen di satélite, i ta e úniko orkan grandi registrá ost di 35°W.
eng_text: Fred is the strongest tropical cyclone ever recorded so far south and east in the Atlantic since the advent of satellite imagery, and only the third major hurricane on record east of 35°W.

text: Riba 24 di sèptèmber 1759, Arthur Guinness a firma un hür di 9.000 aña pa e St James’ Gate Brewery na Dublin, Irlanda.
eng_text: On September 24, 1759, Arthur Guinness signed a 9,000 year lease for the St James' Gate Brewery in Dublin, Ireland.

text: 250 aña despues, Guinness a krese bira un empresa global ku ta produsí mas ku 10 bion euro (US$14,7 bion) kada aña.
eng_text: 250 years later, Guinness has grown to a global business that turns over 10 billion euros (US$14.7 billion) every year.

text: Jonny Reid, ko-shofùr di e tim A1GP di Nueva Zelandia, a marka historia awe ku stür legalmente ku velosidat mas haltu riba e brùg Auckland Harbour Bridge di 48 aña bieu, na Nueva Zelandia.
eng_text: Jonny Reid, co-driver for the A1GP New Zealand team, today made history by driving the fastest over the 48-year-old Auckland Harbour Bridge, New Zealand, legally.

text: Sr. Reid a logra di kore e outo di A1GP Nueva Zelandia, Black Beauty na velosidat di mas ku 160km/ora shete biaha riba e brùg.
eng_text: Mr Reid managed to drive the New Zealand's A1GP car, Black Beauty at speeds over 160km/h seven times over the bridge.

text: Polis di Nueva Zelandia tabatin problema pa usa nan aparatonan di radar pa kapta kon duru Mr. Reid tabata kore, pa motibu di e haltura plat di Black Beauty, i e úniko biaha ku polis a logra di kapta velosidat di Mr Reid tabata ora ku el a baha velosidat na 160km/ora.
eng_text: The New Zealand police had trouble using their speed radar guns to see how fast Mr Reid was going because of how low Black Beauty is, and the only time the police managed to clock Mr Reid was when he slowed down to 160km/h.

text: Den e último 3 lunanan, a laga mas ku 80 detenido liber for di e fasilidat Central Booking sin ku a akusá nan formalmente di ningun karga.
eng_text: In the last 3 months, over 80 arrestees were released from the Central Booking facility without being formally charged.

text: Na aprel e aña akí, Hues Glynn a saka un órden di restrikshon temporario kontra e fasilidat pa fòrsa ponementu liber di e personanan detené pa mas ku 24 ora despues di nan entrada den e fasilidat, ku no a haña un oudiensia di parti di un ofisial di korte.
eng_text: In April this year, a temporary restaining order was issued by Judge Glynn against the facility to enforce the release of those held more than 24 hours after their intake who did not receive a hearing by a court commissioner.

text: E ofisial ta stipulá libertat bou di bòrg, si esaki ta posibel, i ta formalisá e karganan ku e ofisial di detenshon a registrá. E ora ei ta hinka e karganan den sistema di kòmpiuter di estado unda por sigui e kaso.
eng_text: The commissioner sets bail, if granted, and formalizes the charges filed by the arresting officer. The charges are then entered into the state's computer system where the case is tracked.

text: E oudiensia ta stipulá tambe e fecha pa un tratamentu pronto di e kaso di e sospechoso segun su derecho.
eng_text: The hearing also marks the date for the suspect’s right to a speedy trial.

text: Peter Costello, Minister di Finansa oustraliano i e hòmber ku mui probablemente lo ta susesor di Promé Minister John Howard komo lider di Liberal Party, a duna su sosten na un industria di energia nuklear na Australia.
eng_text: Peter Costello, Australian treasurer and the man most likely to succeed Prime Minister John Howard as Liberal party leader has thrown his support behind a nuclear power industry in Australia.

text: Sr. Costello a bisa ku ora produkshon di energia nuklear bira ekonómikamente faktibel, Australia mester aspirá su uso.
eng_text: Mr Costello said that when nuclear power generation becomes economically viable, Australia should pursue its use.

text: “Si e bira komersial, nos mester tin esaki. Ku otro palabra, no tin en prinsipio opheshon kontra energia nuklear,” Sr. Costello a bisa.
eng_text: "If it becomes commercial, we should have it. That is, there's no in-principle objection to nuclear energy" Mr Costello said.

text: Segun Ansa, “polis tabata preokupá pa un par di gòlpi na nivel haltu ku nan tabatin miedu lo por a start un guera total di suseshon.
eng_text: According to Ansa, "police were concerned by a couple of top-level hits they feared might spark a full-blown war of succession.

text: Polis a bisa ku Lo Piccolo tabatin e bentaha pasobra e tabata Provenzano su man drechi na Palermo i su mayor eksperensia a laga e gana e rèspèt di e generashon mas bieu di e hefenan komo ku nan ta aspirá pa e maneho di Provenzano di keda mas trankilamente posibel miéntras ta fortifiká nan ret di poder.
eng_text: Police said Lo Piccolo had the upper hand because he had been Provenzano's right-hand man in Palermo and his greater experience won him the respect of the older generation of bosses as they pursued Provenzano's policy of keeping as low as possible while strengthening their power network.

text: Provenzano a tuma kontrol di e hefenan akí ora ku el a pone un fin na e guera kontra estado ku Riina tabata hiba ku a kosta bida di e koredornan di kampaña Mafia Giovanni Falconi i Paolo Borsellino na 1992.”
eng_text: These bosses had been reined in by Provenzano when he put an end to the Riina-driven war against the state that claimed the lives of Mafia crusaders Giovanni Falcone and Paolo Borsellino in 1992."

text: CEO di Apple Steve Jobs a desvelá e aparato ora e tabata kanando riba esenario i a saka e iPhone for di saku di su djins.
eng_text: Apple CEO Steve Jobs unveiled the device by walking onto the stage and taking the iPhone out of his jeans pocket.

text: Durante su diskurso di 2 ora el a deklará ku “Awe Apple ta bai inventá telefòn di nobo. Nos ta bai skirbi historia awe.”
eng_text: During his 2 hour speech he stated that "Today Apple is going to reinvent the phone, We are going to make history today".

text: Brasil ta e pais Katóliko Romano mas grandi na Mundu, i Iglesia Katóliko Romano konsistentemente a oponé kontra legalisashon di matrimonio di mesun sekso den e pais.
eng_text: Brazil is the largest Roman Catholic country on Earth, and the Roman Catholic Church has consistently opposed the legalization of same-sex marriage in the country.

text: E Kongreso Nashonal di Brasil, a debatí legalisashon pa 10 aña, i e tipo di matrimonionan sivil akí aktualmente ta solamente legal na Rio Grande do Sul.
eng_text: The National Congress of Brazil has debated legalization for 10 years, and such civil marriages are currently only legal in Rio Grande do Sul.

text: E lei original tabata konsipiá pa e anterior alkalde di São Paulo, Marta Suplicy. E legislashon proponé, despues ku a amendá esaki, awor ta den man di Roberto Jefferson.
eng_text: The original bill was drafted by former mayor of São Paulo, Marta Suplicy. The proposed legislation, after being amended, is now in the hands of Roberto Jefferson.

text: Manifestantenan ta spera di kolektá un petishon ku 1,2 mion firma pa presentá na Kongreso Nashonal na novèmber.
eng_text: Protesters hope to collect a petition of 1.2 million signatures to present to the National Congress in November.

text: Despues ku a bini na klaridat ku hopi famia tabata buska ayudo legal pa kombatí e sakamentu for di kas, a tene un reunion riba 20 di mart na East Bay Community Law Center pa e víktimanan di e estafa di bibienda.
eng_text: After it became apparent that many families were seeking legal help to fight the evictions, a meeting was held on March 20 at the East Bay Community Law Center for the victims of the housing scam.

text: Ora ku e hürdónan a kuminsá kompartí loke a pasa ku nan, mayoria di e famianan enbolbí di repente a realisá ku Carolyn Wilson di OHA a hòrta nan depósitonan di seguridat, i a baha na katuna for di e siudat.
eng_text: When the tenants started sharing what had occurred to them, most of the families involved suddenly realized that Carolyn Wilson of the OHA had stolen their security deposits, and skipped out of town.

text: Hürdónan na Lockwood Gardens ta kere ku lo por tin manera 40 otro famia òf mas ku ta enfrentando sakamentu di kas, awor ku nan a haña sa ku polis di OHA ta hasiendo investigashon di otro propiedat di kas di gobièrnu na Oakland ku por ta enbolbí den e estafa di bibienda.
eng_text: Tenants at Lockwood Gardens believe that there may be another 40 families or more to face eviction, since they learned that OHA police are also investigating other public housing properties in Oakland that may be caught up in the housing scam.

text: E banda a kanselá e show na Maui su War Memorial Stadium, ku tabata spera asistensia di 9.000 persona, i a pidi un diskulpa na e fanátikonan.
eng_text: The band canceled the show at Maui's War Memorial Stadium, which was set to be attended by 9,000 people, and apologized to fans.

text: E kompania di maneho di e banda, HK Management Inc., no a duna un motibu inisial dikon a kanselá pa 20 di sèptèmber, pero a kulpa motibunan di logístika riba e siguiente dia.
eng_text: The band's management company, HK Management Inc., gave no initial reason when they canceled on September 20, but blamed logistical reasons by the next day.

text: E famoso abogadonan griego, Sakis Kechagioglou i George Nikolakopoulos a keda enkarselá na Athenas su prisòn Korydallus, komo ku a sentensiá nan kulpabel di soborno i korupshon.
eng_text: The famous Greek lawyers, Sakis Kechagioglou and George Nikolakopoulos have been imprisoned in the Athens' jail of Korydallus, as they were found guilty of graft and corruption.

text: Komo resultado di esaki, a krea un skandal grandi denter di e komunidat legal griego dor di eksponé aktonan ilegal ku huesnan, huristanan, prokuradornan i abogadonan a kometé durante di e añanan anterior.
eng_text: As a result of this, a big scandal within the Greek legal community has been raised through the exposure of illegal actions that judges, lawyers, solicitors and attorneys have done during the previous years.

text: Algun siman pasa, despues di e informashon publiká pa e periodista Makis Triantafylopoulos den su programa popular na televishon “Zoungla” na Alpha TV, e miembro di parlamento i abogado, Petros Mantouvalos a keda apdiká komo ku miembronan di su ofisina tabata embolbí den soborno ilegal i korupshon.
eng_text: A few weeks ago, after the information published by the journalist Makis Triantafylopoulos in his popular Television show "Zoungla" in Alpha TV, the member of Parliament and lawyer, Petros Mantouvalos was abdicated as members of his office had been involved in illegal graft and corruption.

text: Ademas, tòp hues Evangelos Kalousis ta enkarselá komo ku a sentensi’é pa korupshon i kondukta degenerá.
eng_text: Moreover, top judge Evangelos Kalousis is imprisoned as he found guilty of corruption and degenerate behaviour.

text: Roberts a ninga redondamente di bisa ki ora e ta kere bida ta kuminsá, esaki ta un pregunta importante ora ta konsiderá e étika di aborto, bisando ku lo no ta étiko pa duna komentario tokante detayenan di kasonan probabel.
eng_text: Roberts flatly refused to say about when he believes life begins, an important question when considering the ethics of abortion, saying that it would be unethical to comment on the specifics of likely cases.

text: Sinembargo, el a reiterá su deklarashon anterior ku Roe v. Wade tabata e “lei establesé di e pais“, enfatisando e importansia di e konsistensia di e sentensianan di Korte Supremo.
eng_text: He did, however, reiterate his earlier statement that Roe v. Wade was the "settled law of the land", emphasizing the importance of consistent Supreme Court rulings.

text: El a konfirmá tambe ku e ta kere den e implikashon di e derecho di privasidat ku e desishon di Roe tabata dependé di dje.
eng_text: He also confirmed that he believed in the implied right to privacy which the Roe decision depended upon.

text: Maroochydore a finalisá na kabes di e tabla di posishon, ku total seis punto mas ku Noosa na di dos lugá.
eng_text: Maroochydore had finished on top of the ladder, six points clear of Noosa in second.

text: E dos atversarionan lo a topa otro den un semi final mayor unda Noosa a kore bira ganadó ku 11 punto.
eng_text: The two sides would meet in the major semi final where Noosa ran out winners by 11 points.

text: Maroochydore despues a derotá Caboolture den e Final Preliminar.
eng_text: Maroochydore then defeated Caboolture in the Preliminary Final.

text: Hesperonychus elizabethae ta un espesie di e famia Dromaeosauridae i ta un primu di e Velociraptor.
eng_text: Hesperonychus elizabethae is a species of the family Dromaeosauridae and is a cousin of Velociraptor .

text: Ta kere ku e para yagdó akí tur na pluma i ku sanger kayente a kana stret riba dos pata ku garanan meskos ku e Velociraptor.
eng_text: This fully feathered, warm blooded bird of prey was believed to have walked upright on two legs with claws like the Velociraptor.

text: Su di dos gara tabata mas grandi, ku a resultá den e nòmber di Hesperonychus ku ta nifiká “garanan di wèst.”
eng_text: Its second claw was larger, giving rise to the name Hesperonychus which means "western claw."

text: Ademas di e eis devastador, kondishonnan ekstremo di wer a opstakulisá e esfuersonan di reskate.
eng_text: In addition to the crushing ice, extreme weather conditions have been hampering rescue efforts.

text: Pittman a sugerí ku e kondishonnan lo no mehorá te den kurso di otro siman.
eng_text: Pittman suggested that conditions wouldn't improve until sometime next week.

text: E kantidat i e midí diki di e pakete di eis, segun Pittman, ta esun di mas malu pa e yagdónan di kachó di awa den e último 15 aña.
eng_text: The amount and thickness of the pack ice, according to Pittman, is the worst it has been for sealers in the past 15 years.

text: Durante ku e entiero a tuma luga di Jeff Weise i tres di e otro nuebe víktimanan, notisia a plama den e komunidat di Red Lake, ku a aresta un otro studiante en konekshon ku e tiramentu na skol riba 21 di mart.
eng_text: News spread in the Red Lake community today as funerals for Jeff Weise and three of the nine victims were held that another student was arrested in connection with the school shootings of March 21.

text: Autoridatnan a bisa ofisialmente poko mas ayá di solamente konfirmá e aresto di awe.
eng_text: Authorities said little officially beyond confirming today's arrest.

text: Sinembargo un fuente ku konosimentu di e investigashon a bisa Minneapolis Star-Tribune ku ta trata di Louis Jourdain, yu hòmber di 16 aña di e presidente di tribu Red Lake, Floyd Jourdain.
eng_text: However, a source with knowledge of the investigation told the Minneapolis Star-Tribune that it was Louis Jourdain, 16-year old son of Red Lake Tribal Chairman Floyd Jourdain.

text: No sa na e momentonan aki ki akusashon lo hasi of kiko a hiba e autoridatnan na e hoben, pero prosedimentunan di menor a kuminsa na e korte federal.

text: A informá ku e nubianan skur no ta relashoná ku e aktividatnan volkániko na e base di e seru.
eng_text: Dark clouds unrelated to any volcanic activity were reported at the base of the mountain.

text: E nubianan a trese poko konfushon si di berdad un erupshon a tuma lugá.
eng_text: The clouds presented the potential for confusion as to whether an actual eruption had taken place.

text: E Luno tabatin 120-160 meter kúbiko di kombustibel na bordo ora el a daña i bientu fuerte i ola a push’é den e kibraola.
eng_text: The Luno had 120–160 cubic metres of fuel aboard when it broke down and high winds and waves pushed it into the breakwater.

text: Helikòpter a reskatá e diesdos miembronan di tripulashon i e úniko leshon tabata un nanishi kibra.
eng_text: Helicopters rescued the twelve crewmembers and the only injury was a broken nose.

text: E barku di 100 meter tabata na kaminda pa piki su karga di fertilisante di kustumber i inisialmente ofishalnan tabatin miedu ku e barku por a plama un karga.
eng_text: The 100-metre ship was en route to pick up its usual fertiliser cargo and initially officials feared the vessel could spill a load.

text: E amienda proponé a pasa den tur dos kámara kaba na 2011.
eng_text: The proposed amendment already passed both houses in 2011.

text: Un kambio a wòrdu hasí durante e seshon legislativo aki, ora ku e di dos frase a wòrdu eliminá promé dor di House of Representatives (Kas di Diputadonan) i despues a wòrdu pasá den Senado den un manera similar djaluna.
eng_text: A change was made this legislative session when the second sentence was deleted first by the House of Representatives and then was passed in a similar form by the Senate Monday.

text: E fayo di e di dos frase, ku ta proponé pa eksiliá union sivil di sekso igual, posiblemente por habri porta pa union sivil den futuro.
eng_text: The failure of the second sentence, which proposes to ban same-sex civil unions, could possibly open the door for civil unions in the future.

text: Siguiendo e proseso, e próksimo poder legislativo elegí lo revisá HJR-3 atrobe, sea na 2015 òf 2016, pa keda den e proseso.
eng_text: Following the process, HJR-3 will be reviewed again by the next elected legislature in either 2015 or 2016 to remain in process.

text: Vautier su logronan pafó di dirigí ta inkluí un wèlga di hamber na 1973 kontra loke e tabata mira komo sensura polítiko.
eng_text: Vautier's achievements outside of directing include a hunger strike in 1973 against what he viewed as political censorship.

text: Lei franses a kambia. Su aktivismo a bai bèk siglo 15 ora el a drenta resistensia franses durante di dos guera mundial.
eng_text: French law was changed. His activism went back to age 15 when he joined the French Resistance during World War II.

text: El a dokumentá su mes den un buki di 1998.
eng_text: He documented himself in a 1998 book.

text: Na añanan ’60 di siglo pasá el a bai bèk pa Algeria resien independisá pa duna lès di dirigí sine.
eng_text: In the 1960s he headed back to newly-independent Algeria to teach film directing.

text: E yudoka hapones Hitoshi Saito, ganadó di dos medaya di oro Olímpiko, a fayesé na edat di 54 aña.
eng_text: Japanese judoka Hitoshi Saito, winner of two Olympic gold medals, has died at the age of 54.

text: A anunsiá ku e kousa di morto tabata kanser intrahepátiko di tubu di hal.
eng_text: The cause of death was announced as intrahepatic bile duct cancer.

text: El a muri djamars na Osaka.
eng_text: He died in Osaka on Tuesday.

text: Banda di tabata un kampion Olímpiko i Mundial, Saito tambe tabata e presidente di e komishon di treinen di All Japan Judo Federation (Federashon di Yudo di henter Hapon) na e tempu di su morto.
eng_text: As well as a former Olympic and World champion, Saito was the All Japan Judo Federation training committee chairman at the time of his death.

text: Por lo ménos 100 hende a partisipá na e fiesta, pa selebrá e promé aniversario di un pareha ku a tene nan kasamentu aña pasá.
eng_text: At least 100 people had attended the party, in order to celebrate the first anniversary of a couple whose wedding was held last year.

text: A planea un evento di aniversario formal pa un fecha mas lat, ofisialnan a bisa.
eng_text: A formal anniversary event was scheduled for a later date, officials said.

text: E pareha a kasa na Texas un aña pasá i a bini Buffalo pa selebrá ku amigu i famia.
eng_text: The couple had married in Texas one year ago and came to Buffalo to celebrate with friends and relatives.

text: E esposo di 30 aña di edat, ku a nase na Buffalo, tabata un di e kuaternan ku a mata den e tiroteo, pero su kasá no tabata heridá.
eng_text: The 30-year-old husband, who was born in Buffalo, was one of the four killed in the shooting, but his wife was not hurt.

text: Karno ta un maestro di idioma ingles konosí pero kontroversial ku a duna lès na Modern Education (Edukashon Moderno) i King’s Glory (Gloria di Rei) ku ta bisa ku e tabatin 9.000 studiante na kumbre di su karera.
eng_text: Karno is a well-known but controversial English tutor who taught under Modern Education and King's Glory who claimed to have 9,000 students at the peak of his career.

text: Den su anotashonnan e ta usa palabra ku tin mayor tabata haña brutu, i tin bisá ku e tabata papia palabra malu den klas.
eng_text: In his notes he used words which some parents considered coarse, and he reportedly used profanity in class.

text: Modern Education (Edukashon Moderno) a akus’é di imprimí propaganda grandi pa den bùs sin outorisashon i di gaña bisando ku e tabata e maestro hefe di idioma ingles.
eng_text: Modern Education accused him of printing large advertisements on buses without authorisation and lying by saying that he was the chief English tutor.

text: Tambe a akus’é anteriormente di violashon di copyright, pero no a kastig’é.
eng_text: He has also been accused previously of copyright infringement, but was not charged.

text: Un studiante anterior di dje a bisa ku e tabata ‘usa idioma popular den klas, den anotashon e tabata siña na kon pa date, i e tabata manera un amigu di e studiantenan.’
eng_text: A former student said that he 'used slang in class, taught dating skills in notes, and was just like the students' friend.'

text: Durante e último tres dékadanan, no opstante ku ofishalmente nan a keda un estado komunista, China a desaroyá un ekonomia di merkado.
eng_text: During the last three decades, despite officially remaining a communist state, China has developed a market economy.

text: E promé reformanan ekonómiko a hasi bou di liderasgo di Deng Xiaoping.
eng_text: The first economic reforms were made under the leadership of Deng Xiaoping.

text: For di e tempu ei, China su tamaño ekonómiko a krese 90 bia.
eng_text: Since then, China's economic size has grown by 90 times.

text: Pa promé bia, aña pasá China a eksportá mas outo ku Alemania i a surpasá Estádos Unídos komo e merkado di mas grandi pa e industria aki.
eng_text: For the first time, last year China exported more cars than Germany and surpassed the United States as the biggest market for this industry.

text: China su PIB por ta mas grandi ku Estádos Unídos denter di dos dékada.
eng_text: China's GDP could be larger than the United States within two decades.

text: Tempestat tropikal Danielle, e di kuater tempestat ku a duna nòmber di e temporada di orkan atlántiko na 2010, a forma den ost di Oséano Atlántiko.
eng_text: Tropical Storm Danielle, fourth named storm of the 2010 Atlantic hurricane season, has formed in the eastern Atlantic Ocean.

text: E tempestat, lokalisá aproksimadamente 3.000 mia di Miami, Florida, tin bientu kontinuo di un máksimo di 40 mia pa ora (64 kilometer pa ora).
eng_text: The storm, located approximately 3,000 miles from Miami, Florida, has maximum sustained winds of 40 mph (64 kph).

text: Sientífikonan na e National Hurricane Center (Sentro Nashonal di Orkan) ta pronostiká ku Danielle lo kue forsa di un orkan pa djárason.
eng_text: Scientists at the National Hurricane Center predict that Danielle will strengthen to a hurricane by Wednesday.

text: Komo ku e tempestat ta leu for di tera, ta keda difísil pa kalkulá e impakto potensial pa Estádos Unídos òf e Área Karibense.
eng_text: As the storm is far from landfall, it remains difficult to assess potential impact to the United States or Caribbean.

text: Nasé na e kapital di Kroasia, Zagreb, Bobek a kue fama hungando pa Partizan Belgrade.
eng_text: Born in the Croatian capital, Zagreb, Bobek gained fame while playing for Partizan Belgrade.

text: El a djòin nan na 1945 i a keda te 1958.
eng_text: He joined them in 1945 and stayed until 1958.

text: Durante su tempu ku e tim el a skor 403 gol den 468 aparishon.
eng_text: During his time with the team, he scored 403 goals in 468 appearances.

text: Niun otro hende nunka mas no a aparesé mas tantu bia òf hinka mas tantu gol pa e klup ku Bobek.
eng_text: No one else has ever made more appearances or scored more goals for the club than Bobek.

text: Na 1995 a eligié komo e mihó hungadó den e historia di Partizan.
eng_text: In 1995 he was voted the best player in Partizan's history.

text: E selebrashonnan a kuminsá ku un show spesial di e grupo mundialmente famoso Cirque du Soleil.
eng_text: The celebrations started with a special show by the world-renowned group Cirque du Soleil.

text: Despues a sigui e Istanbul State Symphony Orchestra, un banda di Janissar, i e kantantenan Fatih Erkoç i Müslüm Gürses.
eng_text: It was followed by the Istanbul State Symphony Orchestra, a Janissary band, and the singers Fatih Erkoç and Müslüm Gürses.

text: Djei Whirling Dervishes a tuma e podio pa nan.
eng_text: Then Whirling Dervishes took to the stage.

text: E diva di Turkia Sezen Aksu a kanta ku e tenor italiano Alessandro Safina i e kantante griego Haris Alexiou.
eng_text: Turkish diva Sezen Aksu performed with the Italian tenor Alessandro Safina and Greek singer Haris Alexiou.

text: Pa finalisá, e grupo di baile turko Fire of Anatolia a presentá e show “Troy”.
eng_text: To finish, Turkish dance group Fire of Anatolia performed the show "Troy".

text: Peter Lenz, un koredó di kareda di motersaikel di 13 aña di edat, a fayesé despues ku e tabata envolví den un choke na Indianapolis Motor Speedway.
eng_text: Peter Lenz, a 13-year-old motorcycle racer, has died after being involved in a crash at the Indianapolis Motor Speedway.

text: Ora di hasi su ròndu di warm-up, Lenz a kai for di su baiskel, i su kompañero den e kareda Xavier Zayat a dal den dje.
eng_text: While on his warm-up lap, Lenz fell off his bike, and was then struck by fellow racer Xavier Zayat.

text: Mésora e personal médiko riba e pista a atendé kuné i a hib’é un hòspital lokal kaminda el a fayesé despues.
eng_text: He was immediately attended to by the on-track medical staff and transported to a local hospital where he later died.

text: Zayat no a haña leshon den e aksidente.
eng_text: Zayat was unhurt in the accident.

text: Mirando e situashon finansiero global, Zapatero a kontinuá bisando ku “e sistema finansiero ta parti di e ekonomia, un parti krusial.
eng_text: Regarding the global financial situation, Zapatero continued by saying that "the financial system is a part of the economy, a crucial part.

text: Nos tin un krísis finansiero di añanan largu, ku tabatin su momento di mas agudo den e dos lunanan ku a pasa, i mi ta kere ku awor e merkadonan finansiero a kuminsá rekuperá.”
eng_text: We have a year-long financial crisis, which has had its most acute moment in the past two months, and I think now the financial markets are beginning to recover."

text: Siman pasá, Naked News a anunsiá ku e lo oumentá su mandato internashonal di idioma dramátikamente pa reportahe di notisia, ku tres transmishon nobo.
eng_text: Last week, Naked News announced that it would dramatically increase its international language mandate to news reporting, with three new broadcasts.

text: Reportando kaba na ingles i hapones, e organisashon mundial ta lansando programa na idioma spañó, italiano, i koreano, pa televishon, web, i aparato mobil.
eng_text: Already reporting in English and Japanese, the global organization is launching Spanish, Italian, and Korean-language programs, for television, the web, and mobile devices.

text: Afortunadamente nada no a pasa ku mi, pero mi a mira un esena makabro, ora ku hende tabata purba di kibra bentana pa nan sali.
eng_text: "Luckily nothing happened to me, but I saw a macabre scene, as people tried to break windows in order to get out.

text: Hende tabata bati e rampinan di glas ku stul, pero e bentananan no por a kibra.
eng_text: People were hitting the panes with chairs, but the windows were unbreakable.

text: “Un di e rampinan a kibra finalmente, i nan a kuminsá sali pafó via e bentana”, e sobrebibiente Franciszek Kowal a bisa.
eng_text: One of the panes finally broke, and they started to get out by the window," said survivor Franciszek Kowal.

text: Strea ta duna lus i kalor pa motibu di e energia trahá ora atom di hidrógeno mara (òf pega) na otro pa forma elemento mas pisá.
eng_text: Stars give off light and heat because of the energy made when hydrogen atoms are merged (or fused) together to form heavier elements.

text: Sientífiko ta traha pa krea un reaktor ku por traha energia na e mes manera.
eng_text: Scientists are working to create a reactor that can make energy in the same way.

text: Esaki sinembargo ta un problema masha difísil pa solushoná i lo dura hopi aña promé ku nos mira konstrukshon di reaktor di fushon ku ta sirbi.
eng_text: This, however, is a very hard problem to solve and will take many years before we see useful fusion reactors built.

text: E angua di stal ta drif riba e awa pa motibu di e tenshon di e superfisie.
eng_text: The steel needle floats on top of the water because of surface tension.

text: Tenshon di superfisio ta okurí pasobra molekül di awa na e superfisio di e awa ta atraé otro mas ku nan ta atraé e molekülnan di e airu riba nan.
eng_text: Surface tension happens because the water molecules at the surface of the water are strongly attracted to each other more than they are to the air molecules above them.

text: E molekülnan di awa ta forma un kueru invisibel riba superfisio di e awa ku ta laga kos manera e angua drif riba e awa.
eng_text: The water molecules make an invisible skin on the water’s surface that allows things like the needle to float on top of the water.

text: E blat di un skats di eis moderno tin un rant dòbel ku un hòl mei mei. E dos rantnan ta pèrkurá pa e skats wanta mihó riba eis, asta si e ta lèn un banda.
eng_text: The blade on a modern ice skate has a double edge with a concave hollow between them. The two edges allow for a better grasp of the ice, even when tilted.

text: Pasobra e abou di e blat ta un tiki kurvá, si e blat lèn di un banda pa otro, e rant ku ta den kontakto ku e eis tambe ta kurvá.
eng_text: Because the bottom of the blade is slightly curved, as the blade tilts to one side or the other, the edge which is in contact with the ice also curves.

text: Esaki ta pone ku e koredó di skats por bira. Si e skatsnan lèn pa man drechi, e koredó di skats ta bira pa man drechi, si e skatsnan lèn pa man robes, e koredó di skats ta bira pa man robes.
eng_text: This causes the skater to turn. If the skates tilt to the right, the skater turns right, if the skates tilt to the left, the skater turns left.

text: Pa bai bèk pa nan nivel di energia anterior, nan mester deshasí di e energia èkstra ku nan a haña di e lus.
eng_text: To return to their previous energy level, they must get rid of the extra energy they got from the light.

text: Nan ta hasi esaki sakando un partíkulo masha chikí di lus yama “fótòn”.
eng_text: They do this by emitting a tiny particle of light called a "photon".

text: Sientífikonan ta yama e proseso aki “emishon stimulá di radiashon” pasobra e atomnan ta stimulá pa e lus skèrpi, ku ta kousa e emishon di un fótòn di lus, i lus ta un tipo di radiashon.
eng_text: Scientists call this process "stimulated emission of radiation" because the atoms are stimulated by the bright light, causing the emission of a photon of light, and light is a type of radiation.

text: E siguiente potrèt ta mustra e atomnan sakando fótòn. Naturalmente den realidat fótòn ta hopi mas chikí ku esnan den e potrèt.
eng_text: The next picture shows the atoms emitting photons. Of course, in reality photons are a lot smaller than those in the picture.

text: Fótòn ta asta mas chikí ku e material ku atom ta konsistí di dje!
eng_text: Photons are even smaller than the stuff that makes up atoms!

text: Despues di sentenar di ora di traha e waya ku ta lumbra den e pera di lus na final ta kima i e pera di lus no ta traha mas.
eng_text: After hundreds of hours of operation the filament in the bulb eventually burns out and the light bulb no longer works.

text: E ora ei mester remplasá e pera di lus. Ta nesesario pa tene kuidou ora remplasá e pera di lus.
eng_text: The light bulb then needs replacing. It is necessary to be careful in replacing the light bulb.

text: Promé, mester paga e suich ku ta sende e lus òf deskonektá e waya.
eng_text: First, the switch for the light fixture needs to be turned off or the cable disconnected.

text: Esaki ta pasobra koriente ku ta bai e plùk kaminda e parti metáliko di e pera ta sinta por duna bo un shòk di koriente severo si bo mishi ku e paden di e plùk òf e base di metal di e pera miéntras ku e ta parsialmente den e plùk ainda.
eng_text: This is because electricity flowing into the socket where the metallic part of bulb sits can give you a severe electric shock if you touch the inside of the socket or the metal base of the bulb while it is still partly in the socket.

text: E órgano prinsipal di e sistema di sirkulashon ta e kurason, ku ta pòmp sanger.
eng_text: The major organ of the circulatory system is the heart, which pumps the blood.

text: Sanger ta bai for di e kurason den tubu yamá arteria i ta bini bèk den tubu yamá ader. E adernan di mas chikí yama vaso kapiar.
eng_text: Blood goes away from the heart in tubes called arteries and comes back to the heart in tubes called veins. The smallest tubes are called capillaries.

text: Djente di un ‘triceratops’ lo por a mula no solamente blachi pero tambe rama i rais hopi duru.
eng_text: A triceratops' teeth would have been able to crush not only leaves but even very tough branches and roots.

text: Tin sientífiko ku ta pensa ku Triceratops tabata kome ‘cycad’, ku ta un sorto di mata ku tabata komun den ‘Cretaceous’.
eng_text: Some scientists think Triceratops ate cycads, which are a type of plant that was common in the Cretaceous.

text: E matanan akí ta parse palma chikitu ku un korona di blachi skèrpi, ku spiña.
eng_text: These plants look like a small palm tree with a crown of sharp, spiky leaves.

text: Un Triceratops lo por a usa su boka fuerte pa ranka e blachinan for di e mata promé di a kome e tronko.
eng_text: A Triceratops could have used its strong beak to strip off the leaves before eating the trunk.

text: Otro sientífikonan ta komentá ku e matanan akí ta bastante venenoso pues lo no por ta posibel ku kualke dinosouro a kome nan, maske ku ta asina ku awendia léart i otro animalnan manera lora (un desendiente di dinosouro) por kome blachi òf fruta venenoso.
eng_text: Other scientists argue that these plants are very poisonous so it is unlikely that any dinosaur ate them, even though today the sloth and other animals like the parrot (a descendant of the dinosaurs) can eat poisonous leaves or fruit.

text: Kon Io su gravedat lo ranka na mi? Si bo tabata para riba superfisie di Io, bo lo tabata pisa ménos ku si bo ta pisa na mundu.
eng_text: How would Io's gravity pull on me? If you stood on the surface of Io, you would weigh less than you do on Earth.

text: Un persona kende ta pisa 200 liber (90 kg) riba Mundu lo pisa alrededor di 36 liber (16 kg) riba Io. Pues e gravedat naturalmente, ta ranka ménos na bo.
eng_text: A person who weighs 200 pounds (90kg) on Earth would weigh about 36 pounds (16kg) on Io. So the gravity, of course, pulls less on you.

text: Solo no tin un kaska manera Mundu ku bo por para ariba. Solo kompleto ta trahá di gasnan, kandela, i plasma.
eng_text: The Sun doesn't have a crust like the Earth that you can stand on. The whole Sun is made out of gases, fire, and plasma.

text: E gas ta bira mas fini segun bo ta bai mas leu for di e sentro di Solo.
eng_text: The gas becomes thinner as you go farther from the center of the Sun.

text: E parti eksterno ku nos ta mira ora nos wak Solo ta yama photosphere, loke ta nifiká “bala di lus”.
eng_text: The outer-part we see when we look at the Sun is called the photosphere, which means "ball of light".

text: Mas òf ménos tres mil aña despues, na 1610, e astrónomo italiano Galileo Galilei, a hasi uso di un teleskop pa opservá ku Venus tin fase, nèt manera luna tin.
eng_text: About three thousand years later, in 1610, Italian astronomer Galileo Galilei used a telescope to observe that Venus has phases, just as the moon does.

text: Fase ta tuma lugá pasobra solamente e banda di Venus (òf di Luna) ku ta ku kara pa Solo ta iluminá. E fasenan di Venus tabata sostené e teoria di Copernicus ku e planetanan ta drai rònt di Solo.
eng_text: Phases happen because only the side of Venus (or of the Moon) facing the Sun is lighted. The phases of Venus supported the theory of Copernicus that the planets go around the Sun.

text: Seguidamente, algun aña despues na 1639, un astrónomo ingles ku tabata yama Jeremiah Horrocks a opservá un transishon di Venus.
eng_text: Then, a few years later in 1639, an English astronomer named Jeremiah Horrocks observed a transit of Venus.

text: Inglatera a eksperensiá un temporada largu di pas despues di e rekonkista di e Danelaw.
eng_text: England had experienced a long period of peace after the reconquest of the Danelaw.

text: Sinembargo na 991 Ethelred a hañ’é ku un flota vikingo mas grandi ku tur for di esun di Guthrum un siglo anterior.
eng_text: However in 991 Ethelred was faced with a Viking fleet larger than any since Guthrum's a century earlier.

text: Olaf Trygvasson, un noruego ku ambishon pa gana su pais bèk for di e dominashon danes, a dirigí e flota.
eng_text: This fleet was led by Olaf Trygvasson, a Norwegian with ambitions to reclaim his country from Danish domination.

text: Despues di kontratempu militar inisial, Ethelred por a bai di akuerdo ku Olaf, ku a bolbe bèk pa Noruega pa trata di gana su reino bèk ku éksito miksto.
eng_text: After initial military setbacks, Ethelred was able to agree to terms with Olaf, who returned to Norway to try to gain his kingdom with mixed success.

text: Hangeul ta e úniko álfabèt inventá ku e meta pa uso popular i diario. A inventá e álfabèt na aña 1444 durante e reinado di Rei Sejong (1418 – 1450).
eng_text: Hangeul is the only purposely invented alphabet in popular daily use. The alphabet was invented in 1444 during the reign of King Sejong (1418 – 1450).

text: Rei Sejong tabata e di kuater rei di e Dinastia Joseon i ta unu di esunnan mas tantu respetá.
eng_text: King Sejong was the fourth king of the Joseon Dynasty and is one of the most highly regarded.

text: Originalmente el a yama e Hangeul álfabèt Hummin Jeongeum, loke ta nifiká “e zonidonan korekto pa instrukshon di pueblo”.
eng_text: He originally named the Hangeul alphabet Hunmin Jeongeum, which means "the correct sounds for the instruction of the people".

text: Tin hopi teoria tokante kon sanskrit a bini na eksistensia. Un di nan ta tokante un migrashon Aryan ku a drenta India for di wèst ku a bini ku nan idioma huntu ku nan.
eng_text: There are many theories to how Sanskrit came into existence. One of them is about an Aryan migration from the west into India who brought their language with them.

text: Sanskrit ta un idioma antiguo i ta komparabel ku e idioma latin ku a papia na Oropa.
eng_text: Sanskrit is an ancient language and is comparable to the Latin language spoken in Europe.

text: E buki mas promé ku ta konosí na mundu tabata skirbí na sanskrit. Despues di e kompilashon di Upanishads, sanskrit a disparsé dor di herarkia.
eng_text: The earliest known book in the world was written in Sanskrit. After the compilation of Upanishads, Sanskrit just faded due to hierarchy.

text: Sanskrit ta un idioma hopi kompliká i riku, ku a sirbi di ta e fuente pa hopi idioma indio moderno, netamente manera latin ta e fuente pa idiomanan oropeo manera franses i spañó.
eng_text: Sanskrit is a very complex and rich language, which has served to be the source for many modern Indian languages, just like Latin is the source for European languages like French and Spanish.

text: Ora ku e bataya kontra Fransia tabata kla, Alemania a kuminsá prepará pa invadí e isla di Bretaña.
eng_text: With the battle for France over, Germany began to get ready to invade the island of Britain.

text: Alemania a duna e atake e nòmber kódigo “Operation Sealion”. Mayoria di e armanan pisá i e suministro di material di e ehérsito britániko a bai pèrdí ora ku e mester a evakuá di Duinkerken, pues e ehérsito tabata bastante suak.
eng_text: Germany code-named the attack “Operation Sealion”. Most of the British Army's heavy weapons and supplies had been lost when it evacuated from Dunkirk, so the army was fairly weak.

text: Pero ainda Royal Navy tabata muchu mas fuerte ku German Navy (“Kriegsmarine”) i lo por a destruí kualke marina di guera pa invashon ku bin krusa English Channel.
eng_text: But the Royal Navy was still much stronger than the German Navy (“Kriegsmarine”) and could have destroyed any invasion fleet sent across the English Channel.

text: Sinembargo, masha tiki barku di Royal Navy tabata stashoná serka di e posibel rutanan di invashon komo ku e atmiralnan tabatin miedu ku atake di aire aleman por a senk nan.
eng_text: However, very few Royal Navy ships were based near the likely invasion routes as the admirals were afraid they would be sunk by German air attack.

text: Laga nos kuminsá ku un splikashon di e plannan di Italia. Italia tabata prinsipalmente e “ruman hòmber chikí” di Alemania i Hapon.
eng_text: Let's start with an explanation about Italy's plans. Italy was mainly the "little brother" of Germany and Japan.

text: E tabatin un ehérsito i un marina mas débil, maske ku nan a kaba di konstruí kuater nave nobo nèt promé ku inisio di e guera.
eng_text: It had a weaker army and a weaker navy, although they had just built four new ships right before the beginning of the war.

text: Italia su metanan mayor tabata paisnan afrikano. Pa por kapturá e paisnan akí, nan lo mester tin un via pa lansa trupa, di manera ku e trupanan por nabegá krusa Laman Mediteráneo i invadí Afrika.
eng_text: Italy's main goals were African countries. To capture those countries, they would need to have a troop launching pad, so as troops could sail across the Mediterranean Sea and invade Africa.

text: Pa esaki, nan mester a deshasí di e basenan i barkunan britániko na Egipto. Banda di e akshonnan akí, no tabata spera ku e barkunan di guera di Italia lo tabatin nada otro di hasi.
eng_text: For that, they had to get rid of British bases and ships in Egypt. Besides those actions, Italy's battleships were not supposed to do anything else.

text: Pa loke ta trata Hapon awor, Hapon tabata un nashon di isla, nèt meskos ku Bretaña.
eng_text: Now for Japan. Japan was an island country, just like Britain.

text: Supmarinonan ta barkunan ku ta diseñá pa nabegá bou di awa, i keda ei pa un temporada largu.
eng_text: Submarines are ships designed to travel underwater, and remain there for an extended amount of time.

text: Supmarinonan tabata wòrdu usá den Guera Mundial l i Guera Mundial ll. E tempu ei nan tabata hopi pokopoko i nan tabatin un alkanse di tiru hopi limitá.
eng_text: Submarines were used in World War I and World War II. Back then they were very slow and had a very limited shooting range.

text: Den kuminsamentu di e guera nan tabata nabegá mayoria biaha na superfisie di laman, pero segun radar a kuminsá desaroyá i tabata bira mas presis e supmarinonan tabata wòrdu obligá pa bai bou di awa pa evitá ku por a mira nan.
eng_text: In the beginning of the war they mostly travelled on top of the sea, but as radar began developing and becoming more accurate the submarines were forced to go under water to avoid being seen.

text: E supmarinonan aleman tabata wòrdu yamá U-Boat. E alemannan tabata hopi bon den nabegá i manehá nan supmarinonan.
eng_text: German submarines were called U-Boats. The Germans were very good at navigating and operating their submarines.

text: Dor di nan éksito ku supmarinonan, despues di guera e alemannan no tabata wòrdu konfia pa tin hopi di nan.
eng_text: Because of their success with submarines, after the war Germans aren't trusted to have many of them.

text: Sí! Rei Tutankhamun, tin biaha referí na dje komo “Rei Tut” òf “E Mucha Rei”, ta un di e reinan mas konosí di antiguo Egipto den tempu moderno.
eng_text: Yes! King Tutankhamun, sometimes referred to as "King Tut" or "The Boy King", is one of the most well known ancient Egyptian kings in modern times.

text: Ta interesante, e no tabata konsiderá masha importante den tempu antiguo i e no tabata registrá riba mayoria lista di reinan antiguo.
eng_text: Interestingly, he was not considered to be very important in ancient times and was not recorded on most ancient king lists.

text: Sinembargo, e deskubrimentu di su graf na 1922 a hasié un selebridat. Miéntras ku tabata hòrta kos for di hopi graf di pasado, e graf akí a keda virtualmente intakto.
eng_text: However, the discovery of his tomb in 1922 made him a celebrity. While many tombs of the past were robbed, this tomb was left virtually undisturbed.

text: Mayoria di e kosnan derá ku Tutankhamun, a wòrdu bon konservá, inkluso míles di artefakto trahá di metalnan presioso i piedranan raro.
eng_text: Most of the items buried with Tutankhamun have been well preserved, including thousands of artefacts made from precious metals and rare stones.

text: E invenshon di wilnan ku spak a hasi garoshinan militar di Asiria mas lihé, mas rápido, i mihó prepará pa kore mas duru ku sòldánan i otro garoshinan militar.
eng_text: The invention of spoke wheels made Assyrian chariots lighter, faster, and better prepared to outrun soldiers and other chariots.

text: Flechanan di nan kruisboognan mortal por penetrá e armadura di e sòldánan enemigu. Banda di 1000 B.C., e asirionan a introdusí e promé trupa riba kabai.
eng_text: Arrows from their deadly crossbows could penetrate the armor of rival soldiers. About 1000 B.C., the Assyrians introduced the first cavalry.

text: Un kabayeria ta un ehérsito ku ta bringa riba kabai. Sia no a wòrdu inventá ainda, pues e kabayeria asirio tabata bringa riba lomba sunú di nan kabainan.
eng_text: A cavalry is an army that fights on horseback. The saddle had not yet been invented, so the Assyrian cavalry fought on the bare backs of their horses.

text: Nos konosé hopi polítiko, sientífiko, i artista griego. Posiblemente e persona mas konosí di e kultura akí ta Homer, e legendario poeta siegu, kende a komponé dos obra maestro di literatura griego: e poemanan Iliad i Odyssey.
eng_text: We know many Greek politicians, scientists, and artists. Possibly the most known person of this culture is Homer, the legendary blind poet, who composed two masterpieces of Greek literature: the poems Iliad and Odyssey.

text: Sophocles i Aristophanes ainda ta dramaturgonan popular i nan obranan di teater ta konsiderá di ta entre e mihó obranan di literatura mundial.
eng_text: Sophocles and Aristophanes are still popular playwrights and their plays are considered to be among the greatest works of world literature.

text: Un otro famoso griego ta e matemátiko Pythagoras, mihó konosí pa su famoso fórmula tokante e relashon di e bandanan di triángulonan rektangular.
eng_text: Another famous Greek is a mathematician Pythagoras, mostly known for his famous theorem about relations of the sides of right triangles.

text: Tin kalkulashonnan variá di kuantu hende ta papia hindi. Tin kalkulá ku e ta entre e di dos ku e di kuater idioma mas papiá na mundu.
eng_text: There are varying estimates for how many people speak Hindi. It is estimated to be between the second and fourth most commonly spoken language in the world.

text: E sifra di ‘native speakers’ ta varia dependiendo di si ta konta dialektonan ku tin relashon estrecho ku otro òf nò.
eng_text: The number of native speakers varies depending on whether or not very closely related dialects are counted.

text: Kalkulashon ta di un rango di 340 mion pa 500 mion hende ku ta papia e idioma, i sigur 800 mion hende por komprondé e idioma.
eng_text: Estimates range from 340 million to 500 million speakers, and as many as 800 million people can understand the language.

text: Hindi i urdu ta similar den vokabulario pero diferente den skirbimentu; den kòmbersashon diario, hende ku ta papia tur dos idioma normalmente por komprondé otro.
eng_text: Hindi and Urdu are similar in vocabulary but different in script; in everyday conversations, speakers of both languages can usually understand each other.

text: Banda di siglo 15, parti nort di Estonia tabata bou di e influensia kultural grandi di Alemania.
eng_text: Around the 15th century, northern Estonia was under great cultural influence of Germany.

text: Algun bruder aleman tabata ke trese Dios mas serka di e hendenan nativo, asina nan a inventá e idioma literal di Estonia.
eng_text: Some German monks wanted to bring God closer to the native people, so they invented the Estonian literal language.

text: E tabata basá riba e álfabèt aleman i un lèter “Õ/õ” a wòrdu añadí.
eng_text: It was based on the German alphabet and one character "Õ/õ" was added.

text: Ora tempu a pasa, hopi palabra ku a fia di e dialekto aleman a pega. Esaki tabata e kuminsamentu di iluminashon.
eng_text: As time passed, many words that were borrowed from German coalesced. This was the beginning of enlightenment.

text: Tradishonalmente, e heredero di e trono lo bai direktamente den ehérsito despues di kaba skol.
eng_text: Traditionally, the heir to the throne would go straight into the military after finishing school.

text: Sinembargo, Charles a bai universidat na Trinity College, Cambridge unda el a studia Antropologia i Arkeologia, i despues Historia, hañando un 2:2 (un grado abou den segundo klase).
eng_text: However, Charles went to university at Trinity College, Cambridge where he studied Anthropology and Archaeology, and later History, earning a 2:2 (a lower second class degree).

text: Charles tabata e promé miembro di e famia Real britániko ku a haña un diploma di universidat.
eng_text: Charles was the first member of the British Royal Family to be awarded a degree.

text: Turkia Oropeo (parti ost di Thrace òf Rumelia na e península di Balkan) ta inkluí 3% di e pais.
eng_text: European Turkey (eastern Thrace or Rumelia in the Balkan peninsula) includes 3% of the country.

text: E teritorio di Turkia ta mas ku 1.600 kilometer (1.000 mia) largu i 800 km (500 mia) hanchu, ku un forma globalmente rektangular.
eng_text: The territory of Turkey is more than 1,600 kilometres (1,000 mi) long and 800 km (500 mi) wide, with a roughly rectangular shape.

text: Turkia su superfisie, inkluyendo lagonan, ta kubri 783.562 kilometer kuadrá (300.948 mia kuadrá), di kua 755.688 kilometer kuadrá (291.773 mia kuadrá) ta den sùit wèst di Asia i 23.764 kilometer kuadrá (9.174 mia kuadrá) den Oropa.
eng_text: Turkey's area, including lakes, occupies 783,562 square kilometres (300,948 sq mi), of which 755,688 square kilometres (291,773 sq mi) are in south west Asia and 23,764 square kilometres (9,174 sq mi) in Europe.

text: Turkia su superfisie ta hasié e di 37 pais mas grandi na mundu, i tin mas òf ménos e tamaño di Fransia metropolitano i Reino Uní kombiná.
eng_text: Turkey's area makes it the world's 37th-largest country, and is about the size of Metropolitan France and the United Kingdom combined.

text: Turkia ta rondoná pa laman na tres banda: Laman Egeo na banda wèst, Laman Pretu na banda nort i Laman Mediteráneo na banda sùit.
eng_text: Turkey is encircled by seas on three sides: the Aegean Sea to the west, the Black Sea to the north and the Mediterranean Sea to the south.

text: Luxemburg tin un historia largu pero su independensia ta data di 1839.
eng_text: Luxembourg has a long history but its independence dates from 1839.

text: Aktual partinan di Bèlgika tabata parti di Luxemburg den pasado pero a bira belga despues di e Revolushon Belga di 1830.
eng_text: Present-day parts of Belgium were part of Luxembourg in the past but became Belgian after the 1830s Belgian Revolution.

text: Luxemburg semper a purba di keda un pais neutral pero e tabata okupá den tantu Guera Mundial l i Guera Mundial ll pa Alemania.
eng_text: Luxembourg has always tried to remain a neutral country but it was occupied in both World War I and World War II by Germany.

text: Na 1957 Luxemburg a bira un miembro fundadó di e organisashon ku awendia ta konosí komo Union Oropeo.
eng_text: In 1957 Luxembourg became a founding member of the organization which is today known as the European Union.

text: Drukgyal Dzong ta un fòrti na ruina i monasterio budista den e parti mas ariba di e Paro District (na Phondey Village).
eng_text: The Drukgyal Dzong is a ruined fortress and Buddhist monastery in the upper part of the Paro District (in Phondey Village).

text: Tin bisá ku na 1649, Zhabdrung Ngawang Namgyel a krea e fòrti pa konmemorá su viktoria kontra e forsanan tibetano-mongoles.
eng_text: It is said that in 1649, Zhabdrung Ngawang Namgyel created the fortress to commemorate his victory against the Tibetan-Mongol forces.

text: Na 1951, un kandela a kousa ku solamente algun di e relíkianan di Drukgyal Dzong a keda intakto, manera e imágen di Zhabdrung Ngawang Namgyal.
eng_text: In 1951, a fire caused for only some of the relics of the Drukgyal Dzong to remain, such as the image of Zhabdrung Ngawang Namgyal.

text: Despues di e kandela, a preservá i protehá e fòrti, pa e keda komo un di Bhutan su atrakshonnan mas sensashonal.
eng_text: After the fire, the fortress was preserved and protected, remaining to be one of Bhutan's most sensational attractions.

text: Durante siglo 18 Cambodja a haña su mes primí entre dos bisiña poderoso, Tailandia i Vietnam.
eng_text: During the 18th century Cambodia found itself squeezed between two powerful neighbors, Thailand and Vietnam.

text: E tailandesnan a invadí Cambodja vários biaha den siglo 18 i na 1772 nan a destruí Phnom Phen.
eng_text: The Thais invaded Cambodia several times in the 18th century and in 1772 they destroyed Phnom Phen.

text: Den e último añanan di siglo 18 e vietnamitanan tambe a invadí Cambodja.
eng_text: In the last years of the 18th century the Vietnamese also invaded Cambodia.

text: Diesocho porshento di venezolano ta desempleá, i mayoria di esunnan ku tin empleo ta traha den e ekonomia informal.
eng_text: Eighteen percent of Venezuelans are unemployed, and most of those who are employed work in the informal economy.

text: Dos tersera parti di venezolano ku ta traha ta hasi esaki den e sektor di servisio, kasi un kuart ta traha den industria i un kinto parti ta traha den agrikultura.
eng_text: Two thirds of Venezuelans who work do so in the service sector, nearly a quarter work in industry and a fifth work in agriculture.

text: Un industria importante pa e venezolanonan ta zeta, di kua e pais ta un eksportadó neto, maske ta solamente un porshento ta traha den e industria di zeta.
eng_text: An important industry for Venezuelans is oil, where the country is a net exporter, even though only one percent work in the oil industry.

text: Trempan den e independensia di e nashon, ekspertisio di e hardin botániko di Singapore a yuda pa transformá e isla den un Garden City tropikal.
eng_text: Early in the nation's independence, Singapore Botanic Gardens' expertise helped to transform the island into a tropical Garden City.

text: Na 1981, a elegí Vanda Miss Joaquim, un orkidia híbrido, komo e flor nashonal di e nashon.
eng_text: In 1981, Vanda Miss Joaquim, an orchid hybrid, was chosen as the nation's national flower.

text: Tur aña banda di òktober kasi 1.5 mion di hèrbívor ta biaha pa e sabananan den parti sùit, krusando e riu Mara, for di serunan den parti nort pa e yobidanan.
eng_text: Every year around October nearly 1.5 million herbivores travel towards the southern plains, crossing the Mara River, from the northern hills for the rains.

text: I despues bai bek nort via wèst, un biaha mas krusando riu Mara, despues di yobida banda di aprel.
eng_text: And then back to the north through the west, once again crossing the Mara river, after the rains in around April.

text: E region Serengeti ta kontené e Parke Nashonal Serengeti, e Área di Konservashon Ngorongoro i Maswa Game Reserve na Tanzania i e parke nashonal Maasai Mara National Reserve na Kenya.
eng_text: The Serengeti region contains the Serengeti National Park, the Ngorongoro Conservation Area and Maswa Game Reserve in Tanzania and the Maasai Mara National Reserve in Kenya.

text: Siñando pa krea medionan interaktivo ta rekerí abilidat konvenshonal i tradishonal, i tambe hèrmèn ku a dominá den kursonan interaktivo (storyboarding, oudio i editá video, konta storia, etc.)
eng_text: Learning to create interactive media requires conventional and traditional skills, as well as tools mastered in interactive classes (storyboarding, audio and video editing, story telling, etc.)

text: Diseño interaktivo ta rekerí pa bo reevaluá bo kerensianan tokante produkshon di medionan i siña pensa den formanan no linear.
eng_text: Interactive design requires that you re-assess your assumptions about media production and learn to think in a non-linear ways.

text: Diseño interaktivo ta rekerí pa e komponentenan di un proyekto ta konektá ku otro, pero tambe pa nan tin sentido komo un entidat separá.
eng_text: Interactive design requires that components of a project connect to each other, but also make sense as a separate entity.

text: E desbentaha di zumlènsnan ta ku e kompleksidat fokal i e kantidat di elementonan di lèns nesesario pa por yega na un alkanse di distansianan fokal ta mas grandi ku den kaso di lènsnan fiho.
eng_text: The disadvantage of zoom lenses is that the focal complexity and number of lens elements required to achieve a range of focal lengths is much greater than for prime lenses.

text: Esaki ta birando un problema mas chikitu komo ku produktornan di lèns ta logrando un standart mas haltu den e produkshon di lèns.
eng_text: This is becoming less of an issue as lens manufacturers achieve higher standards in lens production.

text: Esaki a permití zumlènsnan pa produsí potrètnan di un kalidat komparabel ku esun ku lèns ku distansia fokal fiho ta logra.
eng_text: This has allowed zoom lenses to produce pictures of a quality comparable to that achieved by lenses with fixed focal length.

text: Un otro desbentaha di zumlènsnan ta ku e apertura máksimo (e velosidat) di e lèns ta generalmente mas abou.
eng_text: Another disadvantage of zoom lenses is that the maximum aperture (the speed) of the lens is usually lower.

text: Esaki ta hasi zumlènsnan barata difísil pa usa den kondishonnan ku tiki lus i sin flash.
eng_text: This makes inexpensive zoom lenses hard to use in low-light conditions without a flash.

text: Un di e problemanan di mas komun ora ta trata di konvertí un sine pa e fòrmat di DVD ta e ‘overscan’.
eng_text: One of the most common problems when trying to convert a movie to DVD format is the overscan.

text: Mayoria di televishonnan ta trahá na un manera pa ta na agrado di públiko general.
eng_text: Most televisions are made in a way to please the general public.

text: Pa e motibu ei tur kos ku bo mira na televishon tabatin e rant nan kitá, ariba, abou i na bandanan.
eng_text: For that reason, everything you see on the TV had the borders cut, top, bottom and sides.

text: A traha esaki pa sigurá ku e imágen ta kubri henter e pantaya. Ta yama esaki ‘overscan’.
eng_text: This is made to ensure that the image covers the whole screen. That is called overscan.

text: Desafortunadamente, ora bo traha un DVD, ta masha probabel ku e rantnan tambe lo wòrdu kòrtá, i si e vidio tin suptítulo muchu te abou, nan no ta sali kompletamente.
eng_text: Unfortunately, when you make a DVD, it's borders will most likely be cut too, and if the video had subtitles too close to the bottom, they won't be fully shown.

text: E kastel tradishonal medieval a inspirá pa hopi tempu e imaginashon, kreando imágen di weganan di kompetensha di hinka, bankete i kabayerosidat Arturiano.
eng_text: The traditional medieval castle has long inspired the imagination, conjuring up images of jousts, banquets and Arthurian chivalry.

text: Hasta ora ku bo ta pará meimei di ruinanan di mil aña bieu ta fásil pa bo mente sinti e zonidu i holó di batayanan di hopi tempu pasá, te kasi yega na oido di patanan riba piedra di kaminda i pa sinti e holó di miedu ku ta sali di e kuartunan di profos bou di tera.
eng_text: Even standing amidst thousand year-old ruins it is easy to bring to mind the sounds and smells of battles long gone, to almost hear the clatter of hooves on the cobbles and to smell the fear rising from the dungeon pits.

text: Pero nos imaginashon ta basá riba realidat? Pa kua motibu tabata traha kastel na promé lugá? Kon nan tabata diseñá i trahá?
eng_text: But is our imagination based on reality? Why were castles built in the first place? How were they designed and built?

text: Típiko pa e periodo, Kastel Kirby Muxloe ta mas bien un kas fortifiká ku un kastel real.
eng_text: Typical for the period, Kirby Muxloe Castle is more of a fortified house than a true castle.

text: Su bentananan grandi di glas i murayanan delegá lo no por a resistí un atake determiná pa un tempu largu.
eng_text: Its large glazed windows and thin walls would not have been able to resist a determined attack for long.

text: Na añanan 1480, ora ku su konstrukshon a kuminsá pa Lord Hastings, e pais tabata relativamente trankilo i defensa tabata solamente nesesario kontra gruponan chikitu di bandidu sakeadó ku tabata kana rònt.
eng_text: In the 1480s, when its construction was begun by Lord Hastings, the country was relatively peaceful and defense was only required against small bands of roving marauders.

text: E balansa di poder tabata un sistema den kua nashonnan oropeo tabata buska pa mantené e soberania nashonal di tur e estadonan oropeo.
eng_text: The balance of power was a system in which European nations sought to maintain the national sovereignty of all European states.

text: E konsepto tabata ku tur e nashonnan oropeo mester buska manera di evitá ku un nashon por bira poderoso, i pues gobièrnunan nashonal hopi biaha tabata kambia nan aliansanan pa por mantené e balansa.
eng_text: The concept was that all European nations had to seek to prevent one nation from becoming powerful, and thus national governments often changed their alliances in order to maintain the balance.

text: E Guera di e Suseshon Spañó a marka e promé guera ku e tópiko sentral tabata e balansa di poder.
eng_text: The War of Spanish Succession marked the first war whose central issue was the balance of power.

text: Esaki a marka un kambio importante, komo podernan oropeo lo no tin e preteksto mas di ta den guera religioso. Asina e Guera di Trinta Aña lo a bira e último guera katalogá komo un guera religioso.
eng_text: This marked an important change, as European powers would no longer have the pretext of being religious wars. Thus, the Thirty Years' War would be the last war to be labeled a religious war.

text: E tèmpel di Artemis na Ephesus a keda destruí na 21 di yüli, 356 BCE den un akto di sendementu na kandela kometé dor di Herostratus.
eng_text: The temple of Artemis at Ephesus was destroyed on July 21, 356 BCE in an act of arson committed by Herostratus.

text: Di akuerdo ku e historia, su motivashon tabata fama kueste loke kueste. E efesionan, rabiá, a anunsiá ku lo no graba e nòmber di Herostratus nunka mas.
eng_text: According to the story, his motivation was fame at any cost. The Ephesians, outraged, announced that Herostratus' name never be recorded.

text: E historiadó griego Strabo despues a nota e nòmber, loke ta pone ku nos sa di dje awe. E tèmpel tabata destruí riba e mesun anochi ku Alexander Grandi a nasé.
eng_text: The Greek historian Strabo later noted the name, which is how we know today. The temple was destroyed on the same night that Alexander the Great was born.

text: Alexander, komo rei, a ofresé di paga pa rekonstruí e tèmpel, pero su oferta a wòrdu rechasá. Despues ku Alexander a muri, e tèmpel a wòrdu rekonstruí na 323 BCE.
eng_text: Alexander, as king, offered to pay to rebuild the temple, but his offer was denied. Later, after Alexander died, the temple was rebuilt in 323 BCE.

text: Sigurá ku bo man ta mas relahá posibel miéntras ku bo ta primi tur e notnan korektamente – tambe purba di no hasi hopi moveshon straño ku bo dedenan.
eng_text: Make sure your hand is as relaxed as possible while still hitting all the notes correctly - also try not to make much extraneous motion with your fingers.

text: Di e manera akí, lo bo kansa bo mes mas tiki posibel. Kòrda no tin nesesidat di primi e teklanan ku hopi forsa pa èkstra volúmen manera riba piano.
eng_text: This way, you will tire yourself out as little as possible. Remember there's no need to hit the keys with a lot of force for extra volume like on the piano.

text: Riba akordeon, pa haña mas volúmen, bo ta usa e kashi di aire ku mas preshon òf velosidat.
eng_text: On the accordion, to get extra volume, you use the bellows with more pressure or speed.

text: Mistisismo ta e akto di yega na komunion ku, identidat ku, òf konsiensia intenshonal di e realidat apsoluto, divinidat, bèrdat spiritual, òf Dios.
eng_text: Mysticism is the pursuit of communion with, identity with, or conscious awareness of an ultimate reality, divinity, spiritual truth, or God.

text: E kreyente ta buska un eksperensia direkto, intuishon, òf di komprenshon di e realidat divino/e divinidat òf divinidatnan.
eng_text: The believer seeks a direct experience, intuition, or insight into divine reality/the deity or dieties.

text: Siguidornan ta persiguí sierto manera di biba, òf práktikanan ku tin e intenshon di alimentá e eksperensianan ei.
eng_text: Followers pursue certain ways of living, or practices that are intended to nurture those experiences.

text: Místisismo por keda distinguí for di otro forma di kerensia religioso i adorashon dor di su énfasis riba un eksperensia personal direkto di un estado úniko di konsiensia, espesialmente esunnan di karakter pasífiko, perspikas, dichoso, òf te hasta karakter ékstasis.
eng_text: Mysticism can be distinguished from other forms of religious belief and worship by its emphasis on the direct personal experience of a unique state of consciousness, particularly those of a peaceful, insightful, blissful, or even ecstatic character.

text: Sikhismo ta un religion di e sup kontinente di India. Su orígen ta di e region Punjab durante siglo 15 for di un divishon sektario denter di e tradishon hindú.
eng_text: Sikhism is a religion from the Indian sub-continent. It originated in the Punjab region during the 15th century from a sectarian split within the Hindu tradition.

text: Sikhnan ta konsiderá nan fe di ta apart for di e religion di hinduismo apesar ku nan ta rekonosé su raisnan i tradishonnan hindú.
eng_text: Sikhs consider their faith to be a separate religion from Hinduism though they acknowledge its Hindu roots and traditions.

text: Sikhnan ta yama nan religion Gurmat, ku ta punjabi pa “e manera di e guru”. E guru ta un aspekto fundamental di tur religion di India pero den Sikhismo el a tuma un importansia ku ta forma e núkleo di e kerensia di Sikh.
eng_text: Sikhs call their religion Gurmat, which is Punjabi for "way of the guru". The guru is a fundamental aspect of all Indian religions but in Sikhism has taken on an importance that forms the core of Sikh beliefs.

text: E religion a wòrdu fundá den siglo 15 pa Guru Nanak (1469-1539). A sigui un suseshon di nuebe siguiente guru.
eng_text: The religion was founded in the 15th century by Guru Nanak (1469–1539). There followed in succession a further nine gurus.

text: Sinembargo, na yüni di 1956, a pone Krushchev su promesanan na prueba ora ku e rebelion na Polonia, kaminda trahadónan tabata protestá kontra skarsedat di kuminda i bahamentu di salario, a kambia den un protesta general kontra Komunismo.
