eng_text: However, in June 1956, Krushchev's promises were put to the test when riots in Poland, where workers were protesting against food shortages and wage cuts, turned into a general protest against Communism.

text: Maske na final, Krushchev a manda tanki pa restorá órden, el a akseptá algun di e demandanan ekonómiko i a bai di akuerdo pa pone e popular Wladyslaw Gomulka komo e promé minister nobo.
eng_text: Although in the end, Krushchev sent in tanks to restore order, he did give way to some economic demands and agreed to appoint the popular Wladyslaw Gomulka as the new prime minister.

text: E Indus Valley Civilization tabata un sivilisashon di e era di Bròns na nortwèst di e sup-kontinente di India konteniendo mayoria di e Pakistan moderno di awendia i algun region den nortwèst di India i nortost di Afganistan.
eng_text: The Indus Valley Civilization was a Bronze Age civilisation in the northwest Indian subcontinent encompassing most of modern-day Pakistan and some regions in northwest India and northeast Afghanistan.

text: E sivilisashon a floresé den e kuenka di e riu Indus di unda su nòmber ta derivá.
eng_text: The civilisation flourished in the basins of the Indus River wherefore it derives its name.

text: Aunke algun eksperto ta spekulá ku komo ku e sivilisashon a eksistí tambe den e kuenka di e riu Sarasvati ku awendia a seka, e mester korektamente wòrdu yamá Sivilisashon Indus-Sarasvati, miéntras algun ta yam’é Sivilisashon Harappan na honor di Harappa, e promé di e sitionan ku a eskavá den añanan 1920.
eng_text: Although some scholars speculate that since the civilisation also existed in the basins of the now dried up Sarasvati River, it should be aptly called the Indus-Sarasvati Civilization, while some call it the Harappan Civilization after Harappa, the first of its sites to be excavated in the 1920s.

text: E aspekto militar di e imperio romano a yuda den desaroyo di adelanto médiko.
eng_text: The militaristic nature of the Roman empire aided in the development of medical advances.

text: Dòkternan a kuminsá wòrdu reklutá dor di Emperador Augustus i hasta a forma e promé Kuerpo Médiko Romano pa uso despues di batayanan.
eng_text: Doctors began to be recruited by Emperor Augustus and even formed the first Roman Medical Corps for use in the aftermath of battles.

text: Siruhanonan tabatin konosementu di vários remedi kontra doló inkluso morfina for di ekstrakto di simia di papaver i scopolamine for di simia di e mata herbane.
eng_text: Surgeons had knowledge of various sedatives including morphine from extracts of poppy seeds and scopolamine from herbane seeds.

text: Nan a bira ábil den amputashon pa salba pashènt di gangrena i tambe ku turnikèt i klèm di ardu pa stòp fluho di sanger.
eng_text: They became proficient at amputation to save patients from gangrene as well as tourniquets and arterial clamps to stem blood flow.

text: Den kurso di múltiple siglo, e imperio romano a realisá logronan grandi den e kampo di medisina i a krea hopi di e konosementu di loke ku nos sa awe.
eng_text: Over multiple centuries, the Roman empire led to great gains in the field of medicine and formed much of the knowledge we know today.

text: Origami di Pureland ta origami ku tin e restrikshon ku solamente un doblá mag wòrdu realisá pa biaha, doblánan mas kompliká manera dobla bai bèk no ta permití, i tur e doblánan mester tin un sitio evidente.
eng_text: Pureland origami is origami with the restriction that only one fold may be done at a time, more complex folds like reverse folds are not allowed, and all folds have straightforward locations.

text: E ta desaroyá pa John Smith den e añanan 1970 pa yuda hende ku no tin eksperensiá di dobla òf esunnan ku tin abilidat di kordinashon limitá.
eng_text: It was developed by John Smith in the 1970s to help inexperienced folders or those with limited motor skills.

text: Mucha hopi yòn kaba ta desaroyá un konsiensia di rasa i stereotipo rasial i e stereotiponan akí ta afektá komportashon.
eng_text: Children develop an awareness of race and racial stereotypes quite young and these racial stereotypes affect behavior.

text: Por ehèmpel, muchanan ku ta identifiká nan mes ku e minoria rasial ku ta wòrdu duná e stereotipo di no ta presta bon na skol tin tendensia di no presta bon na skol ora nan haña sa di e stereotipo asosiá ku nan rasa.
eng_text: For instance, children who identify with a racial minority that is stereotyped as not doing well in school tend to not do well in school once they learn about the stereotype associated with their race.

text: MySpace ta e di tres website di mas popular ku ta wòrdu usá na Estados Unidos i aktualmente e tin 54 mion profil.
eng_text: MySpace is the third most popular website used in the United States and has 54 million profiles currently.

text: E websitenan akí a haña hopi atenshon, espesialmente den enseñansa.
eng_text: These websites have gotten a lot of attention, especially in the education setting.

text: Tin aspekto positivo na e websitenan akí, ku ta inkluí e abilidat pa fásilmente traha un página di klas ku por inkluí blog, vidio, potrét, i otro funshon.
eng_text: There are positive aspects to these websites, which include, being able to easily setup a class page which can include blogs, videos, photos, and other features.

text: E página akí ta aksesibel fásil yenando solamente un adrès di web, loke ta hai´é fásil pa kòrda i fásil pa taip pa studiantenan ku kisas tin problema ku uso di teklado òf ku ortografía.
eng_text: This page can easily be accessed by providing just one web address, which makes it easy to remember and easy to type in for students who may have trouble using the keyboard or with spelling.

text: Por adapt’é pa hasié fásil pa lesa i tambe ku mes tantu òf mes tiki koló ku ta deseá.
eng_text: It can be customized to make it easy to read and also with as much or little color as desired.

text: Attention Deficit Disorder “ta un síndrome neurológiko ku nan ta definí ku su trio di síntomanan klásiko ku ta inkluí impulsividat, distrakshon, i hiperaktividat òf un ekseso di energia”.
eng_text: Attention Deficit Disorder "is a neurological syndrome whose classic defining triad of symptoms including impulsivity, distractibility, and hyperactivity or excess energy".

text: No ta un desabilidat pa siña, ta un defekto pa siña; e ta “afektá 3 pa 5 porshento di tur mucha, kisas hasta 2 mion mucha merikano”.
eng_text: It is not a learning disability, it is a learning disorder; it "affects 3 to 5 percent of all children, perhaps as many as 2 million American children".

text: Mucha ku ADD tin difikultat pa konsentrá riba kosnan manera tarea di skol, pero nan por konsentrá riba kosnan ku nan ta gusta hasi manera hunga wega òf wak nan cartoon faborito òf skirbi frase sin puntuashon.
eng_text: Children with ADD have a hard time focusing on things like school work, but they can concentrate on things they enjoy doing like playing games or watching their favorite cartoons or writing sentences without punctuation.

text: E muchanan akí tin e tendensia di haña nan mes den hopi problema, pasobra nan “gusta aktuashon ku tin riesgo, nan ta drenta pelea, i nan ta reta outoridat” pa por stimulá nan serebro, dor ku métodonan normal no ta stimulá nan serebro.
eng_text: These children tend to get into a lot of trouble, because they "engage in risky behaviors, get into fights, and challenge authority" in order to stimulate their brain, since their brain can not be stimulated by normal methods.

text: ADD ta afektá e relashonnan ku nan otro kompañeronan pasobra otro muchanan no ta komprondé dikon nan ta aktua di e manera ku nan ta hasi òf dikon nan ta spèl e manera ku nan ta hasié òf ku nan nivel di madures ta diferente.
eng_text: ADD affects relationships with other peers because other children can not understand why they act the way that they do or why they spell they way they do or that their maturity level is different.

text: Meskos ku e abilidat di optené konosementu i siña a kambia di tal manera ku a menshoná anteriormente e base di rapides na kua tabata optené konosementu a kambia.
eng_text: As the ability to obtain knowledge and to learn changed in such a way as mentioned above the base rate at which knowledge was obtained changed.

text: E enfoke riba optené informashon tabata diferente. Preshon no tabata presente mas den e individuo su memoria, pero e abilidat di kòrda e teksto a bira mas tantu e enfoke.
eng_text: The approach to obtaining information was different. No longer did pressure reside within individual recall, but the ability to recall text became more of a focus.

text: Den esensia, Renasementu a trese un kambio signifikante den enfoke pa siñamentu i e distribushon di konosementu.
eng_text: In essence, the Renaissance made a significant change in the approach to learning and the dissemination of knowledge.

text: Diferente na otro primatenan, makakunan antropoide no ta usá nan man mas den manera di move òf karga peso òf zuai bula den palunan.
eng_text: Unlike other primates, hominids no longer use their hands in locomotion or bearing weight or swinging through the trees.

text: E man i pia di chimpansénan tin mesun tamaño i largura, loke ta reflehá e uso di e man pa karga peso den nan forma di kana usando kokoti di dede.
eng_text: The chimpanzee's hand and foot are similar in size and length, reflecting the hand's use for bearing weight in knuckle walking.

text: E man humano ta mas kòrtiku ku e pia, ku wesu di dede mas stret.
eng_text: The human hand is shorter than the foot, with straighter phalanges.

text: Fòsil di wesu di man ku tin dos pa tres mion aña bieu ta revelá e kambio akí den spesialisashon di e man for di manera di move pa manipulashon.
eng_text: Fossil hand bones two million to three million years old reveal this shift in specialization of the hand from locomotion to manipulation.

text: Algun hende ta kere ku eksperensiá hopi soño lúsido kousá artifisialmente hopi biaha por ta hopi agotador.
eng_text: Some people believe that experiencing many artificially induced lucid dreams often enough can be very exhausting.

text: E rason prinsipal di e fenómeno akí ta e resultado di e soñonan lúsido ku ta ekspandé e durashon di tempu entre e diferente estadonan di REM.
eng_text: The main reason for this phenomenon is the result of the lucid dreams expanding the length of time between REM states.

text: Ku ménos REM pa anochi, e estado akí den kua bo ta eksperensiá soño di bèrdat i rekuperashon di bo kurpa ta bira sufisientemente infrekuente pa bai bira un problema.
eng_text: With fewer REMs per night, this state in which you experience actual sleep and your body recovers becomes infrequent enough to become a problem.

text: Esaki ta mesun agotador ku ora bo ta spièrta kada binti òf trinta minüt i wak TV.
eng_text: This is just as exhausting as if you were to wake up every twenty or thirty minutes and watch TV.

text: E efekto ta dependé di kuantu biaha bo serebro ta purba tin soño lúsido pa anochi.
eng_text: The effect is dependent on how often your brain attempts to lucidly dream per night.

text: For di prinsipio kos no a bai bon pa e italianonan na Nort Áfrika. Denter di un siman di Italia su deklarashon di guera riba 10 di yüni, 1940, e di 11 Huzarnan britániko a konkistá Fòrti Capuzzo na Libia.
eng_text: Things did not go well for the Italians in North Africa almost from the start. Within a week of Italy's declaration of war on June 10, 1940, the British 11th Hussars had seized Fort Capuzzo in Libya.

text: Den un emboskada ost di Bardia, e británikonan a kapturá e Ingeniero Hefe di e di e Di Dies Ehérsito italiano, General Lastrucci.
eng_text: In an ambush east of Bardia, the British captured the Italian Tenth Army's Engineer-in-Chief, General Lastucci.

text: Riba 28 di yüni, Mariskal Italo Balbo, Gobernador General di Libia i aparentemente e susesor di Mussolini, a fayesé aksidentalmente di tiru di su propio sòldánan miéntras ku e tabata yega tera na Tobruk.
eng_text: On June 28, Marshal Italo Balbo, the Governor-General of Libya and apparent heir to Mussolini, was killed by friendly fire while landing in Tobruk.

text: Ta hunga e deporte moderno esgrima riba hopi nivel, for di studiantenan ku ta siñando na universidat te ku profeshonalnan i kompetensia Olímpiko.
eng_text: The modern sport of fencing is played at many levels, from students learning at a university to professional and Olympic competition.

text: Ta hunga e deporte primeramente den format di duelo, un esgrimista den duelo ku un otro.
eng_text: The sport is primarily played in a duel format, one fencer dueling another.

text: Gòlf ta un wega den kua hungadónan ta usa un palu pa dal e balanan i tira nan den ‘holes’ (buraku).
eng_text: Golf is a game in which players use clubs to hit balls into holes.

text: Ta hunga diesocho holes durante un buèlta regular, ku hungadónan ku usualmente ta kuminsá na e promé buraku den e kampo i kaba na e di diesocho.
eng_text: Eighteen holes are played during a regular round, with players usually starting on the first hole on the course and finishing on the eighteenth.

text: E hungadó ku a bati òf swing ménos ku e palu, pa kompletá e rekorido ta gana.
eng_text: The player who takes the fewest strokes, or swings of the club, to complete the course wins.

text: Ta hunga e wega riba yerba, i e yerba rònt di e buraku ta kòrtá mas chikí i yama bèrdè.
eng_text: The game is played on grass, and the grass around the hole is mown shorter and called the green.

text: Kisas e tipo di turismo mas komun ta loke mayoria di hende ta asosiá ku biahamentu: Turismo di Rekreashon.
eng_text: Perhaps the most common type of tourism is what most people associate with traveling: Recreation tourism.

text: Esaki ta ora hendenan ta bai un lugá ku ta diferente for di nan bida diario pa relahá i dibertí.
eng_text: This is when people go to a place that is very different from their regular day-to-day life to relax and have fun.

text: Laman, parke di dibershon i terenonan di kampamentu hopi bia ta e lugánan mas komun ku e turistanan di rekreo ta frekuentá.
eng_text: Beaches, theme parks and camp grounds are often the most common places frequented by recreational tourists.

text: Si e ophetivo di un hende su bishita na un lugá en partikular ta pa konosé su historia i kultura e ora ei e tipo di turismo aki ta konosí komo turismo kultural.
eng_text: If the objective of one’s visit to a particular place is to get to know its history and culture then this type of tourism is known as cultural tourism.

text: Turistanan por bishitá diferente lugánan di interes di un pais en partikular òf nan por simplemente opta pa enfoká riba djis un área.
eng_text: Tourists may visit different landmarks of a particular country or they may simply opt to focus on just one area.

text: Ora e kolonialistanan, a mira e aktividat aki, nan tambe a pidi pa refuerso.
eng_text: The Colonists, seeing this activity, had also called for reinforcements.

text: E trupanan ku ta reforsá e posishon delantero ta inkluí e 1˚ i di 3 unidat militar di New Hampshire insistiendo di 200 hòmber, bou di Kolonèl John Stark i James Reed (tur dos a bira general despues).
eng_text: Troops reinforcing the forward positions included the 1st and 3rd New Hampshire regiments of 200 men, under Colonels John Stark and James Reed (both later became generals).

text: E hòmbernan di Stark a tuma posishon a lo largu di e tranké na e banda nort di e Kolonialistanan su posishon.
eng_text: Stark's men took positions along the fence on the north end of the Colonist's position.

text: Ora e nivel di e awa a baha el a habri un apertura ekstendiendo di e Mystic River te ku e nort ost di e península, rápidamente nan a ekstendé e tranké ku un muraya di piedra kòrtiku den direkshon nort finalisando kantu di awa riba un playa chikí.
eng_text: When low tide opened a gap along the Mystic River along the northeast of the peninsula, they quickly extended the fence with a short stone wall to the north ending at the water's edge on a small beach.

text: Gridley òf Stark a pone un staka di alrededor di 100 pia (30 m) den e parti dilanti di e tranké i ordená pa niun hende no tira te ora ku e regularnan kaba di pas’e.
eng_text: Gridley or Stark placed a stake about 100 feet (30 m) in front of the fence and ordered that no one fire until the regulars passed it.

text: E plan merikano tabata basá riba lansamentu di atakenan kordiná for di tres diferente direkshon.
eng_text: The American plan relied on launching coordinated attacks from three different directions.

text: General John Cadwalder mester a lansa un atake di distraishon kontra e forsa armá Britániko na Bordentown, pa asin’ei blòkiá tur refuerso.
eng_text: General John Cadwalder would launch a diversionary attack against the British garrison at Bordentown, in order to block off any reinforcements.

text: General James Ewing mester a krusa ku 700 militar dor di e riu na Trenton Ferry, konkistá e brùg riba Assunpink Creek i prevení kualke trupa di enemigu di hui.
eng_text: General James Ewing would take 700 militia across the river at Trenton Ferry, seize the bridge over the Assunpink Creek and prevent any enemy troops from escaping.

text: E forsa prinsipal di atake di 2.400 hòmber lo a krusa e riu nuebe mia nort di Trenton, i despues splet den dos grupo, un bou di Greene i unu bou di Sullivan, pa asina lansa un atake promé ku manesé.
eng_text: The main assault force of 2,400 men would cross the river nine miles north of Trenton, and then split into two groups, one under Greene and one under Sullivan, in order to launch a pre-dawn attack.

text: Ku e kambio di e kareda di un kuart pa mitar mia, velosidat ta bira di hopi ménos importansia i resistensia ta bira un nesesidat apsoluto.
eng_text: With the change from the quarter to the half mile run, speed becomes of much less importance and endurance becomes an absolute necessity.

text: Naturalmente ku un koredó di mei mia di primera klase, un hòmber ku por vense dos minüt, mester poseé un bon kantidat di velosidat, pero mester kultivá resistensia bou di tur sirkunstansia.
eng_text: Of course a first-class half-miler, a man who can beat two minutes, must be possessed of a fair amount of speed, but endurance must be cultivated at all hazards.

text: Algun korementu “cross country” durante wenter, kombiná ku trabou di gemastik pa e parti ariba di e kurpa, ta e mihó preparashon pa e temporada di kareda.
eng_text: Some cross country running during the winter, combined with gymnasium work for the upper part of the body, is the best preparation for the running season.

text: Práktikanan di solamente nutrishon adekuá no ta generá prestashonnan máksimo, pero nan por afektá e bienestar general di atleta hóben di un manera signifikativo.
eng_text: Proper nutritional practices alone cannot generate elite performances, but they can significantly affect young athletes' overall wellness.

text: Mantené un balansa energétiko saludabel, praktikando kustumbernan di hidratashon efektivo, i komprondé e vários aspektonan di suplementashon por yuda atletanan mehorá nan prestashonnan i oumentá nan goso den e deporte.
eng_text: Maintaining a healthy energy balance, practicing effective hydration habits, and understanding the various aspects of supplementation practices can help athletes improve their performance and increase their enjoyment of the sport.

text: Kareda di distansia medio ta un deporte relativamente barata; sin embargo, tin hopi konsepto eróneo tokante e kantidat mínimo di piesanan di ekipo ku mester pa partisipá.
eng_text: Middle distance running is a relatively inexpensive sport; however, there are many misconceptions regarding the few pieces of equipment required to participate.

text: Por kumpra produktonan segun nesesidat, pero e mayoria ta bai tin tiki òf niun impakto riba prestashon.
eng_text: Products can be purchased as needed, but most will have little or no real impact on performance.

text: Atletanan por sinti ku nan ta preferá un produkto hasta ora e no ta proveé ningun benefisio real.
eng_text: Athletes may feel that they prefer a product even when it provides no real benefits.

text: Por konsiderá e atom di ta un di e blòkinan fundamental di konstrukshon di tur kos.
eng_text: The atom can be considered to be one of the fundamental building blocks of all matter.

text: E ta un entidat hopi kompleho i di akuerdo ku un modelo Bohr simplifiká, ta konsistí di, un núkleo sentral órbita pa elektrononan, un tiki similar na planetanan ku ta move rònt di e solo – wak Figura 1.1.
eng_text: Its a very complex entity which consists, according to a simplified Bohr model, of a central nucleus orbited by electrons, somewhat similar to planets orbiting the sun - see Figure 1.1.

text: E núkleo ta konsistí di dos partíkula – neutrònnan i protònnan.
eng_text: The nucleus consists of two particles - neutrons and protons.

text: Protònnan tin un karga eléktriko positivo miéntras ku neutrònnan no tin karga. E elektronnan tin un karga eléktriko negativo.
eng_text: Protons have a positive electric charge while neutrons have no charge. The electrons have a negative electric charge.

text: Pa Kontrolá e víktima, bo mester inspekshoná e esena promé pa sigurá bo seguridat.
eng_text: To Check the victim, you must first survey the scene to ensure your safety.

text: Bo mester tuma nota di e posishon di e víktima segun bo ta aserk’é i di kualke señal di alerta outomátiko.
eng_text: You need to notice the victim's position as you approach him or her and any automatic red flags.

text: Si bo lastimá bo mes tratando di yuda, bo por sirbi solamente pa hasi kos pió.
eng_text: If you get hurt trying to help, you may only serve to make matters worse.

text: E studio a revelá ku depreshon, hansha i sensashon di fatalidat a intermediá den e relashon entre e doló i desabilidat serka pashèntnan ku ta sufri di doló den parti abou di nan lomba.
eng_text: The study found that depression, fear and catastrophising mediated the relationship between pain and disability in lower back pain sufferers.

text: Únikamente e efektonan di dramatisashon, i no depreshon i hansha tabata kondishonal den e seshonnan strukturá regularmente semanal di PA.
eng_text: Only the effects of catastrophizing, not depression and fear was conditional of regular weekly structured PA sessions.

text: Esnan ku tabata partisipá na aktividatnan regular tabata rekerí mas sosten den término di persepshon negativo di doló distinguiendo e diferensianan entre doló króniko i sensashon di inkomonidat dor di un movementu físiko normal.
eng_text: Those participating in regular activity required more support in terms of negative perception of pain distinguishing the differences of chronic pain and discomfort feel from normal physical movement.

text: Vishon, òf e abilidat di mira ta dependé di e sistema visual di órganonan sensorial òf wowonan.
eng_text: Vision, or the ability to see depends on visual system sensory organs or eyes.

text: Tin hopi diferente konstrukshon di wowo, ku ta varia den kompleksidat dependiendo di e rekerimentunan di e organismo.
eng_text: There are many different constructions of eyes, ranging in complexity depending on the requirements of the organism.

text: E diferente konstrukshonnan tin diferente kapasidat, ta sensibel pa diferente largura di onda i tin diferente grado di presishon, tambe nan ta rekerí diferente prosesamentu pa por komprondé e input i diferente numbernan pa por traha optimalmente.
eng_text: The different constructions have different capabilities, are sensitive to different wave-lengths and have differing degrees of acuity, also they require different processing to make sense of the input and different numbers to work optimally.

text: Un populashon ta un kolekshon di organismonan di un espesie en partikular denter di un área geográfiko determiná.
eng_text: A population is the collection of organisms of a particular species within a given geographic area.

text: Na momentu ku tur organismo den un populashon ta idéntiko pa loke ta trata un karakterístiko fenotípiko en partikular, ta yama nan monomórfiko.
eng_text: When all individuals in a population are identical with regard to a particular phenotypic trait they are known as monomorphic.

text: Ora e individuonan ta mustra diferente variante di un karakterístika en partikular nan ta polymórfiko.
eng_text: When the individuals show several variants of a particular trait they are polymorphic.

text: Kolonianan di vruminganan militar tambe ta marcha i traha nèshi den diferente etapa.
eng_text: Army ant colonies march and nest in different phases as well.

text: Den e etapa nomádiko, e ehérsito di vruminga ta marcha durante anochi i stòp pa kamper durante dia.
eng_text: In the nomadic phase, army ants march at night and stop to camp during the day.

text: E kolonia ta kuminsá un etapa nomádiko na momentu ku e kuminda disponibel bira ménos. Durante e etapa aki, e kolonia ta traha nèshinan temporal kual nan ta kambia tur dia.
eng_text: The colony begins a nomadic phase when available food has decreased. During this phase, the colony makes temporary nests that are changed everyday.

text: Kada un di e òptògt nomádikonan aki òf marchanan ta dura aproksimadamente 17 dia.
eng_text: Each of these nomadic rampages or marches lasts for approximately 17 days.

text: Kiko ta un sélula? E palabra sélula ta bin di e palabra Latin “cella”, ku ta nifiká “kamber chikí”, i ta un mikroskopista a invent’é pa promé bia ora e tabata opservá e struktura di kòrki.
eng_text: What is a cell? The word cell comes from the Latin word "cella", meaning "small room", and it was first coined by a microscopist observing the structure of cork.

text: E sélula ta e unidat básiko di tur kos ku ta biba, i tur organismo ta konsistí di un òf mas sélula.
eng_text: The cell is the basic unit of all living things, and all organisms are composed of one or more cells.

text: Sélulanan ta asina básiko i kritiko pa e estudio di bida, ku de echo hopi bia ta yama nan “e blòkinan di konstrukshon di bida”.
eng_text: Cells are so basic and critical to the study of life, in fact, that they are often referred to as "the building blocks of life".

text: E sistema nèrvioso ta mantené homeostatis dor di manda impulsonan nèrvioso a traves di e kurpa pa mantené e fluho di sanger asina bon manera sin interupshon.
eng_text: The Nervous System maintains homeostasis by sending nerve impulses through out the body to keep the flow of blood going as well as undisturbed.

text: E impulsonan nèrvioso aki por ser mandá asina lihé dor di e kurpa kompleto ku nan ta yuda tene e kurpa safe di kualke menasa potensial.
eng_text: These nerve impulses can be sent so quickly throughout the body which helps keep the body safe from any potential threat.

text: Warwarúnan ta afektá un área chikí kompará ku otro tormentanan violento, pero nan por destruí tur kos ku ta riba nan kaminda.
eng_text: Tornadoes strike a small area compared to other violent storms, but they can destroy everything in their path.

text: Warwarúnan por ranka i saka palunan for di tera, kibra tablanan for di edifisionan i zuai outonan den laira. E dos porshento di warwarúnan mas violento ta dura mas ku tres ora.
eng_text: Tornadoes uproot trees, rip boards from buildings, and fling cars up into the sky. The most violent two percent of tornadoes last more than three hours.

text: E tormentonan monstruoso aki tin bientunan di hasta 480 km/o (133 m/s; 300 mph).
eng_text: These monster storms have winds up to 480 km/h (133 m/s; 300 mph).

text: E ser humano ta traha i usa lèns pa magnifikashon ya pa míles i míles di aña kaba.
eng_text: Humans have been making and using lenses for magnification for thousands and thousands of years.

text: Sinembargo, e promé berdadero teleskopnan ta trahá na Oropa na final di siglo 16.
eng_text: However, the first true telescopes were made in Europe in the late 16th century.

text: E teleskopnan aki tabata usa un kombinashon di dos lèns pa hasi ophetonan ku ta leu parse tantu mas serka komo mas grandi.
eng_text: These telescopes used a combination of two lenses to make distant objects appear both nearer and larger.

text: Kudishi i egoismo semper lo ta ku nos i ta e naturalesa di koperashon ku ora e mayoria ta benefisiá di algu semper lo tin mas pa gana riba término kòrtiku dor di aktua di manera egoista.
eng_text: Greed and selfishness will always be with us and it is the nature of cooperation that when the majority benefit there will always be more to gain in the short term by acting selfishly

text: Ta di spera, ku hopi hende lo realisá ku nan mihó opshon riba término largu ta pa traha huntu ku otro.
eng_text: Hopefully, most people will realise that their long term best option is to work together with others.

text: Hopi hende ta soña ku e dia ku hendenan por biaha bai un otro strea i eksplorá otro mundunan, tin hende ta puntra nan mes kiko tin eifó, tin ta pensa ku ekstraterestre òf otro bida por biba riba un otro planeta.
eng_text: Many people dream of the day when humans can travel to another star and explore other worlds, some people wonder what's out there some belive that aliens or other life may live on another plant.

text: Pero, si esaki sosodé un dia probablemente e lo no sosodé pa un tempu hopi largu. E streanan ta asina plamá for di otro ku tin biónes di mia entre e streanan ku ta “bisiña”.
eng_text: But, if this ever does happen probably won't happen for a very long time. The stars are so spread out that there are trillions of miles between stars that are "neighbors".

text: Por ta un dia, bo bisa-nietunan lo ta para riba tòp di un mundu di ekstraterestre puntrando nan mes over di nan antepasadonan antiguo?
eng_text: Maybe one day, your great grandchildren will be standing atop an alien world wondering about their ancient ancestors?

text: Animalnan ta trahá di hopi sélulanan. Nan ta kome kos i digerié den nan paden. Mayoria di animal por move.
eng_text: Animals are made of many cells. They eat things and digest them inside. Most animals can move.

text: Solamente animalnan tin serebro (aunke no ta tur animal tin; kwal, por ehèmpel, no tin serebro).
eng_text: Only animals have brains (though not even all animals do; jellyfish, for example, do not have brains).

text: Ta haña animalnan tur kaminda na mundu. Nan ta koba den tera, landa den laman, i bula den laira.
eng_text: Animals are found all over the earth. They dig in the ground, swim in the oceans, and fly in the sky.

text: Un sélula ta e unidat struktural i funshonal mas chikí di un organismo (kosnan) bibu.
eng_text: A cell is the smallest structural and functional unit of a living (things) organism.

text: Sélula ta bin di e palabra na latin cella ku ta nifiká kamber chikí.
eng_text: Cell comes from the Latin word cella which means small room.

text: Si bo wak kosnan bibu bou di un mikroskop, lo bo mira ku nan ta trahá di firkantnan òf balanan chikí.
eng_text: If you look at living things under a microscope, you will see that they are made of small squares or balls.

text: Robert Hooke, un biólogo di Inglatera, a mira firkantnan chikí den kòrki ku un mikroskop.
eng_text: Robert Hooke, a biologist from England, saw small squares in cork with a microscope.

text: Nan tabata parse kamber. E tabata e promé persona ku a opservá sélulanan morto.
eng_text: They looked like rooms. He was the first person to observe dead cells

text: Elemento i kompuestonan por move di un estado pa otro i no kambia.
eng_text: Elements and compounds can move from one state to another and not change.

text: Nitrógeno komo gas ainda tin e mesun propiedatnan ku nitrógeno líkido. E estado líkido ta mas diki pero e molekülnan ta keda meskos.
eng_text: Nitrogen as a gas still has the same properties as liquid nitrogen. The liquid state is denser but the molecules are still the same.

text: Awa ta un otro ehèmpel. E komposishon di awa ta konsistí di dos atom di hidrógeno i un atom di oksígeno.
eng_text: Water is another example. The compound water is made up of two hydrogen atoms and one oxygen atom.

text: E tin e mesun struktura molekular sea ku ta un gas, líkido, òf sólido.
eng_text: It has the same molecular structure whether it is a gas, liquid, or solid.

text: Aunke su estado físiko por kambia, su estado kímiko ta keda meskos.
eng_text: Although its physical state may change, its chemical state remains the same.

text: Tempu ta algu ku ta tur rònt di nos, i e ta afektá tur kos ku nos ta hasi, pero tòg e ta difísil pa komprondé.
eng_text: Time is something that is all around us, and affects everything we do, yet is difficult to understand.

text: Pa míles di aña akadémikonan religioso, filosófiko, i sientífiko a studia tempu.
eng_text: Time has been studied by religious, philosophical, and scientific scholars for thousands of years.

text: Nos ta eksperensiá tempu manera un seri di akontesimentunan pasando di e futuro dor di e presente pa e pasado.
eng_text: We experience time as a series of events passing from the future through the present to the past.

text: Tempu ta tambe e manera kon nos ta kompará e durashon (largura) di eventonan.
eng_text: Time is also how we compare the duration (length) of events.

text: Bo mes por marka e pasamentu di tempu dor di opservá e ripitishon di akontesimentunan síkliko. Un akontesimentu síkliko ta algu ku ta keda pasa regularmente.
eng_text: You can mark the passing of time yourself by observing the repetition of a cyclical event. A cyclical event is something that happens again and again regularly.

text: Ta usa kòmpiuternan awendia pa manipulá potrèt i vidionan.
eng_text: Computers today are used to manipulate pictures and videos.

text: Por konstruí animashonnan sofistiká riba kòmpiuter, i mas i mas televishon i pelíkulanan ta usando e tipo di animashonnan aki.
eng_text: Sophisticated animations can be constructed on computers, and this kind of animation is increasingly being used in television and films.

text: Hopi bia ta graba muzik usando kòmpiuternan sofistiká pa prosesá i meks zonido.
eng_text: Music is often recorded using sophisticated computers to process and mix sounds together.

text: Pa largu tempu, a kere ku ta durante e di diesnuebe i di binti siglo, ku e promé abitantenan di Nueva Zelandia tabata e hendenan di Maori, ku tabata yag riba e paranan gigantesko yamá moas.
eng_text: For a long time during the nineteenth and twentieth centuries, it was believed the first inhabitants of New Zealand were the Maori people, who hunted giant birds called moas.

text: E teoria a establesé e ora ei e idea ku e hendenan di Maori a emigrá for di Polinesia den un Flota Grandi i a kita Nueva Zelandia for di e Moriorinan, establesiendo un sosiedat agrikultor.
eng_text: The theory then established the idea that the Maori people migrated from Polynesia in a Great Fleet and took New Zealand from the Moriori, establishing an agricultural society.

text: Sinembargo, evidensia nobo ta sugerí ku e Moriorinan tabata un grupo di Maori di kontinente ku a emigrá for di Nueva Zelandia bai e islanan Chatham, desaroyando nan propio kultura distintivo i pasífiko.
eng_text: However, new evidence suggests that the Moriori were a group of mainland Maori who migrated from New Zealand to the Chatham Islands, developing their own distinctive, peaceful culture.

text: Tambe tabatin un otro tribu riba e islanan Chatman esakinan tabata Maori ku a emigrá for di Nueva Zelandia.
eng_text: There was also another tribe on the Chatham islands these were Maori who migrated away from New Zealand.

text: Nan tabata yama nan mes Moriori, tabatin algun konflikto i na final, a anikilá e Moriorinan.
eng_text: They called themselves the Moriori there were a few skirmishes and in the end, the Moriori were wiped out

text: Personanan ku tabata envolví den diferente dékada a yuda nos apresiá nos parti fuerte i pashonnan miéntras tabata evaluá ku frankesa e difikultat i asta frakasonan.
eng_text: Individuals who had been involved for several decades helped us appreciate our strengths and passions while candidly assessing difficulties and even failures.

text: Segun nos ta skucha personanan kompartí nan historianan individual, familiar i organisatorio, nos a haña komprondementu balioso den e pasado i algun di e personahenan ku a influensia e kultura di e organisashon pa bon òf pa malu.
eng_text: While listening to individuals share their individual, family, and organizational stories, we gained valuable insight into the past and some of the personalities who influenced for good or ill the culture of the organization.

text: Miéntras ku komprondé un hende su historia no ta enserá komprondementu di e kultura, e ta yuda a lo ménos pa hende haña un idea unda nan ta kai denter di e historia di e organisashon.
eng_text: While understanding one’s history does not assume understanding of culture, it does at least help people gain a sense of where they fall within the history of the organization.

text: Miéntras ta evaluando e éksitonan i birando konsiente di fayonan, e personanan i e konhunto kompleto di e personanan ku a partisipá, ta diskubrí mas profundamente e balornan, mishon, i motornan di e organisashon.
eng_text: While assessing the successes and becoming aware of failures, individuals and the whole of the participating persons discover more deeply the values, mission, and driving forces of the organization.

text: Na e instansia aki, rekordando kasonan previo di kondukta empresarial i éksitonan komo resultado di esaki, a yuda hende pa habri nan mes pa kambionan nobo i direkshon nobo di e iglesia lokal.
eng_text: In this instance, recalling previous instances of entrepreneurial behavior and resulting successes helped people to be open to new changes and new direction for the local church.

text: Historianan asin’aki a redusí e miedu pa kambio, miéntras nan tabata krea inklinashonnan positivo pa ku kambio den futuro.
eng_text: Such success stories lessened the fears of change, while creating positive inclinations toward change in the future.

text: Patronchi di pensa konvergente ta téknikanan pa solushoná problema ku ta uni diferente ideanan òf áreanan pa haña solushon.
eng_text: Convergent thinking patterns are problem solving techniques that unite different ideas or fields to find a solution.

text: E fókùs di e manera di pensa aki ta velosidat, lógika i presishon, tambe identifikashon di echonan, aplikashon di nobo di téknikanan eksistente, kolektá informashon.
eng_text: The focus of this mindset is speed, logic and accuracy, also identification of facts, reapplying existing techniques, gathering information.

text: E faktor di mas importante di e mindset akí ta: tin un solo kontesta korekto. Bo ta pensa solamente riba dos kontesta, esta bon òf malu.
eng_text: The most important factor of this mindset is: there is only one correct answer. You only think of two answers, namely right or wrong.

text: Ta asosiá e tipo di pensa aki ku sierto prosedura sientífiko òf standart.
eng_text: This type of thinking is associated with certain science or standard procedures.

text: Hende ku e manera di pensa aki ta pensa lógikamente, por memorisá patronchi, solushoná problema i traha riba tèst sientífiko.
eng_text: People with this type of thinking have logical thinking, are able to memorize patterns, solve problems and work on scientific tests.

text: Hende ta e espesie ku ta hopi mas talentoso den lesa mente di otro.
eng_text: Humans are by far the most talented species in reading the minds of others.

text: Esei ta nifiká ku nos ta kapas di pronostiká ku éksito lokual otro ser humano ta persibí, kere, sa, deseá òf ke hasi.
eng_text: That means we are able to successfully predict what other humans perceive, intend, believe, know or desire.

text: Entre e abilidatnan aki, komprondé e intenshon di otronan ta krusial. E ta permití nos resolvé posibel ambigwedatnan i akshonnan físiko.
eng_text: Among these abilities, understanding the intention of others is crucial. It allows us to resolve possible ambiguities of physical actions.

text: Por ehèmpel, si bo a mira un hende kibrando un bentana di outo, probablemente lo bo asumí ku e tabata trata di hòrta e outo di un hende straño.
eng_text: For example, if you were to see someone breaking a car window, you would probably assume he was trying to steal a stranger’s car.

text: Lo mester a husg’e diferentemente si el a pèrdè su yabinan di outo i tabata su mes outo ku e tabata trata di kibra drenta aden.
eng_text: He would need to be judged differently if he had lost his car keys and it was his own car that he was trying to break into.

text: MRI ta basá riba un fenómeno físiko yamá resonansia magnétiko nuklear (NMR), diskubrí den e dékada di 1930 dor di Felix Bloch (trahando na Universidat di Stanford) i Edward Purcell (di Universidat di Harvard).
eng_text: MRI is based on a physics phenomenon called nuclear magnetic resonance (NMR), which was discovered in the 1930s by Felix Bloch (working at Stanford University) and Edward Purcell (from Harvard University).

text: Den e resonansia aki, e kampo magnétiko i ondanan radial ta kousa e atomnan pa emití señalnan di radio minúskulo.
eng_text: In this resonance, magnetic field and radio waves cause atoms to give off tiny radio signals.

text: Den e aña 1970, Raymond Damadian, un dòkter i investigadó sientífiko, a diskubrí e base pa usa imágennan di resonansia magnétiko komo hèrmènt pa diagnóstiko médiko.
eng_text: In the year 1970, Raymond Damadian, a medical doctor and research scientist, discovered the basis for using magnetic resonance imaging as a tool for medical diagnosis.

text: Kuater aña despues a konsedé un patènt, ku tabata mundu su promé patènt emití den e kampo di MRI.
eng_text: Four years later a patent was granted, which was the world's first patent issued in the field of MRI.

text: Den 1977, Dr. Damadian a kompletá e konstrukshon di e promé scanner di MRI “pa kurpa kompleto”, kual el a yama e “Indomabel”.
eng_text: In 1977, Dr. Damadian completed the construction of the first “whole-body” MRI scanner, which he called the ”Indomitable”.

text: Komunikashon asinkróniko ta enkurashá tempu di reflekshon i reakshon riba otronan.
eng_text: Asynchronous communication encourages time for reflection and reaction to others.

text: E ta permití studiantenan e abilidat di traha na nan propio tèmpo i kontrolá e tèmpo di e informashon di instrukshon.
eng_text: It allows students the ability to work at their own pace and control the pace of instructional information.

text: Banda di esaki, tin ménos restrikshon di tempu ku e posibilidat pa traha oranan di trabou fleksibel. (Bremer, 1998)
eng_text: In addition, there are fewer time restrictions with the possibility of flexible working hours. (Bremer, 1998)

text: E uso di e Internèt i e Ret Mundial ta permití e alumnonan pa tin akseso na informashon na tur momento.
eng_text: The use of the Internet and the World Wide Web allows learners to have access to information at all times.

text: Studiantenan por manda preguntanan pa nan instruktornan na kualke momentu di dia i spera kontestanan rasonablemente rápido, na lugá di warda te e siguiente reunion kara - kara.
eng_text: Students can also submit questions to instructors at any time of day and expect reasonably quick responses, rather than waiting until the next face-to-face meeting.

text: E aserkamentu pòst moderno di siñamentu ta ofresé e libertat di prinsipio òf balornan apsoluto. No tin un manera bon so di siña.
eng_text: The postmodern approach to learning offers the freedom from absolutes. There is no one good way to learn.

text: De echo, no tin ni un kos bon pa siña. Siñamentu ta tuma lugá den e eksperensia entre alumno i e konosementu presentá.
eng_text: In fact, there is not one good thing to learn.Learning takes place in the experience between the learner and the knowledge presented.

text: Nos eksperensia aktual ku tur e hasié - bo - mes i programanan di televishon presentando informashon basá riba siñamentu ta ilustrá e punto aki.
eng_text: Our current experience with all the do-it-yourself and information presenting, learning-based television shows illustrates this point.

text: Asina tantu di nos ta haña nos mes ta wak un programa di televishon ku ta informá nos di un proseso òf eksperensia den kua nunka nos lo no partisipá òf apliká e konosementu.
eng_text: So many of us find ourselves watching a television show that informs us of a process or experience in which we will never participate or apply that knowledge.

text: Nunka nos lo revisá un outo, konstruí un fòntein den nos kura patras, biaha pa Perú pa eksaminá ruinanan antiguo, òf remodelá kas di nos bisiña.
eng_text: We will never overhaul a car, build a fountain in our backyard, travel to Peru to examine ancient ruins, or remodel our neighbour's house.

text: Danki na e konekshonnan di kabel di fibra óptiko bou di laman pa Oropa i e satélite di banda hanchu ku Grunlandia ta bon konektá i ku 93% di e poblashon tin akseso na Internèt.
eng_text: Thanks to undersea fiber optic cable links to Europe and broadband satellite, Greenland is well connected with 93% of the population having internet access.

text: Bo hotèl òf anfitrionnan (si ku bo ta kedando den un kas di huéspet òf kas privá) probablemente lo tin wifi òf un kòmpiuter personal konektá ku Internèt, i tur e establesimentunan tin un Internet-café òf un lugá ku wifi públiko.
eng_text: Your hotel or hosts (if staying in a guesthouse or private home) will likely have wifi or an internet connected PC, and all settlements have an internet cafe or some location with public wifi.

text: Manera a ser menshoná anteriormente, aunke e palabra “èskimo” ainda ta aseptabel na Merka, varios pueblonan ártiko no-amerikano ta konsider´é peyorativo, espesialmente na Canada.
eng_text: As mentioned above, though the word "Eskimo" remains acceptable in the United States, it is considered pejorative by many non-U.S. Arctic peoples, especially in Canada.

text: Asta si bo tende e palabra usá entre e nativonan di Groenlandia, stranheronan mester evitá su uso.
eng_text: While you may hear the word used by Greenlandic Natives, its use should be avoided by foreigners.

text: E habitantenan nativo di Groenlandia ta yama nan mes Inuit na Canada i Kalaaleq (plural Kalaallit), un groenlandés, na Groenlandia.
eng_text: The native inhabitants of Greenland call themselves Inuit in Canada and Kalaalleq (plural Kalaallit), a Greenlander, in Greenland.

text: Krímen, i mal boluntat na estranhero en general, virtualmente no ta algu ku Grunlandia konosé. Te hasta den siudatnan no tin “áreanan di peliger.”
eng_text: Crime, and ill-will toward foreigners in general, is virtually unknown in Greenland. Even in the towns, there are no "rough areas."

text: Wer friu probablemente ta e úniko peliger ku persona ku no ta prepará lo konfrontá.
eng_text: Cold weather is perhaps the only real danger the unprepared will face.

text: Si bo ta bishitá Grunlandia durante temporada friu (konsiderá ku mas nort bo bai, mas friu lo bira), ta esensial pa bini ku trahe ku ta duna sufisientemente kalor.
eng_text: If you visit Greenland during cold seasons (considering that the further north you go, the colder it will be), it is essential to bring warm enough clothing.

text: E dianan hopi largu den zomer por kondusí na problema di drumi sufisientemente i kasonan relashoná ku salú.
eng_text: The very long days in the summer can lead to problems getting sufficient sleep and associated health issues.

text: Durante zomer, tene kuenta tambe ku e sanguranan nórdiko. Apesar ku nan no ta pega bo ku ningun malesa, nan por ta iritante.
eng_text: During the summer, also watch out for the Nordic mosquitoes. Although they do not transmit any diseases, they can be irritating.

text: Miéntras e ekonomia di San Francisco ta ligá ku e ta un atrakshon turístiko di klase-mundial, su ekonomia ta diversifiká.
eng_text: While San Francisco's economy is linked to it being a world-class tourist attraction, its economy is diversified.

text: E sektornan di empleo di mas grandi ta servisionan profeshonal, gobièrnu, finansa, komersio, i turismo.
eng_text: The largest employment sectors are professional services, government, finance, trade, and tourism.

text: Su frekuente representashonnan di muzik, pelíkula, literatura, i kultura popular a yuda hasi e siudat i su lugánan di interes konosí rònt mundu.
eng_text: Its frequent portrayal in music, films, literature and popular culture has helped make the city and its landmarks known throughout the world.

text: San Francisco a desaroyá un infrastruktura turístiko grandi ku numeroso hotèl, restorant, i fasilidatnan pa konvenshon di ekselensia.
eng_text: San Francisco has developed a large tourist infrastructure with numerous hotels, restaurants, and top-notch convention facilities.

text: San Francisco tambe ta un di e mihó lugánan den e nashon pa otro tipo di kushina Asiátiko: Koreano, Tailandes, Indio, i Hapones.
eng_text: San Francisco is also one of the best places in the nation for other Asian cuisine: Korean, Thai, Indian, and Japanese.

text: Biaha pa Walt Disney World ta representá un peregrinashon importante pa hopi famia Merikano.
eng_text: Traveling to Walt Disney World represents a major pilgrimage for many American families.

text: E bishita “típiko” ta enserá bula bai Aeropuerto Internashonal di Orlando, kue bus bai un hotèl di i situá den Disney, pasa alrededor di un siman sin sali for di e propiedat di Disney, i bolbe kas bek.
eng_text: The "typical" visit involves flying into Orlando International Airport, busing to an on-site Disney hotel, spending about a week without leaving Disney property, and returning home.

text: Tin un infinidat di variashon posibel, pero esaki ta sigui ta e loke mayoria hende ke bisa ora nan ta papia di “bai Disney World”.
eng_text: There are infinite variations possible, but this remains what most people mean when they talk of "going to Disney World".

text: Hopi di e ticketnan ku nan ta bende online via wèpsaitnan di findishi manera eBay òf Craigslist ta “multi-day park-hopper tickets” parsialmente usá.
eng_text: Many tickets sold online through auction websites such as eBay or Craigslist are partially used multi-day park-hopper tickets.

text: Miéntras ku esaki ta un praktiká bastante komun, e ta prohibí pa Disney: e ticketnan no ta transferibel.
eng_text: While this is a very common activity, it is prohibited by Disney: the tickets are non-transferable.

text: Kualke kampamentu bou di e rand di Grand Canyon ta rekerí un pèrmit di travesia.
eng_text: Any camping below the rim in Grand Canyon requires a backcountry permit.

text: E pèrmitnan ta limitá pa protehá e klof i ta bira disponibel riba promé dia di luna, kuater luna promé ku luna di inisio.
eng_text: Permits are limited to protect the canyon, and become available on the 1st day of the month, four months prior to the start month.

text: Ke men, pèrmit di travesia backcountry pa kualke fecha di inisio den luna di mei, ta bira disponibel for di 1 di yanüari.
eng_text: Thus, a backcountry permit for any start date in May becomes available on 1 Jan.

text: E espasio pa áreanan mas popular, manera Bright Angel Campground banda di Phantom Ranch, generalmente ta yena ku solisitutnan risibí desde promé fecha ku nan ta habrí pa reservashon.
eng_text: Space for the most popular areas, such as the Bright Angel Campground adjacent to Phantom Ranch, generally fill up by the requests received on first date they are opened to reservations.

text: Tin un number limitá di pèrmit reservá pa solisitutnan sin afsprak disponibel pa órden di yegada.
eng_text: There are a limited number permits reserved for walk-in requests available on a first come, first served basis.

text: Drentando e sur di Áfrika ku outo ta un forma inkreibel pa wak tur e region su bunitesa i tambe pa yega na lugánan fuera di e rutanan turístiko komun.
eng_text: Entering Southern Africa by car is an amazing way to see all the region's beauty as well as to get to places off the normal tourist routes.

text: Por hasi esaki den un outo normal ku un planifikashon kuidadosamente hasí, pero un 4x4 ta altamente rekomendá i hopi lugá ta únikamente aksesibel ku un base di wil haltu 4x4.
eng_text: This can be done in a normal car with careful planning but a 4x4 is highly advised and many locations are only accessible with a high wheel base 4x4.

text: Tuma na kuenta ora bo ta planiando ku aunke e Sur di Áfrika ta stabil, no ta tur e paisnan bisiña ta.
eng_text: Keep in mind while planning that although Southern Africa is stable not all neighboring countries are.

text: E rekerimentu di visa i gastunan ta varia di nashon pa nashon i ta dependé di e pais di kual bo ta bin.
eng_text: Visa requirements and costs vary from nation to nation and are affected by the country you come from.

text: Kada pais tin su leinan úniko ku ta eksigí kiko ta e artíkulonan di emergensia ku mester ta den e outo.
eng_text: Each country also has unique laws requiring what emergency items need to be in the car.

text: Victoria Falls ta un stat den e parti wèst di Zimbabwe, na e otro banda di e frontera di Livingstone, Zambia, i serka di Botswana.
eng_text: Victoria Falls is a town in the western portion of Zimbabwe, across the border from Livingstone, Zambia, and near Botswana.

text: E siudat ta situá direktamente banda di e watervalnan, i nan ta e atrakshon prinsipal, pero e destinashon turístiko popular aki ta ofresé tantu na buskadónan di aventura komo na turistanan bastante posibilidat pa un estadia mas largu.
eng_text: The town lies immediately next to the falls, and they are the major attraction, but this popular tourist destination offers both adventure seekers and sightseers plenty of opportunities for a longer stay.

text: Den e temporada di áwaseru (Novèmber te Mart), e volúmen di awa lo ta mas haltu i e Kaidanan lo ta mas dramátiko.
eng_text: In the rainy season (November to March), the water volume will be higher and the Falls will be more dramatic.

text: Bo por ta sigur ku bo ta muha si bo krusa e brùg òf kana riba e bereanan yen di bògt banda di e watervalnan.
eng_text: You are guaranteed to get wet if you cross the bridge or walk along the trails winding near the Falls.

text: Di otro banda, ta netamente paso e volúmen di awa ta asina haltu ku bo bista di e berdadero Watervalnan lo skuresé—dor di tur e awa!
eng_text: On the other hand, it is precisely because the volume of water is so high that your viewing of the actual Falls will be obscured—by all the water!

text: E tumba di Tutankhamun (KV62). KV62 por ta e tumba di mas famoso di e tumbanan den e Vaye, e esena di Howard Carter su deskubrimentu na 1922 di e entiero real kasi intakto di e rei hóben.
eng_text: Tomb of Tutankhamun (KV62). KV62 may be the most famous of the tombs in the Valley, the scene of Howard Carter's 1922 discovery of the almost intact royal burial of the young king.

text: Kompará ku mayoria di e otro tumbanan real, sinembargo, e tumba di Tutankhamun apénas ta bale la pena bishitá, dor ku e ta muchu mas chikí i ku dekorashon limitá.
eng_text: Compared to most of the other royal tombs, however, the tomb of Tutankhamun is barely worth visiting, being much smaller and with limited decoration.

text: Kualkier hende interesá pa mira evidensia di e daño hasí na e momia durante e intentonan pa sak’e for di e kaha di morto lo keda desapuntá, pa motibu ku ta solamente e kabes i skoudernan ta visibel.
eng_text: Anyone interested in seeing evidence of the damage to the mummy done during attempts to remove it from the coffin will be disappointed as only the head and shoulders are visible.

text: E rikesanan fabuloso di e tumba ya no ta aden, pero a trasladá nan pa e Museo Egipsio na Cairo.
eng_text: The fabulous riches of the tomb are no longer in it, but have been removed to the Egyptian Museum in Cairo.

text: Lo ta mihó pa bishitantenan ku tempu limitá pasa nan tempu otro kaminda.
eng_text: Visitors with limited time would be best to spend their time elsewhere.

text: Phnom Krom, 12 km zùitwèst di Siem Reap. A konstruí e tèmpel riba tòp di seru aki na final di e di 9 siglo, durante e reinado di Rei Yasovarman.
eng_text: Phnom Krom, 12 km southwest of Siem Reap. This hilltop temple was built at the end of the 9th century, during the reign of King Yasovarman.

text: E ambiente melankóliko di e tèmpel i e bista riba e lago Tonle Sap ta hasi ku e ta bale la pena subi e seru.
eng_text: The gloomy atmosphere of the temple and the view over the Tonle Sap lake make the climb to the hill worthwhile.

text: Por kombiná e bishita na e sitio aki kumbinientemente ku un biahe di barku riba e lago.
eng_text: A visit to the site can be conveniently combined with a boat trip to the lake.

text: Pa bo por drenta e tèmpel bo mester di e Angkor Pass, p’esei no lubidá di bin ku bo pasport ora abo ta bai Tonle Sap.
eng_text: The Angkor Pass is needed to enter the temple so do not forget to bring your passport along when heading to Tonle Sap.

text: Herusalèm ta e kapital i siudat mas grandi di Israel, aunke mayoria di otro paisnan i e Nashonnan Uní no ta rekonosé komo kapital di Israel.
eng_text: Jerusalem is the capital and largest city of Israel, though most other countries and the United Nations do not recognize it as Israel's capital.

text: E antiguo siudat den e serunan di Huda tin un historia fasinante ku ta abarká míles di aña.
eng_text: The ancient city in the Judean Hills has a fascinating history spanning thousands of years.

text: E siudat ta santu pa e tres religionnan monoteista: Hudaismo, Kristianismo i Islam, i ta sirbi komo un sentro spiritual, religioso i kultural.
eng_text: The city is holy to the three monotheistic religions - Judaism, Christianity and Islam, and serves as a spiritual, religious, and cultural center.

text: Debí na e nifikashon religioso di e siudat, i en partikular e hopi sitionan den e área di e Siudat Bieu, Herusalèm ta un di e prinsipal destinashonnan turístiko di Israel.
eng_text: Due to the religious significance of the city, and in particular the many sites of the Old City area, Jerusalem is one of the main tourist destinations in Israel.

text: Herusalèm tin hopi lugánan históriko, arkeológiko i kultural, banda di e sentronan komersial vibrante i yená ku hende, café, i restorantnan.
eng_text: Jerusalem has many historic, archeological and cultural sites, along with vibrant and crowded shopping centers, cafés, and restaurants.

text: Ecuador ta rekerí ku siudadanonan Kubano mester risibí un karta di invitashon promé ku drenta Ecuador via di aeropuertonan internashonal òf puntonan di atmishon na frontera.
eng_text: Ecuador requires that Cuban citizens receive an invitation letter prior to entering Ecuador through international airports or frontier admission points.

text: E karta aki mester ta legalisá pa e Ministerio di Asuntunan Eksterior Ekuatoriano, i kumpli ku sierto eksigensia.
eng_text: This letter must be legalized by the Ecuadorian Ministry of Foreign Affairs, and comply with certain requirements.

text: E eksigensianan aki ta diseñá pa proveé un fluho di migrashon organisá entre ámbos pais.
eng_text: These requirements are designed to provide an organized migratory flow between both countries.

text: Siudadanonan Kubano ku ta den posishon di un US green card (Tarheta di residensia permanente di Merka) tin ku bishitá un Konsulado Ekuatoriano pa optené un dispensashon pa e eksigensia aki.
eng_text: Cuban citizens who are US green card holders should visit an Ecuadorian Consulate to obtain an exemption to this requirement.

text: Bo pasport mester ta bálido pa por lo ménos 6 luna despues di bo fecha di biahamentu. Un pasashi di ida i buèlta/di tránsito ta nesesario pa proba e durashon di bo estadia.
eng_text: Your passport must be valid for at least 6 months beyond your travel dates. A round/onward trip ticket is needed to prove the length of your stay.

text: Tournan ta mas barata pa grupo mas grandi, pues si bo ta so òf djis ku un amigu, purba di haña otro hende i forma un grupo di kuater pa seis persona pa un mihó preis pa persona.
eng_text: Tours are cheaper for larger groups, so if you're by yourself or with just one friend, try to meet other people and form a group of four to six for a better per-person rate.

text: Sinembargo, esaki no mester ta realmente bo preokupashon, pasobra frekuentemente ta brua turistanan den otro pa por kaba yena vehíkulo.
eng_text: However, this shouldn't really be off your concern, because often tourists are shuffled around to fill the cars.

text: Den realidat ta parse mas bien di ta un manera gaña hende pa nan kere ku nan lo tin ku paga mas.
eng_text: It seems actually to be more a way of tricking people into believing they have to pay more.

text: Mas haltu ku e parti nort di Machu Picchu ta e seru perpendikular akí, frekuentemente den fondo di hopi pòrtrèt di e ruinanan.
eng_text: Towering above the north end of Machu Picchu is this steep mountain, often the backdrop to many photos of the ruins.

text: For di abou e ta mustra un tiki manera kos ku ta deskurashá bo, i e ta un subida perpendikular i difísil, pero mayoria di persona ku ta rasonablemente den kondishon mester por subi yega ariba den 45 minüt.
eng_text: It looks a bit daunting from below, and it is a steep and difficult ascent, but most reasonably fit persons should be able to make it in about 45 minutes.

text: Tin pia di trapi di piedra trahá na mayoria di e kaminda, i den e sekshon mas perpendikular tin kabel di stal komo man di trapi pa duna sosten.
eng_text: Stone steps are laid along most of the path, and in the steeper sections steel cables provide a supporting handrail.

text: Papiando di esei, prepará pa bai pèrdè rosea, i paga tinu den e pidanan mas perpendikular, spesialmente ora nan ta muhá, komo ku situashon por kambia bira peligroso di gòlpi.
eng_text: That said, expect to be out of breath, and take care in the steeper portions, especially when wet, as it can become dangerous quickly.

text: Tin un kueba chikitu pegá ku e tòp ku mester krusa dor di dje, esaki ta hopi plat i bastante smal.
eng_text: There's a tiny cave near the top that must be passed through, it is quite low and a rather tight squeeze.

text: Pa mira e sitionan i e bida natural di Galapagos ta mihó bai ku boto, presis manera Charles Darwin a hasi na 1835.
eng_text: Seeing the sites and wildlife of the Galapagos is best done by boat, just as Charles Darwin did it in 1835.

text: Mas ku 60 barku krusero ta nabegá den e awanan di Galapagos – di tamaño ku ta varia di 8 pa 100 pasahero.
eng_text: Over 60 cruise ships ply the Galapagos waters - ranging in size from 8 to 100 passengers.

text: Mayoria di persona ta reservá nan lugá hopi adelantá (komo ku e barkunan generalmente ta yen durante e periodo di temporada haltu).
eng_text: Most people book their place well in advance (as the boats are usually full during the high season).

text: Sigurá bo mes ku e agente ku bo tin pa buk ta un spesialista di Galapagos ku un bon konosementu di un variedat grandi di barku.
eng_text: Be sure the agent through whom you book is a Galapagos specialist with a good knowledge of a wide variety of ships.

text: Esaki lo por sigurá ku bo interes i/òf limitashonnan partikular ta kuadra ku e barku ku ta pas mas tantu ku nan.
eng_text: This will ensure that your particular interests and/or constraints are matched with the ship most suitable to them.

text: Promé ku e spañónan a yega den siglo 16, parti nort di Chile tabata bou di mando Inca miéntras e indígena Araucanianonan (Mapuchenan) tabata abitá e parti sentral i sùit di Chile.
eng_text: Before the Spanish arrived in the 16th century, northern Chile was under Inca rule while the indigenous Araucanians (Mapuche) inhabited central and southern Chile.

text: E Mapuchenan tabata tambe un di e último gruponan di amerikanonan indígena independiente, ku e gobernashon ku tabata papia spañó no a apsorbé kompletamente te ku despues di Chile su independensia.
eng_text: The Mapuche were also one of the last independent American indigenous groups, that were not fully absorbed into Spanish-speaking rule until after Chile's independence.

text: Maske Chile a deklará independensia na 1810 (durante e gueranan Napoleoniko ku a laga Spaña sin un gobièrnu sentral funshonando pa algun aña), no a logra un viktoria desisivo kontra e spañónan te na 1818.
eng_text: Although Chile declared independence in 1810 (amid the Napoleonic wars that left Spain without a functioning central government for a couple of years), decisive victory over the Spanish was not achieved until 1818.

text: Repúplika Dominikana (Spañó: República Dominicana) ta e pais den Karibe ku ta okupá e parti ost di isla Hispañola, ku ta komparti´é ku Haiti.
eng_text: The Dominican Republic (Spanish: República Dominicana) is a Caribbean country that occupies the eastern half of the island of Hispaniola, which it shares with Haiti

text: Ademas di playa ku santu blanku i paisahe nan ku seru, e pais ta kas pa e stat europeo mas bieu den Amérika, awendia parti di Santo Domingo.
eng_text: Besides white sand beaches and mountain landscapes, the country is home to the oldest European city in the Americas, now part of Santo Domingo.

text: E isla tabata habitá promé pa e Taínonan i Caribenan. E Caribenan tabata hendenan ku ta papia arawak ku a yega alrededor di 10.000 era komun.
eng_text: The island was first inhabited by the Taínos and Caribes. The Caribes were an Arawakan-speaking people who had arrived around 10,000 BCE.

text: Denter di poko aña despues di e yegada di e eksploradónan europeo, e poblashon di Taínos a redusí drástikamente debí na e konkistadónan spañó.
eng_text: Within a few short years following the arrival of European explorers, the population of Tainos had significantly been reduced by the Spanish conquerors

text: Basá riba Fray Bartolomé de las Casas (Tratado de las Indias) entre 1492 i 1498, e konkistadónan spaño a mata rond di 100.000 Taínos.
eng_text: Based on Fray Bartolomé de las Casas (Tratado de las Indias) between 1492 and 1498 the Spanish conquerors killed around 100,000 Taínos.

text: Jardín de la Unión. A konstruí e espasio akí komo un atrio di un kombento di siglo 17, di kua e Tèmpel di San Diego ta e úniko konstrukshon ku a sobrebibí.
eng_text: Jardín de la Unión. This space was built as the atrium for a 17th-century convent, of which the Templo de San Diego is the sole surviving building.

text: Awor e ta funshoná komo e plasa sentral, i tur ora bai tin un kantidat di kos ta tuma lugá, di dia i di anochi.
eng_text: It now functions as the central plaza, and always has a lot of things going on, day and night.

text: Tin restorant rònt di e hardin, i den traimèrdia i anochi tin frekuentemente konsierto grátis ta tuma lugá na e prieel sentral.
eng_text: There are a number of restaurants surrounding the garden, and in the afternoons and evening there free concerts are often given from the central gazebo.

text: Callejon del Beso (Hanchi di e Sunchi). Dos balkon separá pa solamente 69 centimeter ta hogar di un leyenda bieu di amor.
eng_text: Callejon del Beso (Alley of the Kiss). Two balconies separated by only 69 centimeters is home of an old love legend.

text: Pa un par di sèn algun mucha por konta bo e historia.
eng_text: For a few pennies some children will tell you the story.

text: Bowen Island ta un ekskurshon popular pa hinter dia òf ekskurshon pa wikènt ofresiendo kore den kayak, kaminata den naturalesa, tiendanan, restorantnan i otro kos mas.
eng_text: Bowen Island is a popular day trip or weekend excursion offering kayaking, hiking, shops, restaurants, and more.

text: E komunidat outéntiko akí ta situá na Howe Sound, djis pegá ku Vancouver, i ta fásilmente alkansabel pa medio di taksi akuátiko ku ta kore segun programa i ta sali for di Granville Island den sentro di Vancouver.
eng_text: This authentic community is located in Howe Sound just off Vancouver, and is easily accessed via scheduled water taxis departing Granville Island in downtown Vancouver.

text: Pa personanan kende gusta aktividatnan den aire liber, un kaminata di e koredor di Sea to Sky ta esensial.
eng_text: For those who enjoy outdoor activities, a trek up the Sea to Sky corridor is essential.

text: Whistler (1,5 ora ku outo for di Vancouver) ta karu pero famoso pa e Olimpiada di Wenter 2010.
eng_text: Whistler (1.5 hour drive from Vancouver) is expensive but well-known because of the 2010 Winter Olympics.

text: Den wenter, disfrutá di algun di e mihó skimentu nan den Nort Amérika, i den zomer purba algun kareda outéntiko di mountain biking.
eng_text: In the winter, enjoy some of the best skiing in North America, and in the summer try some authentic mountain biking.

text: Mester hasi reservashon di pèrmit adelantá. Bo mester tin un pèrmit pa por pasa nochi na Sirena.
eng_text: Permits must be reserved in advance. You must have a permit to stay overnight at Sirena.

text: Sirena ta e úniko warda di wardadó di mondi ku ta ofresé fasilidat pa alohamentu pa pasa anochi ku kuminda kayente i ademas fasilidat pa kamper. La Leona, San Pedrillo, i Los Patos ta ofresé sitio pa kamper so sin servisio di kuminda.
eng_text: Sirena is the only ranger station that offers dormitory lodging and hot meals in addition to camping. La Leona, San Pedrillo, and Los Patos offer only camping with no food service.

text: Ta posibel pa haña pèrmit di parke direktamente na e Warda di wardadó di mondi na Puerto Jiménez, pero nan no ta akseptá tarheta di krédito
eng_text: It is possible to secure park permits directly from the Ranger Station in Puerto Jiménez, but they do not accept credit cards

text: E Servisio di Parke (MINAE) no ta saka pèrmit di parke mas ku un luna promé ku e yegada ku ta antisipá.
eng_text: The Park Service (MINAE) does not issue park permits more than one month in advance of anticipated arrival.

text: CafeNèt El Sol ta ofresé servisio di reservashon pa un kontribushon di US$30, òf $10 pa karchi di entrada pa un dia; detayenan ta riba nan página Corcovado.
eng_text: CafeNet El Sol offers a reservation service for a fee of US$30, or $10 for one-day passes; details on their Corcovado page.

text: Cook Islands ta un nashon di isla asosiá libremente ku Nueva Zelandia, lokalisá na Polinesia, meimei di Oséano Pasífiko Sùit.
eng_text: The Cook Islands are an island country in free association with New Zealand, located in Polynesia, in the middle of the South Pacific Ocean.

text: Ta un archipiélago ku 15 isla plamá rònt over di 2,2 mion km2 di oséano.
eng_text: It is an archipelago with 15 islands spread out over 2.2 million km2 of ocean.

text: Ku e mesun zona di tempu ku Hawaii, tin biaha ta wòrdu referí na e islanan komo “Hawaii down under”.
eng_text: With the same time zone as Hawaii, the islands are sometimes thought of as "Hawaii down under".

text: Maske mas chikitu, e ta pone algun bishitante di edat kòrda e Hawaii promé ku nashon independiente, sin tur e hotèlnan grandi pa turista i otro desaroyo.
eng_text: Though smaller, it reminds some elderly visitors of Hawaii before statehood without all the large tourist hotels and other development.

text: Cook Islands no tin ningun siudat pero ta komponé di 15 diferente isla. Esunnan prinsipal ta Rarotonga i Aitutaki.
eng_text: The Cook Islands do not have any cities but are composed of 15 different islands. The main ones are Rarotonga and Aitutaki.

text: Awendia na paisnan desaroyá, Bed and Breakfast a bira un sorto di obra di arte.
eng_text: In developed countries today, providing deluxe bed and breakfasts has been raised to a sort of art-form.

text: Kompará ku otronan, e B&Bnan ta kompetí opviamente riba dos kos prinsipal: kamber i desayuno.
eng_text: At the top end, B&Bs obviously compete mainly on two main things: bedding and breakfast.

text: Pa e motibu akí, na e mihó establesimentunan asina, bo por spera di haña kama di mas luhoso, por ta ku un sobrekama traha na man òf un kama antik.
eng_text: Accordingly, at the finest such establishments one is apt to find the most luxurious bedding, maybe a handmade quilt or an antique bed.

text: Desayuno por inkluí e delisianan di temporada di e region òf e kuminda spesial di e anfitrion.
eng_text: Breakfast may include seasonal delights of the region or the host's speciality dish.

text: E sitio por ta un edifisio históriko i bieu ku muebel antik, tereno bon mantené i un pul pa landa aden.
eng_text: The setting might be an historic old building with antique furnishings, manicured grounds and a swimming pool.

text: Drenta bo mes outo i kohe direkshon pa un paseo largu tin un atrakshon fundamental den su simplesa.
eng_text: Getting into your own car and heading off on a long road trip has an intrinsic appeal in its simplicity.

text: Otro na vehíkulonan grandi, abo probablemente ta kustumá kaba ku kore bo outo i bo konosé su limitashonnan.
eng_text: Unlike larger vehicles, you are probably already familiar with driving your car and know its limitations.

text: Instalá un tènt riba un tereno di propiedat propio òf den un siudat di kualke tamaño por fásilmente hala atenshon no deseá.
eng_text: Setting up a tent on private property or in a town of any size can easily attract unwanted attention.

text: En breve, usa bo outo ta un tremendo manera pa bai dal un paseo pero tiki biaha riba su mes esaki ta un manera pa bai “kamper”.
eng_text: In short, using your car is a great way to take a road trip but seldom in itself a way to "camp".

text: Kamper ku outo ta posibel ora bo tin un minivan grandi, SUV, Sedan òf un Station Wagon ku asiento ku ta drumi plat.
eng_text: Car camping is possible if you have a large minivan, SUV, Sedan or Station Wagon with seats that lay down.

text: Tin algun hotèl ku tin herensia di e siglo di oro di rielnan di trein di stom i bapornan di turista, promé ku Segundo Guera Mundial, den siglo 19 òf prinsipio di siglo 20.
eng_text: Some hotels have a heritage from the golden age of steam railways and ocean liners; before the Second World War, in the 19th or early 20th centuries.

text: E hotèlnan akí tabata kaminda e hendenan riku i ku fama di e tempu ei lo a hospedá, i hopi biaha tabatin sena elegante i bida nokturno.
eng_text: These hotels were where the rich and the famous of the day would stay, and often had fine dining and nightlife.

text: E asesorionan di moda bieu, e falta di e fasilidatnan di último tempu, i un sierto behes elegante tambe ta forma parti di nan karakter.
eng_text: The old fashioned fittings, the lack of the latest amenities, and a certain graceful agedness are also part of their character.

text: Ounke ku normalmente nan ta propiedat privá, tin biaha nan ta akomodá hefenan di estado i otro dignatarionan di bishita.
eng_text: While they are usually privately owned, they sometimes accommodate visiting heads of state and other dignitaries.

text: Un biahero ku bòshi di plaka por konsiderá un buelo rònt mundu, interumpí ku estadia den hopi di e hotèlnan akí.
eng_text: A traveller with piles of money might consider a round the world flight, broken up with stays in many of these hotels.

text: Un ret di interkambio hospitalario ta e organisashon ku ta konektá biaheronan ku hendenan lokal den e siudatnan ku nan ta bai bishitá.
eng_text: A hospitality exchange network is the organization that connects travelers with locals in the cities they are going to visit.

text: Pa djòin un ret asina normalmente ta rekirí simplemente yena un formulario online; maske ku algun di e retnan ta ofresé òf rekirí verifikashon adishonal.
eng_text: Joining such a network usually just requires filling out an online form; although some networks offer or require additional verification.

text: E ora ei ta duna un lista ku anfitrionnan disponibel sea riba papel i/òf online ku, tin biaha ku komentarionan i evaluashonnan di otro biaheronan.
eng_text: A listing of available hosts is then provided either in print and/or online, sometimes with references and reviews by other travelers.

text: A funda ‘Couchsurfing’ na yanüari 2004 despues ku e programadó di kòmpiuter Casey Fenton a haña un buelo barata pa Islandia pero no tabatin lugá pa hospedá.
eng_text: Couchsurfing was founded in January 2004 after computer programmer Casey Fenton found a cheap flight to Iceland but did not have a place to stay.

text: El a manda e-mail pa studiantenan na e universidat lokal i a risibí un kantidat grandi di oferta di akomodashon grátis.
eng_text: He emailed students at the local university and received an overwhelming number of offers for free accommodation.

text: Penshonnan ta fiha prinsipalmente riba hóbennan – un huéspet típiko den su añanan binti – pero bo por haña biaheronan di mas edat einan tambe.
eng_text: Hostels cater primarily to young people – a typical guest is in their twenties – but you can often find older travellers there too.

text: Famianan ku mucha bo no ta mira hopi, pero algun penshon ta permití nan den kambernan privá.
eng_text: Families with children are a rare sight, but some hostels do allow them in private rooms.

text: E siudat di Beijing na China ta e siudat anfitrion pa e Weganan Olímpiko di Wenter 2022. Esaki lo hasié e promé siudat ku tabata anfitrion di Olimpiada di zomer i di wenter.
eng_text: The city of Beijing in China will be the host city of the Olympic Winter Games in 2022, which will make it the first city to have hosted both the summer and winter Olympics.

text: Beijing lo ta e anfitrion di e seremonianan di apertura i klousura i tambe e eventonan di eis di paden.
eng_text: Beijing will host the opening and closing ceremonies and the indoor ice events.

text: Otro eventonan di ski lo ta den e área di ski di Taizicheng na Zhangjiakou, mas òf ménos 220 km (140 mia) for di Beijing.
eng_text: Other skiing events will be at the Taizicheng ski area in Zhangjiakou, about 220 km (140 miles) from Beijing.

text: Mayoria di e tèmpelnan tin un festival anual kuminsando for fin di novèmber i pa medio mei, ku ta varia segun kalendario anual di kada tèmpel.
eng_text: Most of the temples do have an Annual festival starting from November end to Mid of May, which varies according to each temple's annual calendar.

text: Ta selebrá mayoria di e festivalnan di e tèmpelnan komo parti di aniversario di e tèmpel òf di e dios gobernante òf komo otro evento grandi relashoná ku e tèmpel.
eng_text: Most of the temple festivals is celebrated as part of temple's anniversary or presiding deity's birthday or any other major event associated with the temple.

text: E festivalnan di e tèmpel di Kerala ta hopi interesante pa mira, ku proseshonnan regular di olifantenan dekorá, orkesta di tèmpel i otro festividatnan.
eng_text: Kerala's temple festivals are very interesting to see, with regular procession of decorated elephants, temple orchestra and other festivities.

text: Un Feria Mundial (normalmente yamá Eksposishon Mundial, òf simplemente Expo) ta un festival internashonal grandi di arte i siensia.
eng_text: A World's Fair (commonly called World Exposition, or simply Expo) is large international festival of arts and sciences.

text: Paisnan ku ta partisipá ta presentá eksposishon artístiko i edukashonal den paviyonnan nashonal pa eksponé temanan mundial òf historia i kultura di nan pais.
eng_text: Participating countries present artistic and educational displays in national pavilions to showcase world issues or their country's culture and history.

text: Eksposishonnan Internashonal di Hortikultura ta eventonan spesialisá ku ta eksponé obranan di flor, hardinnan botániko i tur otro kos ku tin di aber ku mata.
eng_text: International Horticultural Expositions are specialised events which showcase floral displays, botanical gardens and anything else to do with plants.

text: Ounke ku den teoria nan por tuma lugá anualmente (tanten ku esaki ta tuma lugá na diferente pais) den práktika esaki no ta e kaso.
