eng_text: Although in theory they can take place annually (so long as they are in different countries), in practice they are not.

text: E eventonan aki ta dura normalmente entre tres pa seis luna i ta tuma lugá riba sitionan no mas chikitu ku 50 hèktar.
eng_text: These events normally last anywhere between three and six months, and are held on sites no smaller than 50 hectares.

text: Tin diferente tamaño di felm ku a usa a traves di añanan. E felm di 35mm standart (negatif di 36 pa 24 mm) ta esun di mas komun.
eng_text: There are many different film formats that have been used over the years. Standard 35 mm film (36 by 24 mm negative) is much the commonest.

text: Normalmente e por wòrdu kambiá bastante fásil si bo no tin mas, i ta duna resolushon mas o ménos komparabel ku un kámara DSLR aktual.
eng_text: It can usually be replenished fairly easily if you run out, and gives resolution roughly comparable to a current DSLR.

text: Tin algun kámara ku format mediano di felm ku ta usa un format di 6 pa 6 cm, mas eksaktamente un negatif di 56 pa 56 mm.
eng_text: Some medium-format film cameras use a 6 by 6 cm format, more precisely a 56 by 56 mm negative.

text: Esaki ta duna un resolushon kasi kuater biaha esun di un negatif di 35 mm (3136 mm2 kontra 864).
eng_text: This gives resolution almost four times that of a 35 mm negative (3136 mm2 versus 864).

text: Naturalesa ta entre e elementonan ku mas reto pa un fotógrafo, i tin mester di un kombinashon di suerte, pasenshi, eksperensia i bon ekipo.
eng_text: Wildlife is among the most challenging motifs for a photographer, and needs a combination of good luck, patience, experience and good equipment.

text: Fotografia di naturalesa hopi biaha ta wòrdu konsiderá algu fásil, pero manera fotografia en general, un potrèt ta bal mil palabra.
eng_text: Wildlife photography is often taken for granted, but like photography in general, a picture is worth a thousand words.

text: Fotografia di naturalesa hopi biaha mester di un lèns di telefoto largu, pero kosnan manera un trupa di para òf un bestia miniatura mester di otro lèns.
eng_text: Wildlife photography often requires a long telephoto lens, though things like a flock of birds or a tiny creature need other lenses.

text: Hopi animal eksótiko ta difísil pa haña, i e parkenan tin biaha tin regla di saka potrèt pa metanan komersial.
eng_text: Many exotic animals are hard to find, and parks sometimes have rules about taking photographs for commercial purposes.

text: Animalnan salbahe por ta sea tímido òf agresivo. E ambiente lo por ta friu, kayente, òf di otro forma hostil.
eng_text: Wild animals might either be shy or aggressive. The environment might be cold, hot, or otherwise hostile.

text: Mundu tin mas ku 5.000 diferente idioma, inkluso mas ku binti ku 50 mion òf mas papiadó.
eng_text: The world has over 5,000 different languages, including more than twenty with 50 million or more speakers.

text: Palabra skirbí mayoria biaha ta mas fásil di komprondé ku palabranan papiá, tambe. Esaki ta spesialmente bèrdat pa adrèsnan ku hopi biaha ta difísil pa pronunsiá komprendiblemente.
eng_text: Written words are often easier to understand than spoken words, also. This is especially true of addresses, which are often difficult to pronounce intelligibly.

text: Hopi nashon kompletu ta dominá ingles kompletamente, i den hopi mas bo por spera konosementu limitá – spesialmente bou di e hóbennan.
eng_text: Many entire nations are completely fluent in English, and in even more you can expect a limited knowledge - especially among younger people.

text: Imaginá bo, si bo por, un persona di Manchester, unu di Boston, un hamaikino i unu di Sydney sintá na un mesa komiendo sena na un restorant na Toronto.
eng_text: Imagine, if you will, a Mancunian, Bostonian, Jamaican and Sydneysider sitting around a table having dinner at a restaurant in Toronto.

text: Nan ta entretené otro ku kuentanan di nan pueblo, kontá den nan aksèntnan distinto i nan argo lokal.
eng_text: They're regaling each other with stories from their hometowns, told in their distinct accents and local argot.

text: Kumpra kuminda den supermarketnan ta normalmente e manera di mas barata pa alimentá bo mes. Sin fasilidat di kushiná, eskohonan sinembargo ta limitá na kuminda kushiná kada.
eng_text: Buying food in supermarkets is usually the cheapest way to get fed. Without cooking opportunities, choices are however limited to ready-made food.

text: Mas i mas supermarketnan ta hañando un sekshon ku mas variedat di kuminda kushiná kaba. Algun asta ta ofresé un fòrnu microwave òf otro forma pa keinta e kuminda.
eng_text: Increasingly supermarkets are getting a more varied section of ready-made food. Some even provide a microwave oven or other means to heat food.

text: Den algun pais òf otro tipo di tienda tin a lo ménos un restorant na e sitio mes, hopi biaha unu basta informal ku preis barata.
eng_text: In some countries or types of stores there is at least one on-site restaurant, often a rather informal one with affordable prices.

text: Saka kopia i kana ku kopianan di bo pólisa di seguro i datonan di kontakto di bo seguro huntu ku bo.
eng_text: Make and carry copies of your policy and your insurer's contact details with you.

text: Nan mester mustra e kompania di seguro su direkshon di e-mail number i su telefòn internashonal pa konseho/outorisashon i pa entregá claimnan.
eng_text: They need to show the insurer's e-mail address and international phone numbers for advice/authorizations and making claims.

text: Warda un otro kopia den bo ekipahe i online (manda un mensahe pa bo mes ku un suplemento, òf wardá den sistema di “cloud”).
eng_text: Have another copy in your luggage and online (e-mail to yourself with attachment, or stored in the "cloud").

text: Si bo ta biaha ku un laptop òf tablet, warda un kopia den su memoria òf riba disko (aksesibel sin internèt).
eng_text: If traveling with a laptop or tablet, store a copy in its memory or disc (accessible without the internet).

text: Tambe duna kopia di bo pólisa/kontakto na bo kompañeronan di biahe i famia òf amigu na kas ku ke yuda.
eng_text: Also give policy/contact copies to traveling companions and relatives or friends back home willing to help.

text: Biná grandi (tambe konosí komo elk) no ta agresivo di karakter, pero lo defendé su mes si nan ripará un menasa.
eng_text: Moose (also known as elk) aren't inherently aggressive, but will defend themselves if they perceive a threat.

text: Ora hende no to konsiderá biná grandi komo potensialmente peligroso, nan por yega demasiado serka i pone nan mes na peliger.
eng_text: When people don't see moose as potentially dangerous, they may approach too closely and put themselves at risk.

text: Bebe bibida alkohóliko ku moderashon. Alkohòl ta afektá tur hende diferentemente, i konosé bo límite ta hopi importante.
eng_text: Drink alcoholic drinks with moderation. Alcohol affects everyone differently, and knowing your limit is very important.

text: Posibel resultado di salú pa término largu dor di bebe den ekseso por inkluí daño na higra i asta sieguedat i morto. E potensial peliger ta subi ora ta konsumí alkohòl produsí ilegalmente.
eng_text: Possible long term health events from excessive drinking can include liver damage and even blindness and death. The potential danger is increased when consuming illegally produced alcohol.

text: Alkohòl ilegal por kontené vários impuresa peligroso inkluso methanol, ku por kousa sieguedat òf morto asta na dósisnan chikitu.
eng_text: Illegal spirits can contain various dangerous impurities including methanol, which can cause blindness or death even in small doses.

text: Brel di bista por ta mas barata den un pais estranhero, spesialmente den paisnan di poko entrada kaminda kosto laboral ta mas abou.
eng_text: Eyeglasses can be cheaper in a foreign country, especially in low-income countries where labour costs are lower.

text: Konsiderá hasi un kontrol di wowo na kas, spesialmente si seguro ta kubrié, i bai ku e resèpt pa por wòrdu trahá na un otro kaminda.
eng_text: Consider getting an eye exam at home, especially if insurance covers it, and bringing the prescription along to be filed elsewhere.

text: Monturanan di marka luhoso disponibel den e áreanan ei por tin dos problema: algun por ta imitashon, i esunnan real, importá por ta mas karu ku na kas.
eng_text: High-end brand-name frames available in such areas may have two problems; some may be knock-offs, and the real imported ones may be more expensive than at home.

text: Kòfi ta un di mundu su produktonan mas bendé, i probablemente bo por haña hopi tipo den e region ku bo ta biba den.
eng_text: Coffee is one of the world's most traded commodities, and you can probably find many types in your home region.

text: Sin embargo, tin hopi diferente manera di bebe kòfi rònt mundu ku ta bal pa eksperensiá.
eng_text: Nevertheless, there are many distinctive ways of drinking coffee around the world that are worth experiencing.

text: Canyoning (òf:canyoneering) ta enserá bai na fondo di un canyon, ku ta sea seku òf yen di awa.
eng_text: Canyoning (or: canyoneering) is about going in a bottom of a canyon, which is either dry or full of water.

text: Canoying ta kombiná elementonan di landamentu, subimentu di seru, i bulamentu – pero e ta rekerí relativamente tiki práktika òf kondishon físiko pa kuminsá kuné (kompará ku rock climbing, sambuyamentu òf skimentu alpino, por ehèmpel).
eng_text: Canyoning combines elements from swimming, climbing and jumping--but requires relatively little training or physical shape to get started (compared to rock climbing, scuba diving or alpine skiing, for example).

text: Hiking ta un aktividat di aire liber ku ta konsistí di kana den un ambiente natural, hopi biaha riba rutanan di kaminata.
eng_text: Hiking is an outdoor activity which consists of walking in natural environments, often on hiking trails.

text: Hiking pa dia ta enserá distansia di ménos ku un mia te ku distansianan mas largu ku por kubri den un solo dia.
eng_text: Day hiking involves distances of less than a mile up to longer distances that can be covered in a single day.

text: Pa un hiking pa dia ta nesesario un ruta fásil ku tiki preparashon, i ku kualke persona den kondishon moderá por gosa di nan.
eng_text: For a day hike along an easy trail little preparations are needed, and any moderately fit person can enjoy them.

text: Famianan ku mucha chikí lo por tin mester di mas preparashon, pero un dia den aire liber ta fásilmente posibel te asta ku beibi i mucha ku no ta bai skol ainda.
eng_text: Families with small children may need more preparations, but a day outdoors is easily possible even with babies and pre-school children.

text: Internashonalmente, tin kasi 200 organisashon di tour di korementu. Mayoria di nan ta operá independientemente.
eng_text: Internationally, there are nearly 200 running tour organizations. Most of them operate independently.

text: Global Running Tours su susesor, Go Running Tours ta operá un ret ku desénas di provedor di sightrunning na kuater kontinente.
eng_text: The Global Running Tours successor, Go Running Tours networks dozens of sightrunning providers on four continents.

text: Ku raisnan den Barcelona su Running Tours Barcelona i Kopenhagen su Running Copenhagen, Running Tours Prague ku base na Praga, i otronan, a djòin rápidamente.
eng_text: With roots in Barcelona's Running Tours Barcelona and Copenhagen's Running Copenhagen, it was quickly joined by Running Tours Prague based in Prague and others.

text: Tin hopi kos ku bo mester tuma na konsiderashon promé ku bo biaha pa un lugá.
eng_text: There are many things you have to take into consideration before and when you travel somewhere.

text: Ora bo biaha, ferwagt ku kosnan no ta meskos “ku na kas”. Maneranan, leinan, kuminda, tráfiko, hospedahe, normanan, idioma i asina mas na sierto midí lo ta diferensiá for di kaminda bo ta biba.
eng_text: When you travel, expect things not to be like they are "back home". Manners, laws, food, traffic, lodging, standards, language and so on will to some extent differ from where you live.

text: Esaki ta algu ku bo semper mester tene na mente, pa evitá desepshon òf kisas asta disgustu tokante e maneranan lokal di hasi kos.
eng_text: This is something you always need to keep in mind, to avoid disappointment or perhaps even distaste over local ways to do things.

text: Agensianan di biahe ta eksistí kaba for di siglo 19. Un agente di biahe normalmente ta un bon opshon pa un biahe ku ta bai mas leu ku un biahero su eksperensia anterior di naturalesa, kultura, idioma òf paisnan di ingreso abou.
eng_text: Travel agencies have been around since the 19th century. A travel agent is usually a good option for a journey which extends beyond a traveller's previous experience of nature, culture, language or low-income countries.

text: Maske mayoria di agensianan ta dispuesto di tuma mas tantu reservashonnan regular, hopi agente ta spesialisá den formanan partikular di biaha, rangonan di presupuesto òf destinashonnan.
eng_text: Although most agencies are willing to take on most regular bookings, many agents specialise in particular types of travel, budget ranges or destinations.

text: Lo ta kombení pa hasi uso di un agente ku frekuentemente ta reservá biahenan similar na esun di bo.
eng_text: It can be better to use an agent who frequently books similar trips to yours.

text: Tira un bista riba kua biahenan e agente ta promové, sea ta riba un wèpsait òf den e bentana di e negoshi.
eng_text: Take a look at what trips the agent is promoting, whether on a website or in a shop window.

text: Si bo ke mira mundu na un preis barata, pa nesesidat, pa estilo di bida òf pa un reto, tin algun manera di hasi esaki.
eng_text: If you want to see the world on the cheap, for necessity, lifestyle or challenge, there are some ways to do that.

text: Básikamente, nan ta kai den dos kategoria: sea traha miéntras bo ta biaha òf purba i limitá bo gastunan. E artíkulo akí ta enfoká riba e último.
eng_text: Basically, they fall into two categories: Either work while you travel or try and limit your expenses. This article is focused on the latter.

text: Pa esunnan ku ta dispuesto di sakrifiká komodidat, tempu i pronostikabilidat pa baha gastu kasi na sero, wak biahamentu ku mínimo presupuesto di biahe.
eng_text: For those willing to sacrifice comfort, time and predictability to push expenses down close to zero, see minimum budget travel.

text: E konseho ta asumí ku e biaheronan no ta bai hòrta, subi tereno prohibí, partisipá den merkado ilegal, pidi limosna, òf na otro manera na eksplotashon di otro hende pa nan mes benefisio.
eng_text: The advice assumes that travellers do not steal, trespass, participate in the illegal market, beg, or otherwise exploit other people for their own gain.

text: Un punto di kontròl di imigrashon ta generalmente e promé stòp despues di a desembarká un avion, un barku, òf un otro vehíkulo.
eng_text: An immigration checkpoint is usually the first stop when disembarking from a plane, a ship, or another vehicle.

text: Riba algun trein ku ta krusa frontera ta hasi inspekshon riba e trein biahando, i bo mester tin un ID bálido huntu ku bo ora bo ta subi bordo di un di e treinnan ei.
eng_text: In some cross-border trains inspections are done on the running train and you should have valid ID with you when boarding one of those trains.

text: Riba treinnan di pasa nochi, pasport por keda kolektá pa e konduktor asina no tin mester di interumpí bo soño.
eng_text: On night sleeper trains, passports may be collected by the conductor so that you do not have your sleep interrupted.

text: Registrashon ta un kondishon adishonal pa e proseso di visa. Den algun pais, bo mester registrá bo presensia i adrès na unda bo ta hospedá na e outoridatnan lokal.
eng_text: Registration is an additional requirement for the visa process. In some countries, you must register your presence and address where you are staying with the local authorities.

text: Esaki por rekerí yenamentu di un formulario na polis lokal òf un bishita na e ofisina di imigrashon.
eng_text: This might require filling out a form with the local police or a visit to the immigration offices.

text: Na hopi pais ku leinan asina, hotèlnan lokal lo hèndel e registrashon (no lubidá di puntra esaki).
eng_text: In many countries with such a law, local hotels will handle the registration (make sure to ask).

text: Den otro kasonan, solamente esunnan kedando pafó di akomodashonnan turístiko mester registrá. Sinembargo, esaki ta hasi e lei hopi mas vago, pues buska pa sa di antemano.
eng_text: In other cases, only those staying outside of tourist accommodations need to register.  However, this makes the law much more obscure, so find out beforehand.

text: Arkitektura ta konserní ku e diseño i konstrukshon di edifisionan. Arkitektura di un lugá hopi biaha ta un atrakshon turístiko riba su mes.
eng_text: Architecture is concerned with the design and construction of buildings. The architecture of a place is often a tourist attraction in its own right.

text: Hopi edifisio ta basta bunita pa mira i e bista for di un edifisio haltu òf di un bentana ingeniosamente posishoná por ta un bunitesa pa memorisá.
eng_text: Many buildings are quite beautiful to look at and the view from a tall building or from a cleverly-positioned window can be a beauty to behold.

text: Arkitektura ta krusa kosiderablemente tereno di otro disiplinanan inkluso planifikashon urbano, ingenieria sivil, arte dekorativo, diseño interior i diseño di paisahe.
eng_text: Architecture overlaps considerably with other fields including urban planning, civil engineering, decorative arts, interior design and landscape design.

text: Indikando kon leu hopi di e pueblonan ta, bo lo no por haña un kantidat signifikante di bida nokturno sin biaha bai Albuquerque òf Santa Fe.
eng_text: Given how remote many of the pueblos are, you won't be able to find a significant amount of nightlife without traveling to Albuquerque or Santa Fe.

text: Sin embargo, kasi tur kasino menshoná ariba ta sirbí bibida, i vários di nan ta trese entretenementu hopi konosí (spesialmente esunnan grandi inmediatamente rondó di Albuquerque i Santa Fe).
eng_text: However, nearly all of the casinos listed above serve drinks, and several of them bring in name-brand entertainment (primarily the large ones immediately surrounding Albuquerque and Santa Fe).

text: Tene kuidou: barnan di pueblo chikitu no ta tur biaha un bon lugá pa bishitante di pafó di e estado hasi bishita.
eng_text: Beware: small-town bars here are not always good places for the out-of-state visitor to hang out.

text: Un di e motibunan, e parti nort di New Mexico tin problema signifikante ku stürmentu fuma, i e konsentrashon di shofùr fuma ta haltu serka barnan di pueblonan chikitu.
eng_text: For one thing, northern New Mexico has significant problems with drunk driving, and the concentration of intoxicated drivers is high close to small-town bars.

text: Muralnan òf pinturanan ku teksto indeseá ta konosí komo grafiti.
eng_text: Unwanted murals or scribble is known as graffiti.

text: Miéntras ku e ta leu di ta un fenómeno moderno, mayoria di hende probablemente ta asosi’é ku hubentut kometiendo vandalismo na propiedat públiko i privá usando fèrf di spùit.
eng_text: While it's far from a modern phenomenon, most people probably associate it with youth vandalizing public and private property using spray paint.

text: Sinembargo, awendia tin artistanan di grafiti establesé, eventonan i murayanan di grafiti “legal”. Pintura di grafiti den e konteksto akí hopi biaha parse obra di arte en bes di tekstonan difísil pa lesa.
eng_text: However, nowadays there are established graffiti artists, graffiti events and "legal" walls. Graffiti paintings in this context often resemble artworks rather than illegible tags.

text: Tiramentu di un boomerang ta un abilidat popular ku hopi turista ke atkirí.
eng_text: Boomerang throwing is a popular skill that many tourists want to acquire.

text: Si bo ke siña kon pa tira un boomerang ku ta bin bèk den bo man, sigurá bo mes ku bo tin un boomerang adekuá pa regresá.
eng_text: If you want to learn throwing a boomerang that comes back to your hand, make sure you have a suitable boomerang for returning.

text: Mayoria di boomerangnan ku ta disponibel na Oustralia ta de echo esunnan ku no ta regresá. Ta mihó pa nobatonan no purba tira den hopi bientu
eng_text: Most boomerangs available in Australia are in fact non-returning. It is best for beginners to not try throwing in windy

text: Un plato Hangi ta kushiná den un buraku kayente den tera.
eng_text: A Hangi Meal is cooked in a hot pit in the ground.

text: E buraku ta sea wòrdu keinta ku piedra kayente di un kandela, òf na algun lugá, kayente geotérmiko ta hasi e área di tera kayente di forma natural.
eng_text: The pit is either heated with hot stones from a fire, or in some places geothermal heat makes areas of ground naturally hot.

text: E buraku hangi hopi biaha ta wòrdu usá pa kushiná sena estilo alaparia tradishonal.
eng_text: The hangi is often used to cook a traditional roast style dinner.

text: Vários lugá na Rotorua ta ofresé hangi geotérmiko, miéntras otro hangi por wòrdu purba na Christchurch, Welligton i otro kaminda.
eng_text: Several places in Rotorua offer geothermal hangi, while other hangi can be sampled in Christchurch, Wellington and elsewhere.

text: MetroRail tin dos klase riba e treinnan di pasahero ku ta bai trabou den i rondó di Cape Town: MetroPlus (tambe yamá Promé Klase) i Metro (yamá Terser Klase).
eng_text: MetroRail has two classes on commuter trains in and around Cape Town: MetroPlus (also called First Class) and Metro (called Third Class).

text: MetroPlus ta mas kómodo i ménos drùk pero un tiki mas karu, ounke ainda mas barata ku e ticketnan normal di metro na Oropa.
eng_text: MetroPlus is more comfortable and less crowded but slightly more expensive, though still cheaper than normal metro tickets in Europe.

text: Tur trein tin ámbos wagònnan di MetroPlus i di Metro; e wagòn di MetroPlus ta semper na final di e trein mas serka di Cape Town.
eng_text: Every train has both MetroPlus and Metro coaches; the MetroPlus coaches are always on the end of the train nearest Cape Town.

text: Kuido pa otro – Nunka laga bo tasnan for di bo bista, spesialmente ora bo ta krusa frontera internashonal.
eng_text: Carrying for others - Never let your bags out of your sight, especially when you are crossing international borders.

text: Bo por haña bo mes usá komo un mula di droga sin bo konosementu, ku lo hinka bo den hopi problema.
eng_text: You could find yourself being used as a drug carrier without your knowledge, which will land you in a great deal of trouble.

text: Esaki ta inkluí warda den rei, miéntras ku kachó pa hole droga por wòrdu usá na kualke momentu sin aviso.
eng_text: This includes waiting in line, as drug-sniffing dogs could be used at any time without notice.

text: Algun pais tin kastigu hopi kruel asta pa un hende ku un promé violashon, nan por enserá kastigu di prisòn di mas ku 10 aña òf pena kapital.
eng_text: Some countries have exceedingly draconian punishments even for first time offenses; these can include prison sentences of over 10 years or death.

text: Tasnan deskuidá ta un blanko pa ladronisia i por tambe atraé atenshon di outoridatnan ku ta kouteloso pa menasa di bòm.
eng_text: Unattended bags are a target for theft and can also attract attention from authorities wary of bomb threats.

text: Na kas, dor di e eksibishon konstante na e bakterianan lokal, e probabilidat ta hopi grandi ku bo ta inmune na nan kaba.
eng_text: At home, due to this constant exposure to the local germs, odds are very high that you're already immune to them.

text: Pero na otro parti di mundu, kaminda e founa bakteriológiko ta nobo pa bo, ta muchu mas probabel ku bo ta bai haña problemanan.
eng_text: But in other parts of the world, where the bacteriological fauna are new to you, you're far more likely to run into problems.

text: Tambe, den klima mas kayente bakteria ta krese tantu mas lihé komo ta sobrebibí mas largu pafó di e kurpa.
eng_text: Also, in warmer climates bacteria both grow more quickly and survive longer outside the body.

text: Asina pues e plaga di Dheli Belly, e Maldishon di e Fárao, Vengansa di Montezuma, i nan hopi amigunan.
eng_text: Thus the scourges of Delhi Belly, the Pharaoh's Curse, Montezuma's Revenge, and their many friends.

text: Meskos ku problema respiratorio den klima mas friu, problema di tripa, den klima kayente ta hopi komun i den mayoria di e kasonan ta klaramente desagradabel pero no realmente peligroso.
eng_text: As with respiratory problems in colder climates, intestinal problems in hot climates are fairly common and in most cases are distinctly annoying but not really dangerous.

text: Si ta biaha pa di promé biaha den un pais den desaroyo – òf den un parti nobo di mundu – no supestimá e posibilidat di shòk di kultura.
eng_text: If traveling in a developing country for the first time – or in a new part of the world – don't underestimate the potential culture shock.

text: Hopi biahero stabil, kapas a keda sorprendé pa e novedat di biahamentu na paisnan den desaroyo, kaminda hopi ahuste kultural chikitu por akumulá hopi lihé.
eng_text: Many a stable, capable traveler has been overcome by the newness of developing world travel, where many little cultural adjustments can add up quickly.

text: Spesialmente den bo dianan inisial, konsiderá di gasta na un estilo di mundu desaroyá i hotèlnan di kalidat, kuminda, i servisio pa yuda adaptá.
eng_text: Especially in your initial days, consider splurging on Western-style and -quality hotels, food, and services to help acclimatize.

text: No drumi riba matras òf kusinchi riba suela den áreanan ku bo no konosé e founa lokal.
eng_text: Do not sleep on a mattress or pad on the ground in areas where you do not know the local fauna.

text: Si bo ta kamper, trese un kòt pa tènt òf hamaka pa tene bo leu for di e kolebranan, skòrpionnan i demas.
eng_text: If you are going to camp out, bring a camp cot or hammock to keep you away from snakes, scorpions and such.

text: Yena bo kas ku un kòfi riku mainta i algu di te relahante di kaneleblum anochi.
eng_text: Fill your home with a rich coffee in the morning and some relaxing chamomile tea at night.

text: Ora bo ta na un staycation, bo tin e oportunidat di trit bo mes i tuma un par di minüt èkstra pa hasi algu spesial.
eng_text: When you're on a staycation, you have the time to treat yourself and take a few extra minutes to brew up something special.

text: Si bo ta sinti bo mas aventurero, tuma e oportunidat pa traha djus òf traha algun smoothies:
eng_text: If you're feeling more adventurous, take the opportunity to juice or blend up some smoothies:

text: Por ta, lo bo diskubrí un simpel bibida ku bo por traha pa desayuno ora bo kai bèk den bo rutina diario.
eng_text: maybe you'll discover a simple beverage that you can make for breakfast when you're back to your daily routine.

text: Si bo ta biba den un siudat ku un kultura variá di bebementu, bishitá barnan òf botekinnan den barionan ku bo no ta frekuentá.
eng_text: If you live in a city with a varied drinking culture, go to bars or pubs in neighborhoods you don't frequent.

text: Pa esunnan ku no konosé e idioma médiko, e palabranan infeksioso i kontagioso tin diferente nifikashon.
eng_text: For those unfamiliar with medical jargon, the words infectious and contagious have distinct meanings.

text: Un malesa infeksioso ta unu ku ta wòrdu kousá dor di un gérmen di enfermedat, manera un vírùs, bakteria, fungus òf otro parasit.
eng_text: An infectious disease is one that is caused by a pathogen, such as a virus, bacterium, fungus or other parasites.

text: Un malesa kontagioso ta un malesa ku ta wòrdu transmití fásilmente dor di yega den serkania di un persona infektá.
eng_text: A contagious disease is a disease which is easily transmitted by being in the vicinity of an infected person.

text: Hopi gobièrnu ta rekerí di bishitantenan ku ta drenta, òf habitantenan ku ta sali, nan pais pa ta bakuná kontra un variedat di malesa.
eng_text: Many governments require visitors entering, or residents leaving, their countries to be vaccinated for a range of diseases.

text: E rekisitonan akí hopi biaha lo por dependé di kua paisnan e biahero a bishitá òf tin intenshon di bishita.
eng_text: These requirements may often depend on what countries a traveller has visited or intends to visit.

text: Un di e puntonan fuerte di Charlotte, North Carolina, ta ku e tin un abundansia di opshon di kalidat haltu pa famia.
eng_text: One of strong points of Charlotte, North Carolina, is that it has an abundance of high-quality options for families.

text: Habitante di otro área hopi bia ta sita amabilidat di famia komo un motibu prinsipal pa muda p’ei, i bishitante hopi bia ta haña e siudat fásil pa gosa di dje den kompania di mucha.
eng_text: Residents from other areas often cite family-friendliness as a primary reason for moving there, and visitors often find the city easy to enjoy with children around.

text: Den e delaster 20 añanan e kantidat di opshon amikabel pa mucha na Uptown Charlotte (e área residensial di Charlotte) a krese eksponensialmente.
eng_text: In the past 20 years, the amount of child-friendly options in Uptown Charlotte has grown exponentially.

text: Generalmente famianan na Charlotte no ta usa taksi, ounke ku den sierto sirkunstansha nan por ta bon pa usa.
eng_text: Taxis are not generally used by families in Charlotte, though they can be of some use in certain circumstances.

text: Tin un sobrekarga pa tin mas ku 2 pasahero, pues e opshon aki por ta mas karu ku ta nesesario.
eng_text: There is a surcharge for having more than 2 passengers, so this option might be more expensive than necessary.

text: Antártika ta e sitio mas friu na mundu, i ta rondoná Polo Sùit.
eng_text: Antarctica is the coldest place on Earth, and surrounds the South Pole.

text: Bishita di turista ta kostoso, ta eksigí bon kondishon físiko, por tuma lugá solamente den zomer nov-feb, i ta limitá na e península, islanan i Ross Sea.
eng_text: Tourist visits are costly, demand physical fitness, can only take place in summer Nov-Feb, and are largely limited to the Peninsula, Islands and Ross Sea.

text: Un par di mil empleado ta biba aki den zomer den algun kuater dozèin di basenan mas biaha den e áreanan ei; un kantidat schikitu di persona ta keda pasa wenter.
eng_text: A couple of thousand staff live here in summer in some four dozen bases mostly in those areas; a small number stay over winter.

text: Den interior di Antártika tin un alto planisie ku ta kubrí ku 2-3 km di eis.
eng_text: Inland Antarctica is a desolate plateau covered by 2-3 km of ice.

text: Na sierto okashon tin tour aéreo di spesialista ta bai den interior, pa subi seru òf pa yega te na e polo, kaminda tin un base grandi.
eng_text: Occasional specialist air tours go inland, for mountaineering or to reach the Pole, which has a large base.

text: E Traverso (òf Pista) di Antárktika ta un pat di 1600 kilometer di Stashon McMurdo na Laman Ross te na e Polo.
eng_text: The South Pole Traverse (or Highway) is a 1600 km trail from McMurdo Station on the Ross Sea to the Pole.

text: Ta sneu kompakto ku skref yená i marká ku bandera. Por biaha aki solamente ku trèktòr spesialisá, ku ta hala vehíkulo pa slep riba sneu ku kombustibel i nesesidat.
eng_text: It's compacted snow with crevasses filled in and marked by flags. It can only be traveled by specialized tractors, hauling sleds with fuel and supplies.

text: Esakinan no ta masha manehabel ke men e pat mester tuma un birada grandi rònt di e Serunan Transantárktiko pa yega na e alto planisie.
eng_text: These aren't very nimble so the trail has to take a long swerve around the Transantarctic Mountains to come onto the plateau.

text: E kousa di mas komun pa aksidente den wenter ta kaminda ku ta slep, asera i espesialmente trapi.
eng_text: The most common cause for accidents in winter is slippery roads, pavements (sidewalks) and especially steps.

text: Minimalmente bo mester di sapatu ku solé adekuá. Sapatu di zomer mayoria bia ta slep masha riba eis i sneu, asta algun buts di wenter ta defisiente.
eng_text: At a minimum, you need footwear with suitable soles. Summer shoes are usually very slippery on ice and snow, even some winter boots are deficient.

text: E patronchi mester ta sufisiente hundu, 5 mm (1/5 inch) òf mas i e material sufisiente moli den temperatura friu.
eng_text: The pattern should be deep enough, 5 mm (1/5 inch) or more, and the material soft enough in cold temperatures.

text: Algun buts tin klabu i tin material ku klabu pa usa pa kondishonnan ku ta slep, ku ta sirbi pa mayoria di sapatu i buts, pa hilchi òf hilchi i solé.
eng_text: Some boots have studs and there is studded add-on equipment for slippery conditions, suitable for most shoes and boots, for the heels or heels and sole.

text: E hilchinan mester ta abou i hanchu. Hopi bia ta basha santu, pieda òf salu (calcium chloride) riba kaminda òf pat pa mehorá grep.
eng_text: Heels should be low and wide. Sand, gravel or salt (calcium chloride) is often scattered on roads or paths to improve traction.

text: Avalancha no ta un apnormalidat; inklinashon perpendikular por wanta solamente un sierto kantidat di sneu, i e volúmen di mas lo bini abou komo avalancha.
eng_text: Avalanches are not an abnormality; steep slopes can hold only so much slow, and the excess volumes will come down as avalanches.

text: E problema ta ku sneu ta pega, ke men e mester di un impulsa pa bini abou, i poko sneu biniendo abou por ta e evento ku ta impulsá e sobrá.
eng_text: The problem is that snow is sticky, so it needs some triggering to come down, and some snow coming down can be the triggering event for the rest.

text: Tin bia e evento di impulsa original ta solo ku ta keinta e sneu, tin bia ta mas kaida di sneu, tin bia ta otro evento natural, hopi bia kousá pa hende.
eng_text: Sometimes the original trigging event is the sun warming the snow, sometimes some more snowfall, sometimes other natural events, often a human.

text: Un warwarú ta un kolumna di airu ku preshon masha abou ku ta drei rònt, ku ta chupa tur e airu rònt di dje aden i pa ariba.
eng_text: A tornado is a spinning column of very low-pressure air, which sucks the surrounding air inward and upward.

text: Nan ta generá bientu fuerte (hopi bia di 100 pa 200 mia pa ora) i nan por hisa opheto pisa den laira, kargando nan bai kuné segun e warwarú ta move.
eng_text: They generate high winds (often 100-200 miles/hour) and can lift heavy objects into the air, carrying them as the tornado moves.

text: Nan ta kuminsá manera trèktu bahando for di nubia di tempestat i nan ta bira “tornado”, ora nan mishi ku tera.
eng_text: They begin as funnels descending from storm clouds, and become "tornadoes" when they touch the ground.

text: Suministradó personal di VPN (virtual private network, nètwèrk virtual privá) ta un manera ekselente pa evitá tantu sensura polítiko i geo filtramentu komersial di IP.
eng_text: Personal VPN (virtual private network) providers are an excellent way of circumventing both political censorship and commercial IP-geofiltering.

text: Nan ta superior na web proxy pa diferente motibu: Nan ta re-dirigí tur tráfiko di Internet, no solamente http.
eng_text: They are superior to web proxies for several reasons: They re-route all Internet traffic, not only http.

text: Normalmente nan ta ofresé un hanchura di banda mas haltu i mihó kalidat di servisio. Nan ta kodifiká i asina mas difísil pa spioná.
eng_text: They normally offer higher bandwidth and better quality of service. They are encrypted and thus harder to spy on.

text: E kompanianan di media tin kustumber di gaña tokante e meta di esaki, bisando ku ta pa “prevení pirateria”.
eng_text: The media companies routinely lie about the purpose of this, claiming that it is to "prevent piracy".

text: Bon mirá, kódigo regional apsolutamente no tin efekto riba kopiamentu ilegal; un kopia di un disko bit pa bit ta toka bon riba kualke aparato kaminda e original ta toka.
eng_text: In fact, region codes have absolutely no effect on illegal copying; a bit-for-bit copy of a disk will play just fine on any device where the original will.

text: E meta aktual ta pa duna e kompanianan ei mas kòntròl di nan merkadonan; ta un asuntu di lora sèn.
eng_text: The actual purpose is to give those companies more control over their markets; it's all about money spinning.

text: Pasobra ta pasa e yamadanan via Internet, bo no tin nodi di usa un kompania di telefòn situá kaminda bo ta biba òf kaminda bo ta biaha.
eng_text: Because calls are routed over the Internet, you do not need to use a phone company located where you live or where you travel.

text: Tampoko no ta un eksigensia pa bo optené un number lokal di e komunidat kaminda bo ta biba; bo por optené un konekshon di satélite di Internet den mondi di Chicken, Alaska i selektá un number ku ta bisa ku bo ta na Arizona den solo.
eng_text: There is also no requirement that you obtain a local number from the community in which you live; you can obtain a satellite Internet connection in the wilds of Chicken, Alaska and select a number which claims you're in sunny Arizona.

text: Hopi bia, bo mester kumpra un number global separá ku ta laga e telefònnan di PSTN yama bo. E kaminda for di kua e number ta originá ta hasi un diferensia pa e hendenan ku ta yama bo.
eng_text: Often, you have to buy a global number separately that allows PSTN phones to call you. Where the number is from makes a difference for people calling you.

text: App di tradukshon di teksto den tempu berdadero - aplikashon ku ta kapas di tradusí outomátikamente henter segmento di teksto di un idioma pa un otro.
eng_text: Real-time text translator apps – applications that are capable of automatically translating whole segments of text from one language into another.

text: Algun di e aplikashonnan den e kategoria aki asta por tradusí teksto den idioma strañero riba bòrchi òf otro opheto den e mundu real ora e usadó dirigí e smartphone den direkshon di e ophetonan ei.
eng_text: Some of the applications in this category can even translate texts in foreign languages on signs or other objects in the real world when the user points the smartphone towards those objects.

text: E mashinnan di tradukshon a mehorá dramátikamente i awor hopi bia ta duna tradukshon mas o ménos korekto (i mas sporádikamente disparati), pero mester kuida poko sí, komo ku ainda nan por ta kompletamente herá.
eng_text: The translation engines have improved dramatically, and now often give more or less correct translations (and more seldom gibberish), but some care is due, as they still may have gotten it all wrong.

text: Un di e appnan di mas prominente den e kategoria aki ta Google Translate, ku ta permití tradukshon offline despues di download e informashon na e idioma deseá.
eng_text: One of the most prominent apps in this category is Google Translate, which allows offline translation after downloading the desired language data.

text: Usando app di nabegashon di GPS riba bo smartphone por ta e manera di mas fásil i kumbiniente pa nabegá ora bo no ta den bo pais.
eng_text: Using GPS navigation apps on your smartphone can be the easiest and most convenient way to navigate when out of your home country.

text: E por spar sèn pa kumpra mapa nobo pa un GPS, òf un aparato di GPS riba su mes òf hür unu di un kompania di hür outo.
eng_text: It can save money over buying new maps for a GPS, or a standalone GPS device or renting one from a car rental company.

text: Si bo no tin konekshon di data pa bo telefòn, òf si e ta fuera di alkanse, nan funshonamentu por ta limitá òf no optenibel.
eng_text: If you don't have a data connection for your phone, or when it is out of range, their performance can be limited or unavailable.

text: Kada pakus di skina di kaya ta yen di un seri konfundí di karchi di telefòn pre-pago ku por usa for di sèl di telefòn públiko òf telefòn normal.
eng_text: Every corner store is filled with a confusing array of pre-paid phone cards that can be used from pay phones or ordinary telephones.

text: Miéntras mayoria di karchi ta sirbi pa yama unda ku ta, tin ta spesialisá den dunamentu di tarifa di yamada faborabel pa grupo òf pais spesífiko.
eng_text: While most cards are good for calling anywhere, some specialise in providing favourable call rates to specific groups of countries.

text: Akseso na e servisionan aki mayoria parti ta via un number di telefòn toll-free ku por yama for di mayoria di telefòn sin paga.
eng_text: Access to these services is often through a toll-free telephone number that can be called from most phones without charge.

text: Regla tokante fotografia regular tambe ta apliká pa grabashon di vidio, posiblemente asta mas.
eng_text: Rules regarding regular photography also apply to video recording, possibly even more so.

text: Si djis saka un potrèt di algu no ta permití, bo no mester pensa mes pa graba un vidio di dje.
eng_text: If just taking a photo of something isn't allowed, then you shouldn't even think of recording a video of it.

text: Si bo ta usa un drone, chèk bon delantá kiko bo ta permití di filma i ki tipo di pèrmit òf lisensia adishonal ta rekerí.
eng_text: If using a drone, check well in advance as to what you are allowed to film and what permits or additional licensing are required.

text: Pa laga un drone bula serka di un aeropuerto òf pasa riba un multitut di hende kasi semper ta un mal idea, asta si esaki no ta ilegal den bo área.
eng_text: Flying a drone near an airport or over a crowd is almost always a bad idea, even if it's not illegal in your area.

text: Awendia masha poko ta buk biahe aéreo direktamente via e kompania di aviashon sin promé buska i kompará preis.
eng_text: Nowadays air travel is only rarely booked directly through the airline without first searching and comparing prices.

text: Tin bia e mésun buelo por tin preis hopi diferente serka vários website di komparashon i ta bal la pena di kompará e resultadonan di búskeda i tambe pa wak e website di e kompania di aviashon mes promé ku buk.
eng_text: Sometimes the same flight can have vastly differing prices at various agregators and it pays to compare search results and to also look at the website of the airline itself before booking.

text: Ounke kisas bo no mester di un visa pa bishita kòrtiku pa sierto pais komo turista òf pa negoshi, pa bai ei komo studiante internashonal generalmente mester di un estadia mas largu ku si bai djis komo un turista kasual.
eng_text: While you may not need a visa for short visits to certain countries as a tourist or for business, going there as an international student generally requires a longer stay than going there just as a casual tourist.

text: Generalmente pa keda den kualke pais strañero pa un temporada largu lo hasi nesesario pa bo optené un visa delantá.
eng_text: In general, staying in any foreign country for an extended period of time will require you to obtain a visa in advance.

text: Visa di studiante generalmente tin diferente eksigensia i prosedura di petishon for di visa normal di turista òf pa negoshi.
eng_text: Student visas generally have different requirements and application procedures from normal tourist or business visas.

text: Pa mayoria di pais, bo mester di un karta di oferta di e instituto kaminda bo ke bai studia, i tambe prueba di fondo pa sostené bo mes pa por lo ménos e promé aña di bo kurso.
eng_text: For most countries, you will need an offer letter from the institution you wish to study at, and also evidence of funds to support yourself for at least the first year of your course.

text: Chèk ku e institushon i tambe e departamento di imigrashon di e pais kaminda bo ke studia pa eksigensia detayá.
eng_text: Check with the institution, as well as the immigration department for the country you wish to study in for detailed requirements.

text: A ménos ku bo ta un diplomátiko, traha den eksterior generalmente ta nifiká ku bo mester deklará impuesto riba entrada na e pais kaminda bo ta basá.
eng_text: Unless you are a diplomat, working overseas generally means that you will have to file income tax in the country you are based in.

text: Impuesto di entrada ta strukturá distintamente den diferente pais, i e tarifanan i gruponan di impuesto ta varia hopi di un pais pa otro.
eng_text: Income tax is structured differently in different countries, and the tax rates and brackets vary widely from one country to another.

text: Na algun pais federal, manera Estádos Unídos i Canada, ta kobra impuesto tantu na e nivel federal komo na e nivel lokal, ke men e tarifanan i kategorianan por varia di region pa region.
eng_text: In some federal countries, such as the United States and Canada, income tax is levied both at the federal level and at the local level, so the rates and brackets can vary from region to region.

text: Miéntras kòntròl di imigrashon mayoria parti no tei òf e ta un formalidat ora bo regresá na bo pais, kòntròl di duana por ta un molèster.
eng_text: While immigration check is usually absent or a formality when you arrive in your homeland, customs control can be a hassle.

text: Sigurá bo mes di loke bo por i no por trese i deklará tur kos ku ta surpasá e límite legal.
eng_text: Make sure you know what you can and cannot bring in and declare anything over the legal limits.

text: E manera di mas fásil pa kuminsá den e negoshi di skibi tokante biahamentu ta pa mehorá bo abilidatnan riba un website establesé di blog di biaha.
eng_text: The easiest way to get started in the business of travel writing is to hone your skills on an established travel blog website.

text: Despues ku bo kustumá ku formatting i editing riba web, e ora ei despues lo bo por krea bo propio website.
eng_text: After you become comfortable with formatting and editing on the web, then later, you might create your own website.

text: Pa ta boluntario miéntras ku ta biaha ta un manera masha bon pa hasi un diferensia pero no ta trata solamente di duna.
eng_text: Volunteering while travelling is a great way to make a difference but it's not just about giving.

text: Pa biba i ta boluntario den un pais strañero ta un manera ekselente pa siña konosé un kultura diferente, topa hende nobo, siña tokante bo mes, haña un sentido di perspektiva i asta optené abilidat nobo.
eng_text: Living and volunteering in a foreign country is a great way to get to know a different culture, meet new people, learn about yourself, get a sense of perspective and even gain new skills.

text: Por ta bon tambe pa rèk un budget pa permití un estadia mas largu un kaminda, komo ku hopi trabou di boluntario ta duna kaminda pa keda i kome i algun di nan ta paga un salario chikí.
eng_text: It can also be a good way to stretch a budget to allow a longer stay somewhere since many volunteer jobs provide room and board and a few pay a small salary.

text: Vikingnan a usa e riunan ruso pa yega na Laman Pretu i Laman di Caspia. Partinan di e rutanan aki ainda por usa. Chèk si mester di pèrmit spesial, ku por ta difísil pa optené.
eng_text: Vikings used the Russian waterways to get to the Black Sea and Caspian Sea. Parts of these routes can still be used. Check possible need for special permits, which may be difficult to get.

text: Laman Blanku-Kanal Báltiko ta konektá Laman Árktiko ku Laman Báltiko via Lago Onega, Lago Ladoga i Sint Petersburg, pa gran parti ku riu i lago.
eng_text: The White Sea–Baltic Canal connects the Arctic Ocean to the Baltic Sea, via Lake Onega, Lake Ladoga and Saint Petersburg, mostly by rivers and lakes.

text: Lago Onega tambe ta konektá ku Volga, pues biniendo for di Laman di Kaspia pasa den Rusia ainda ta posibel.
eng_text: Lake Onega is also connected to Volga, so coming from the Caspian Sea through Russia is still possible.

text: Sea sigurá ku únabes bo yega e marinanan tur kos lo ta basta opvio. Lo bo topa otro hende ku ta tuma kabe’i boto riba barku i nan lo kompartí nan informashon ku bo.
eng_text: Be assured that once you hit the marinas everything will be pretty obvious. You will meet other boat hitchhikers and they will share their information with you.

text: Básikamente lo bo publiká notifikashon ofresiendo bo yudansa, kana bai bini na e dòknan, aserká hende ku ta limpia nan yate, trata di haña kontakto ku e matrosnan den e bar, ets.
eng_text: Basically you'll be putting up notices offering your help, pacing the docks, approaching people cleaning their yachts, trying to make contact with sailors in the bar, etc.

text: Trata di papia ku mas tantu hende posibel. Despues di un tempu tur hende lo konosé bo i duna bo tep tokante kua boto ta buska un hende.
eng_text: Try to talk to as many people as possible. After a while everyone will know you and will give you hints as to which boat is looking for someone.

text: Bo mester skohe bo aerolínea di Frequent Flyer (Buladó Frekuente) den un aliansa metikulosamente.
eng_text: You should choose your Frequent Flyer airline in an alliance carefully.

text: Ounke bo por kere ku ta intuitivo pa djòin e aerolínea ku bo ta bula kuné mas tantu, bo mester ta konsiente ku e privilegionan ku ta ofresé hopi bia ta diferente i e puntonan di biahero frekuente por ta mas generoso bou di un aerolínea diferente den e mésun aliansa.
eng_text: Although you may think it is intuitive to join the airline you fly most, you should be aware that privileges offered are often different and frequent flyer points may be more generous under a different airline in the same alliance.

text: Aerolíneanan manera Emirates, Etihad Airways, Qatar Airways i Turkish Airlines a ekspandé nan servisionan pa Áfrika enormemente, i ta ofresé konekshon pa hopi siudat afrikano prinsipal ku preis [mas] kompetitivo ku otro aerolínea oropeo.
eng_text: Airlines such as Emirates, Etihad Airways, Qatar Airways & Turkish Airlines have greatly expanded their services to Africa, and offer connections to many major African cities at competitive rates than other European airlines.

text: Turkish Airlines ta bula pa 39 destinashon den 30 pais afrikano for di 2014.
eng_text: Turkish Airlines flies to 39 destinations in 30 African countries as of 2014.

text: Si bo tin tempu adishonal pa biaha, chèk pa mira kon bo tarifa di pasashi total pa Áfrika ta kompará ku un tarifa di rònt mundu.
eng_text: If you have additional travel time, check to see how your total fare quote to Africa compares with a round-the-world fare.

text: No lubidá di agregá e gastunan èkstra di visa adishonal, impuesto di salida, transportashon na tera, ets. pa tur e lugánan ei pafó di Áfrika.
eng_text: Don't forget to add in the extra costs of additional visas, departure taxes, ground transportation, etc. for all those places outside of Africa.

text: Si bo ke bula rònt mundu kompletamente den e Hemisferio Sur, e eskoho di buelo i destinashon ta limitá pa motibu di falta di ruta transoseániko.
eng_text: If you want to fly around the world completely in the Southern Hemisphere, the choice of flights and destinations is limited due to the lack of transoceanic routes.

text: Niun aliansa di kompania aéreo no ta kubri krusamentu di tur tres oséano den e Hemisferio Sur (i Sky Team no ta kubri niun di e krusamentunan).
eng_text: No airline alliance covers all three ocean crossings in the Southern Hemisphere (and SkyTeam covers none of the crossings).

text: Sinembargo, Star Alliance ta kubri tur kos ku eksepshon di e Sur Pasífiko oriental di Santiago de Chile pa Tahiti ku ta un buelo di LATAM Oneworld.
eng_text: However, Star Alliance covers everything except the eastern South Pacific from Santiago de Chile to Tahiti, which is a LATAM Oneworld flight.

text: E buelo aki no ta e úniko opshon si bo ke salta e área Sur Pasífiko i e kosta wèst di Suramerika. (mira aki bou)
eng_text: This flight is not the only option if you want to skip the South Pacific and the west coast of South America. (see below)

text: Na 1994, e region étnikamente armenio Nagorno-Karabakh di Azerbaijan a hiba un guera kontra e Azerinan.
eng_text: In 1994, the ethnically Armenian Nagorno-Karabakh region of Azerbaijan waged war against the Azeris.

text: Ku sosten di Armenia, a krea un repúblika nobo. Sinembargo, niun nashon establesé - ni sikiera Armenia - no ta rekonos’é ofishalmente.
eng_text: With Armenian backing, a new republic was created. However, no established nation - not even Armenia - officially recognizes it.

text: Diskushonnan diplomátiko tokante e region ta kontinuá di daña relashonnan entre Armenia i Azerbaijan.
eng_text: Diplomatic arguments over the region continue to mar relations between Armenia and Azerbaijan.

text: E distrito di kanal (hulandes: Grachtengordel) ta e distrito famoso di siglo 17 ku ta rondoná e Binnenstad di Amsterdam.
eng_text: The Canal District (Dutch: Grachtengordel) is the famous 17th-century district surrounding the Binnenstad of Amsterdam.

text: Henter e distrito ta designá komo Sitio di Herensia Mundial di UNESCO pa su balor kultural i históriko úniko, i e balor di su propiedatnan ta entre e di mas haltu di e pais.
eng_text: The whole district is designated as a UNESCO World Heritage Site for its unique cultural and historical value, and its property values are among the highest of the country.

text: Cinque Terre, ku ta nifiká Sinku Tera, ta konsistí di e sinku pueblonan chikí na kosta: Riomaggiore, Manarola, Corniglia, Vernazza i Monterosso, lokalisá den e region italiano di Liguria.
eng_text: Cinque Terre, which means Five Lands, comprises the five small coastal villages of Riomaggiore, Manarola, Corniglia, Vernazza and Monterosso located in the Italian region of Liguria.

text: Nan ta pará riba e Lista di Herensia Mundial di UNESCO.
eng_text: They are listed on the UNESCO World Heritage List.

text: Den kurso di siglonan, hende koutelosamente a konstruí terasa riba e paisahe brutu i perpendikular te na e barankanan ku ta mira riba laman.
eng_text: Over the centuries, people have carefully built terraces on the rugged, steep landscape right up to the cliffs that overlook the sea.

text: Parti di su grasia ta e falta di desaroyo visibel di kompania. Pat, trein i boto ta konektá e pueblonan, i outo no por yega serka nan djafó.
eng_text: Part of its charm is the lack of visible corporate development. Paths, trains and boats connect the villages, and cars cannot reach them from the outside.

text: E variedatnan di franses ku ta papia na Bèlgika i Suisa ta un poko diferente di e franses ku ta papia nan Fransia, ounke nan ta sufisiente similar pa ta mutuamente komprendibel.
eng_text: The varieties of French which are spoken in Belgium and Switzerland differ slightly from the French spoken in France, though they are similar enough to be mutually intelligible.

text: Partikularmente e sistema di number na Bèlgika i Suisa kaminda ta papia franses tin algun pekuliaridat leve ku ta diferente di e franses ku ta papia na Fransia, i e pronunsiashon di algun palabra ta un tiki diferente.
eng_text: In particular, the numbering system in French-speaking Belgium and Switzerland has some slight peculiarities that are different from the French spoken in France, and the pronunciation of some words is slightly different.

text: Sinembargo, tur hende di Bèlgika i Suisa ku ta papia franses lo a siña franses standart na skol, ke men nan lo por komprondé bo asta si bo usa e sistema di number standart franses.
eng_text: Nevertheless, all French-speaking Belgians and Swiss would have learned standard French in school, so they would be able to understand you even if you used the standard French numbering system.

text: Na hopi parti di mundu, zuai man ta un gesto kariñoso, ku ta indiká “kontabai.”
eng_text: In many parts of the world, waving is a friendly gesture, indicating "hello."

text: Sinembargo na Malaysia, alménos entre e malayonan den áreanan rural, e ke men “bini aki” meskos ku si dobla e dede di mustra den direkshon di e kurpa, un gesto ku sa usa den sierto pais oksidental, i ku mester usa solamente pa e meta ei.
eng_text: However, in Malaysia, at least among the Malays in rural areas, it means "come over," similar to the index finger bent toward the body, a gesture which is used in certain Western countries, and should be used only for that purpose.

text: Meskos, un biahero britániko na Spaña por konfundí un saludo di despedida ku e planta di man pa kara di esun ku ta yama ayó (i no pa e persona ku ta risibí e saludo) komo un gesto pa bini bèk.
eng_text: Similarly, a British traveller in Spain may mistake a wave goodbye involving the palm facing the waver (rather than the person being waved at) as a gesture to come back.

text: Idioma ouksiliar ta idioma artifisial òf konstruí, kreá ku e intenshon pa fasilitá komunikashon entre hende ku di un otro manera lo tabatin difikultat pa komuniká.
eng_text: Auxiliary languages are artificial or constructed languages created with the intent of facilitating communication between peoples who would otherwise have difficulty communicating.

text: Nan ta separá di lingua franca, ku ta idioma natural òf orgániko ku ta bira dominante pa un òf otro motibu komo un medio di komunikashon entre papiadó di otro idioma.
eng_text: They are separate from lingua francas, which are natural or organic languages that become dominant for one reason or another as means of communication between speakers of other languages.

text: Den e kalor di den dia, biahero por eksperensiá fata morgana ku ta duna e ilushon di awa (òf otro kos).
eng_text: In the heat of the day, travelers can experience mirages that give the illusion of water (or other things).

text: Esakinan por ta peligroso si e biahero sigui e fata morgana, gastando energia presioso i sobrá di awa.
eng_text: These can be dangerous if the traveler pursue the mirage, wasting precious energy and remaining water.

text: Asta e desiertonan di mas kalor por bira ekstremamente friu anochi. Hipotermia ta un riesgo real sin paña ku ta wanta friu.
eng_text: Even the hottest of deserts can become extremely cold at night. Hypothermia is a real risk without warm clothing.

text: Espesialmente den zomer bo mester tene kuidou ku sangura si bo disidí di kana dor di e selva tropikal.
eng_text: In summer, especially, you'll need to watch out for mosquitoes if you decide to hike through the rainforest.

text: Asta si bo ta kore pasa den e selva suptropikal, algun sekònde ku porta habri miéntras ku bo ta drenta e vehíkulo ta sufisiente tempu pa sangura drenta den e vehíkulo ku bo.
eng_text: Even if you're driving through the subtropical rainforest, a few seconds with the doors open while you get inside the vehicle is enough time for mosquitoes to get in the vehicle with you.

text: Grip di para, òf mas formalmente influenza di para, por infektá tantu para komo mamífero.
eng_text: Bird flu, or more formally avian influenza, can infect both birds and mammals.

text: A yega di raportá ménos ku mil kaso serka hende, pero tin di nan tabata fatal.
eng_text: Fewer than a thousand cases have ever been reported in humans, but some of them have been fatal.

text: Mayoria a envolví hende ku ta traha ku bestia di pluma, pero tin poko riesgo tambe pa hende ku ta opservá para.
eng_text: Most have involved people who work with poultry, but there is also some risk to birdwatchers.

text: Típiko pa Noruega ta e fjordnan perpendikular i vayenan ku di repente ta kambia den un plataforma haltu, mas o ménos plat.
eng_text: Typical for Norway are steep fjords and valleys that suddenly give way to a high, more or less even plateau.

text: Hopi bia ta referí na e plataformanan aki komo “vidde”, ku ta nifiká un espasio hanchu, habrí, sin palu, un ekspanshon sin frontera.
eng_text: These plateaus are often referred to as "vidde" meaning a wide, open treeless space, a boundless expanse.

text: Na Rogaland i Agder mayoria bia ta yama nan “hei” loke ta nifiká un tereno di santu sin palu ku hopi bia ta kubrí ku e mata érika.
eng_text: In Rogaland and Agder they are usually called "hei" meaning a treeless moorland often covered in heather.

text: E glèchernan no ta stabil, pero ta baha e seru. Esaki ta kousa sker, skref, ku por ta tapá ku brùg di sneu.
eng_text: The glaciers are not stable, but flow down the mountain. This will cause cracks, crevasses, which may be obscured by snow bridges.

text: E murayanan i daknan di kueba di eis por basha aden i skernan por sera.
eng_text: The walls and roofs of ice caves can collapse and cracks can get closed.

text: Na e rant di e glèchernan blòki grandi ta kibra lòs, kai abou i kisas bula òf lora mas leu di e rant.
eng_text: At the edge of glaciers huge blocks break loose, fall down and perhaps jump or roll farther from the edge.

text: E temporada di turista pa e stashonnan den seru generalmente tin su kumbre durante di temporada despues di zomer ora ku ainda e tempu ta manera den zomer.
eng_text: The tourist season for the hill stations generally peaks during the Indian summer.

text: Sinembargo nan tin un tipo di beyesa i grasia diferente den wenter, ora hopi stashon den seru ta haña kantidatnan saludabel di sneu i ta ofresé aktividat manera skimentu i kore snowboard.
eng_text: However, they have a different kind of beauty and charm during winter, with many hill stations receiving healthy amounts of snow and offering activities such as skiing and snowboarding.

text: Poko kompania di aviashon numa ainda ta ofresé tarifa di rou, ku por baha e gastu un tiki di biaha na último momento pa motibu di entiero.
eng_text: Only a few airlines still offer bereavement fares, which slightly discount the cost of last-minute funeral travel.

text: Kompanianan aéreo ku ta ofresé esaki ta inkluí Air Canada, Delta Airlines, Lufthansa pa buelo ku ta originá di Estádos Unídos òf Canada, i WestJet.
eng_text: Airlines that offer these include Air Canada, Delta Air Lines, Lufthansa for flights originating from the U.S. or Canada, and WestJet.

text: Den tur e kasonan, bo mester buk via telefòn direktamente ku e kompania di aviashon.
eng_text: In all cases, you must book by phone directly with the airline.
